===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\minecraft\MinecraftDependencyReader.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.LinkOption;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/** Collects declared mod / Maven dependencies from metadata and Gradle text. */
public final class MinecraftDependencyReader {
    private static final Pattern TOML_DEP = Pattern.compile(
            "modId\\s*=\\s*\"([^\"]+)\"[\\s\\S]*?(?:type|mandatory)\\s*=\\s*\"?([^\"]+)\"?[\\s\\S]*?versionRange\\s*=\\s*\"([^\"]+)\"",
            Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);
    private static final Pattern FABRIC_DEP = Pattern.compile("\"([^\"]+)\"\\s*:\\s*\"([^\"]+)\"");

    private MinecraftDependencyReader() {}

    public static List<String> read(ProjectStructure structure, MinecraftLoader loader, MinecraftMetadataReader.ModMetadata meta) throws IOException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(structure);
        Objects.requireNonNull(loader);
        Set<String> deps = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        Path root = structure.rootPath();
        switch (loader) {
            case NEOFORGE -> readTomlDeps(root.resolve("src/main/resources/META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml"), deps);
            case FORGE -> readTomlDeps(root.resolve("src/main/resources/META-INF/mods.toml"), deps);
            case FABRIC -> readJsonDeps(root.resolve("src/main/resources/fabric.mod.json"), deps);
            case QUILT -> readJsonDeps(root.resolve("src/main/resources/quilt.mod.json"), deps);
            case UNKNOWN -> {
                for (String path : structure.metadataFiles()) {
                    Path file = root.resolve(path);
                    if (path.endsWith(".toml")) readTomlDeps(file, deps);
                    else if (path.endsWith(".json")) readJsonDeps(file, deps);
                }
            }
        }
        if (structure.hasGradle()) {
            MinecraftGradleAnalysis.GradleSnapshot gradle = MinecraftGradleAnalysis.analyze(root);
            deps.addAll(gradle.dependencies());
        }
        if (meta != null && !meta.modId().isEmpty()) deps.removeIf(d -> d.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("modid=" + meta.modId().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)));
        List<String> result = new ArrayList<>(deps);
        if (result.size() > 128) return List.copyOf(result.subList(0, 128));
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }

    private static void readTomlDeps(Path file, Set<String> deps) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(file, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return;
        String text = MinecraftGradleAnalysis.read(file);
        Matcher m = TOML_DEP.matcher(text);
        while (m.find() && deps.size() < 128) {
            deps.add("mod:" + m.group(1) + ":" + m.group(3) + " (" + m.group(2) + ")");
        }
        // Also accept simple adjacent declarations
        Matcher simple = Pattern.compile("\\[\\[dependencies\\.[^]]+]]\\s*modId\\s*=\\s*\"([^\"]+)\"\\s*versionRange\\s*=\\s*\"([^\"]+)\"").matcher(text);
        while (simple.find() && deps.size() < 128) deps.add("mod:" + simple.group(1) + ":" + simple.group(2));
    }

    private static void readJsonDeps(Path file, Set<String> deps) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(file, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return;
        String text = MinecraftGradleAnalysis.read(file);
        Matcher block = Pattern.compile("\"(?:depends|depends_overrides|breaking)\"\\s*:\\s*\\{([^}]*)}").matcher(text);
        while (block.find()) {
            Matcher item = FABRIC_DEP.matcher(block.group(1));
            while (item.find() && deps.size() < 128) deps.add("mod:" + item.group(1) + ":" + item.group(2));
        }
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\minecraft\MinecraftGradleAnalysis.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.CodingErrorAction;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.LinkOption;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Properties;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Read-only Gradle text analysis. Never rewrites build scripts or evaluates Gradle.
 */
public final class MinecraftGradleAnalysis {
    public static final int MAX_FILE_BYTES = 512 * 1024;

    public record GradleSnapshot(
            String version,
            List<String> plugins,
            List<String> dependencies,
            List<String> repositories,
            List<String> declaredTasks,
            Properties properties
    ) {
        public GradleSnapshot {
            version = Objects.requireNonNullElse(version, "").trim();
            plugins = plugins == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(plugins);
            dependencies = dependencies == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(dependencies);
            repositories = repositories == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(repositories);
            declaredTasks = declaredTasks == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(declaredTasks);
            properties = copy(properties);
        }

        public static GradleSnapshot empty() {
            return new GradleSnapshot("", List.of(), List.of(), List.of(), List.of(), new Properties());
        }

        private static Properties copy(Properties source) {
            Properties out = new Properties();
            if (source != null) out.putAll(source);
            return out;
        }
    }

    private static final Pattern PLUGIN_ID = Pattern.compile("id\\s*[('\"]([^'\")]+)['\")]");
    private static final Pattern DEPENDENCY = Pattern.compile(
            "(implementation|api|compileOnly|runtimeOnly|modImplementation|modApi|modCompileOnly|minecraft|neoForge|forge)\\s*[(\\[]?\\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]");
    private static final Pattern REPOSITORY = Pattern.compile(
            "maven\\s*\\{[^}]*url\\s*=?\\s*(?:uri\\()?['\"](https?://[^'\"]+)['\"]",
            Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE | Pattern.DOTALL);
    private static final Pattern TASK = Pattern.compile("(?:tasks\\.)?(?:named|register|create)\\s*\\(\\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]");
    private static final Pattern RUNS = Pattern.compile("(?m)^\\s*(client|server|gameTestServer|data|clientData)\\s*\\{");

    private MinecraftGradleAnalysis() {}

    public static GradleSnapshot analyze(Path root) throws IOException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(root);
        Properties properties = new Properties();
        Path props = root.resolve("gradle.properties");
        if (Files.isRegularFile(props, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
            String text = read(props);
            try {
                properties.load(new java.io.StringReader(text));
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
                /* keep empty; caller surfaces soft warnings elsewhere */
            }
        }
        StringBuilder scripts = new StringBuilder();
        for (String name : List.of("build.gradle", "build.gradle.kts", "settings.gradle", "settings.gradle.kts")) {
            Path file = root.resolve(name);
            if (Files.isRegularFile(file, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) scripts.append(read(file)).append('\n');
        }
        String body = scripts.toString();
        Set<String> plugins = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        Matcher pluginMatcher = PLUGIN_ID.matcher(body);
        while (pluginMatcher.find() && plugins.size() < 64) plugins.add(pluginMatcher.group(1).trim());

        Set<String> dependencies = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        Matcher depMatcher = DEPENDENCY.matcher(body);
        while (depMatcher.find() && dependencies.size() < 128) {
            dependencies.add(depMatcher.group(1) + " " + depMatcher.group(2).trim());
        }

        Set<String> repositories = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        if (body.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("mavenCentral()")) repositories.add("mavenCentral()");
        Matcher repoMatcher = REPOSITORY.matcher(body);
        while (repoMatcher.find() && repositories.size() < 32) repositories.add(repoMatcher.group(1).trim());

        Set<String> tasks = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        Matcher taskMatcher = TASK.matcher(body);
        while (taskMatcher.find() && tasks.size() < 64) tasks.add(taskMatcher.group(1).trim());
        Matcher runMatcher = RUNS.matcher(body);
        while (runMatcher.find() && tasks.size() < 64) {
            String run = runMatcher.group(1);
            tasks.add("run" + Character.toUpperCase(run.charAt(0)) + run.substring(1));
        }
        for (String common : List.of("build", "clean", "jar", "runClient", "runServer", "runGameTestServer", "genIntellijRuns")) {
            if (body.contains(common) || body.contains("'" + common + "'") || body.contains("\"" + common + "\""))
                tasks.add(common);
        }

        String version = firstNonBlank(
                properties.getProperty("mod_version"),
                properties.getProperty("version"),
                extractAssignment(body, "version")
        );
        return new GradleSnapshot(version, new ArrayList<>(plugins), new ArrayList<>(dependencies),
                new ArrayList<>(repositories), new ArrayList<>(tasks), properties);
    }

    private static String extractAssignment(String body, String key) {
        Matcher m = Pattern.compile("(?m)^\\s*" + Pattern.quote(key) + "\\s*=\\s*['\"]?([^'\\\"\\n]+)").matcher(body);
        return m.find() ? m.group(1).trim() : "";
    }

    private static String firstNonBlank(String... values) {
        for (String value : values) if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) return value.trim();
        return "";
    }

    static String read(Path file) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(file, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return "";
        long size = Files.size(file);
        if (size > MAX_FILE_BYTES) throw new IOException("Gradle file exceeds analysis limit: " + file.getFileName());
        byte[] bytes = Files.readAllBytes(file);
        return StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newDecoder()
                .onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPLACE)
                .onUnmappableCharacter(CodingErrorAction.REPLACE)
                .decode(java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes))
                .toString()
                .replace("\r\n", "\n")
                .replace('\r', '\n');
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\minecraft\MinecraftImportProblem.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

/** Actionable import problem with suggested resolutions for UI. */
public record MinecraftImportProblem(
        String code,
        String message,
        Severity severity,
        List<Solution> solutions
) {
    public enum Severity { INFO, WARNING, ERROR }

    public enum Solution {
        AUTO_DETECT,
        SELECT_MANUALLY,
        IGNORE,
        RETRY,
        USE_COPY_MODE,
        USE_LINK_MODE
    }

    public MinecraftImportProblem {
        Objects.requireNonNull(code);
        Objects.requireNonNull(message);
        Objects.requireNonNull(severity);
        solutions = solutions == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(solutions);
    }

    public static MinecraftImportProblem error(String code, String message, Solution... solutions) {
        return new MinecraftImportProblem(code, message, Severity.ERROR, List.of(solutions));
    }

    public static MinecraftImportProblem warning(String code, String message, Solution... solutions) {
        return new MinecraftImportProblem(code, message, Severity.WARNING, List.of(solutions));
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\minecraft\MinecraftImportValidator.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.FileVisitResult;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.LinkOption;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.SimpleFileVisitor;
import java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Security gate for Minecraft import. Rejects traversal escapes, unsafe links,
 * suspicious payloads, and oversized trees before copy/link.
 */
public final class MinecraftImportValidator {
    public static final int MAX_ENTRIES = 2000;
    public static final long MAX_FILE_BYTES = 16L * 1024 * 1024;
    public static final long MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 128L * 1024 * 1024;
    public static final long MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES = 64L * 1024 * 1024;

    private static final Set<String> SUSPICIOUS_NAMES = Set.of(
            "payload.exe", "miner.exe", "crack.exe", "keygen.exe", "autorun.inf");
    private static final Set<String> SUSPICIOUS_EXT = Set.of(
            ".exe", ".dll", ".bat", ".cmd", ".ps1", ".scr", ".vbs", ".js", ".msi", ".com");
    private static final Set<String> ARCHIVE_EXT = Set.of(".zip", ".jar", ".rar", ".7z", ".tar", ".gz");
    private static final Set<String> SKIP_DIRS = Set.of(
            ".git", ".gradle", ".idea", ".vscode", ".settings", "build", "out", "run", ".genesis-build");

    public record ValidationResult(boolean ok, List<MinecraftImportProblem> problems) {
        public ValidationResult {
            problems = problems == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(problems);
        }
    }

    private MinecraftImportValidator() {}

    public static ValidationResult validateRoot(Path root) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(root);
        List<MinecraftImportProblem> problems = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            if (!root.isAbsolute()) {
                problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("relative_path",
                        "Use an absolute project path",
                        MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.SELECT_MANUALLY));
                return new ValidationResult(false, problems);
            }
            if (!Files.isDirectory(root, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
                problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("not_directory",
                        "Selected path is not a directory",
                        MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.SELECT_MANUALLY));
                return new ValidationResult(false, problems);
            }
            if (Files.isSymbolicLink(root)) {
                problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("symlink_root",
                        "Symbolic link / junction project roots are not allowed",
                        MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.SELECT_MANUALLY));
                return new ValidationResult(false, problems);
            }
            Path real = root.toRealPath();
            scan(root, real, problems);
            boolean fatal = problems.stream().anyMatch(p -> p.severity() == MinecraftImportProblem.Severity.ERROR);
            return new ValidationResult(!fatal, problems);
        } catch (IOException error) {
            problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("io",
                    error.getMessage() == null ? "Unable to validate project" : error.getMessage(),
                    MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.RETRY,
                    MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.SELECT_MANUALLY));
            return new ValidationResult(false, problems);
        }
    }

    private static void scan(Path root, Path realRoot, List<MinecraftImportProblem> problems) throws IOException {
        long[] total = {0};
        int[] count = {0};
        Files.walkFileTree(root, new SimpleFileVisitor<>() {
            @Override public FileVisitResult preVisitDirectory(Path dir, BasicFileAttributes attrs) throws IOException {
                if (dir.equals(root)) return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
                attrs = Files.readAttributes(dir, BasicFileAttributes.class, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
                String name = dir.getFileName().toString();
                if (SKIP_DIRS.contains(name)) return FileVisitResult.SKIP_SUBTREE;
                if (attrs.isSymbolicLink() || Files.isSymbolicLink(dir)) {
                    problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("symlink",
                            "Unsafe symbolic link refused: " + root.relativize(dir),
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.SELECT_MANUALLY));
                    return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE;
                }
                if (!dir.toRealPath().startsWith(realRoot)) {
                    problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("path_traversal",
                            "Directory escapes project root: " + root.relativize(dir),
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.SELECT_MANUALLY));
                    return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE;
                }
                if (++count[0] > MAX_ENTRIES) {
                    problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("too_many_entries",
                            "Project exceeds " + MAX_ENTRIES + " entries",
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.USE_LINK_MODE,
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.IGNORE));
                    return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE;
                }
                return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
            }

            @Override public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path file, BasicFileAttributes attrs) throws IOException {
                attrs = Files.readAttributes(file, BasicFileAttributes.class, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
                String relative = root.relativize(file).toString().replace('\\', '/');
                if (relative.contains("..")) {
                    problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("path_traversal",
                            "Path traversal refused: " + relative,
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.SELECT_MANUALLY));
                    return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE;
                }
                if (attrs.isSymbolicLink() || Files.isSymbolicLink(file)) {
                    problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("symlink",
                            "Unsafe symbolic link refused: " + relative,
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.SELECT_MANUALLY));
                    return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE;
                }
                if (!file.toRealPath().startsWith(realRoot)) {
                    problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("path_traversal",
                            "File escapes project root: " + relative,
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.SELECT_MANUALLY));
                    return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE;
                }
                if (++count[0] > MAX_ENTRIES) {
                    problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("too_many_entries",
                            "Project exceeds " + MAX_ENTRIES + " entries",
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.USE_LINK_MODE));
                    return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE;
                }
                if (!attrs.isRegularFile()) {
                    problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("not_regular",
                            "Not a regular file: " + relative,
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.IGNORE));
                    return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE;
                }
                long size = attrs.size();
                String lower = file.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (SUSPICIOUS_NAMES.contains(lower) || hasSuspiciousExtension(lower, relative)) {
                    problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("suspicious_payload",
                            "Suspicious executable payload refused: " + relative,
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.SELECT_MANUALLY,
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.IGNORE));
                    return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE;
                }
                if (isArchive(lower) && size > MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES) {
                    problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("huge_archive",
                            "Archive exceeds 64 MiB: " + relative,
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.USE_LINK_MODE,
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.IGNORE));
                    return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE;
                }
                if (size > MAX_FILE_BYTES) {
                    problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("huge_file",
                            "File exceeds 16 MiB: " + relative,
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.USE_LINK_MODE,
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.IGNORE));
                    return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE;
                }
                total[0] += size;
                if (total[0] > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES) {
                    problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.error("huge_project",
                            "Project exceeds 128 MiB",
                            MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.USE_LINK_MODE));
                    return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE;
                }
                return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
            }
        });
    }

    private static boolean hasSuspiciousExtension(String lowerName, String relative) {
        // Gradle wrapper scripts and shell helpers in repo roots are allowed; nested payload-like names are not.
        if (lowerName.equals("gradlew") || lowerName.equals("gradlew.bat") || lowerName.equals("gradlew.cmd")) return false;
        if (relative.startsWith("gradle/")) return false;
        for (String ext : SUSPICIOUS_EXT) {
            if (lowerName.endsWith(ext)) {
                // Allow common Minecraft/dev scripts only at project root tooling paths.
                if ((ext.equals(".bat") || ext.equals(".cmd") || ext.equals(".ps1") || ext.equals(".sh"))
                        && !relative.contains("/")) return false;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean isArchive(String lowerName) {
        for (String ext : ARCHIVE_EXT) if (lowerName.endsWith(ext)) return true;
        return false;
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\minecraft\MinecraftLoaderDetector.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.LinkOption;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Objects;

/** Detects NeoForge / Forge / Fabric / Quilt from Gradle scripts and mod metadata. */
public final class MinecraftLoaderDetector {
    private MinecraftLoaderDetector() {}

    public static MinecraftLoader detect(ProjectStructure structure) throws IOException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(structure);
        Path root = structure.rootPath();
        String gradle = readAll(root, "build.gradle", "build.gradle.kts", "settings.gradle", "settings.gradle.kts", "gradle.properties");
        String lower = gradle.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        boolean neoMeta = exists(root, "src/main/resources/META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml");
        boolean forgeMeta = exists(root, "src/main/resources/META-INF/mods.toml");
        boolean fabricMeta = exists(root, "src/main/resources/fabric.mod.json");
        boolean quiltMeta = exists(root, "src/main/resources/quilt.mod.json");

        boolean neoGradle = lower.contains("net.neoforged.gradle") || lower.contains("neoforge")
                || lower.contains("userdev") && lower.contains("neoforged");
        boolean forgeGradle = lower.contains("net.minecraftforge.gradle") || lower.contains("minecraftforge")
                || (lower.contains("fg.deobf") && !neoGradle);
        boolean fabricGradle = lower.contains("fabric-loom") || lower.contains("net.fabricmc") || lower.contains("fabricmc");
        boolean quiltGradle = lower.contains("org.quiltmc") || lower.contains("quilt-loom") || lower.contains("quiltmc");

        if (neoMeta || neoGradle) return MinecraftLoader.NEOFORGE;
        if (quiltMeta || quiltGradle) return MinecraftLoader.QUILT;
        if (fabricMeta || fabricGradle) return MinecraftLoader.FABRIC;
        if (forgeMeta || forgeGradle) return MinecraftLoader.FORGE;
        return MinecraftLoader.UNKNOWN;
    }

    private static boolean exists(Path root, String relative) {
        return Files.isRegularFile(root.resolve(relative), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
    }

    private static String readAll(Path root, String... names) throws IOException {
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        for (String name : names) {
            Path file = root.resolve(name);
            if (Files.isRegularFile(file, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) out.append(MinecraftGradleAnalysis.read(file)).append('\n');
        }
        return out.toString();
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\minecraft\MinecraftMetadataReader.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.FileVisitResult;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.LinkOption;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.SimpleFileVisitor;
import java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/** Reads mod metadata and main-class hints without executing project code. */
public final class MinecraftMetadataReader {
    public record ModMetadata(
            String modId,
            String displayName,
            String version,
            String description,
            List<String> authors,
            String minecraftVersion,
            String javaVersion,
            String loaderVersion,
            String entrypointHint
    ) {
        public ModMetadata {
            modId = Objects.requireNonNullElse(modId, "").trim();
            displayName = Objects.requireNonNullElse(displayName, "").trim();
            version = Objects.requireNonNullElse(version, "").trim();
            description = Objects.requireNonNullElse(description, "").trim();
            authors = authors == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(authors);
            minecraftVersion = Objects.requireNonNullElse(minecraftVersion, "").trim();
            javaVersion = Objects.requireNonNullElse(javaVersion, "").trim();
            loaderVersion = Objects.requireNonNullElse(loaderVersion, "").trim();
            entrypointHint = Objects.requireNonNullElse(entrypointHint, "").trim();
        }

        public static ModMetadata empty() {
            return new ModMetadata("", "", "", "", List.of(), "", "", "", "");
        }
    }

    private static final Pattern TOML_STRING = Pattern.compile(
            "^(?:\"?([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\"?)\\s*=\\s*(?:\"\"\"([\\s\\S]*?)\"\"\"|'''([\\s\\S]*?)'''|\"([^\"]*)\"|'([^']*)')",
            Pattern.MULTILINE);
    private static final Pattern JSON_STRING = Pattern.compile("\"([^\"]+)\"\\s*:\\s*\"([^\"]*)\"");
    private static final Pattern JSON_ARRAY = Pattern.compile("\"([^\"]+)\"\\s*:\\s*\\[([^]]*)]");
    private static final Pattern MOD_ANNOTATION = Pattern.compile("@Mod\\s*\\(\\s*(?:value\\s*=\\s*)?(?:([A-Za-z_][\\w.]*)\\.MOD_ID|\"([^\"]+)\"|'([^']+)')");
    private static final Pattern CLASS_NAME = Pattern.compile("(?m)^\\s*(?:public\\s+)?(?:final\\s+)?class\\s+([A-Za-z_][\\w]*)");
    private static final Pattern PACKAGE_NAME = Pattern.compile("(?m)^\\s*package\\s+([A-Za-z_][\\w.]*)\\s*;");
    private static final int MAX_JAVA_SCAN = 200;

    private MinecraftMetadataReader() {}

    public static ModMetadata read(ProjectStructure structure, MinecraftLoader loader) throws IOException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(structure);
        Objects.requireNonNull(loader);
        Path root = structure.rootPath();
        return switch (loader) {
            case NEOFORGE -> readToml(root.resolve("src/main/resources/META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml"), true);
            case FORGE -> readToml(root.resolve("src/main/resources/META-INF/mods.toml"), false);
            case FABRIC -> readFabricJson(root.resolve("src/main/resources/fabric.mod.json"));
            case QUILT -> readQuiltJson(root.resolve("src/main/resources/quilt.mod.json"));
            case UNKNOWN -> fallback(structure);
        };
    }

    public static String detectMainClass(ProjectStructure structure, MinecraftLoader loader, ModMetadata meta) throws IOException {
        if (meta != null && !meta.entrypointHint().isEmpty()) return meta.entrypointHint();
        if (loader == MinecraftLoader.FABRIC || loader == MinecraftLoader.QUILT) {
            ModMetadata json = read(structure, loader);
            if (!json.entrypointHint().isEmpty()) return json.entrypointHint();
        }
        return findAnnotatedMod(structure.rootPath());
    }

    private static ModMetadata fallback(ProjectStructure structure) throws IOException {
        for (String path : structure.metadataFiles()) {
            Path file = structure.rootPath().resolve(path);
            String name = path.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (name.endsWith("neoforge.mods.toml")) return readToml(file, true);
            if (name.endsWith("mods.toml")) return readToml(file, false);
            if (name.endsWith("fabric.mod.json")) return readFabricJson(file);
            if (name.endsWith("quilt.mod.json")) return readQuiltJson(file);
        }
        return ModMetadata.empty();
    }

    private static ModMetadata readToml(Path file, boolean neo) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(file, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return ModMetadata.empty();
        String text = MinecraftGradleAnalysis.read(file);
        String table = "";
        String modId = "", displayName = "", version = "", description = "", minecraftVersion = "", loaderVersion = "";
        List<String> authors = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String raw : text.split("\\R")) {
            String line = raw.strip();
            if (line.startsWith("[")) {
                table = line;
                continue;
            }
            Matcher m = Pattern.compile("^(?:modId|displayName|version|description|authors|versionRange)\\s*=\\s*(.*)$").matcher(line);
            if (!m.find()) continue;
            String key = line.substring(0, line.indexOf('=')).strip().replace("\"", "");
            String value = unquote(m.group(1).strip());
            if (table.equals("[[mods]]") || table.isEmpty()) {
                switch (key) {
                    case "modId" -> { if (modId.isEmpty()) modId = value; }
                    case "displayName" -> { if (displayName.isEmpty()) displayName = value; }
                    case "version" -> { if (version.isEmpty()) version = value; }
                    case "description" -> { if (description.isEmpty()) description = value; }
                    case "authors" -> { if (authors.isEmpty() && !value.isBlank()) authors = List.of(value.split("\\s*,\\s*")); }
                    default -> { }
                }
            }
            if (key.equals("versionRange") && table.contains("dependencies")) {
                if (line.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("minecraft") || previousModIdWas(text, table, "minecraft"))
                    minecraftVersion = value;
                if (neo && previousModIdWas(text, table, "neoforge")) loaderVersion = value;
                if (!neo && previousModIdWas(text, table, "forge")) loaderVersion = value;
            }
        }
        // Simpler pass for dependency version ranges near modId="minecraft"
        Matcher dep = Pattern.compile("modId\\s*=\\s*\"(minecraft|neoforge|forge)\"[\\s\\S]*?versionRange\\s*=\\s*\"([^\"]+)\"", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE).matcher(text);
        while (dep.find()) {
            if (dep.group(1).equalsIgnoreCase("minecraft") && minecraftVersion.isEmpty()) minecraftVersion = dep.group(2);
            if ((dep.group(1).equalsIgnoreCase("neoforge") || dep.group(1).equalsIgnoreCase("forge")) && loaderVersion.isEmpty())
                loaderVersion = dep.group(2);
        }
        return new ModMetadata(modId, displayName, version, description, authors, minecraftVersion, "", loaderVersion, "");
    }

    private static boolean previousModIdWas(String text, String table, String id) {
        return table.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("dependencies") && text.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("modid=\"" + id + "\"");
    }

    private static ModMetadata readFabricJson(Path file) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(file, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return ModMetadata.empty();
        String text = MinecraftGradleAnalysis.read(file);
        String id = jsonString(text, "id");
        String name = jsonString(text, "name");
        String version = jsonString(text, "version");
        String description = jsonString(text, "description");
        List<String> authors = jsonStringArray(text, "authors");
        String entry = firstEntrypoint(text);
        String minecraft = dependencyVersion(text, "minecraft");
        String loader = dependencyVersion(text, "fabricloader");
        String java = dependencyVersion(text, "java");
        return new ModMetadata(id, name, version, description, authors, minecraft, java, loader, entry);
    }

    private static ModMetadata readQuiltJson(Path file) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(file, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return ModMetadata.empty();
        String text = MinecraftGradleAnalysis.read(file);
        // Quilt often nests under quilt_loader
        String id = firstNonBlank(jsonNested(text, "id"), jsonString(text, "id"));
        String name = firstNonBlank(jsonNested(text, "name"), jsonString(text, "name"), id);
        String version = firstNonBlank(jsonNested(text, "version"), jsonString(text, "version"));
        String description = jsonString(text, "description");
        List<String> authors = jsonStringArray(text, "authors");
        String entry = firstEntrypoint(text);
        String minecraft = dependencyVersion(text, "minecraft");
        String loader = dependencyVersion(text, "quilt_loader");
        return new ModMetadata(id, name, version, description, authors, minecraft, "", loader, entry);
    }

    private static String findAnnotatedMod(Path root) throws IOException {
        List<String> hits = new ArrayList<>();
        Path src = root.resolve("src");
        if (!Files.isDirectory(src, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return "";
        Files.walkFileTree(src, new SimpleFileVisitor<>() {
            private int count;
            @Override public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path file, BasicFileAttributes attrs) throws IOException {
                if (count >= MAX_JAVA_SCAN) return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE;
                if (!file.getFileName().toString().endsWith(".java")) return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
                if (Files.isSymbolicLink(file) || attrs.size() > MinecraftGradleAnalysis.MAX_FILE_BYTES) return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
                count++;
                String text = MinecraftGradleAnalysis.read(file);
                Matcher mod = MOD_ANNOTATION.matcher(text);
                if (!mod.find()) return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
                Matcher pkg = PACKAGE_NAME.matcher(text);
                Matcher cls = CLASS_NAME.matcher(text);
                if (cls.find()) {
                    String simple = cls.group(1);
                    String fqn = pkg.find() ? pkg.group(1) + "." + simple : simple;
                    hits.add(fqn);
                }
                return hits.size() >= 8 ? FileVisitResult.TERMINATE : FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
            }
            @Override public FileVisitResult preVisitDirectory(Path dir, BasicFileAttributes attrs) {
                return Files.isSymbolicLink(dir) ? FileVisitResult.SKIP_SUBTREE : FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
            }
        });
        return hits.isEmpty() ? "" : hits.get(0);
    }

    private static String jsonString(String text, String key) {
        Matcher m = Pattern.compile("\"" + Pattern.quote(key) + "\"\\s*:\\s*\"([^\"]*)\"").matcher(text);
        return m.find() ? m.group(1) : "";
    }

    private static String jsonNested(String text, String key) {
        Matcher m = Pattern.compile("\"quilt_loader\"\\s*:\\s*\\{([\\s\\S]*?)}").matcher(text);
        return m.find() ? jsonString(m.group(1), key) : "";
    }

    private static List<String> jsonStringArray(String text, String key) {
        Matcher m = JSON_ARRAY.matcher(text);
        while (m.find()) {
            if (!m.group(1).equals(key)) continue;
            List<String> values = new ArrayList<>();
            Matcher item = Pattern.compile("\"([^\"]+)\"").matcher(m.group(2));
            while (item.find() && values.size() < 16) values.add(item.group(1));
            return List.copyOf(values);
        }
        String single = jsonString(text, key);
        return single.isEmpty() ? List.of() : List.of(single);
    }

    private static String firstEntrypoint(String text) {
        Matcher block = Pattern.compile("\"entrypoints\"\\s*:\\s*\\{([\\s\\S]*?)}").matcher(text);
        if (!block.find()) return "";
        Matcher item = Pattern.compile("\"(?:main|client|server)\"\\s*:\\s*(?:\"([^\"]+)\"|\\[\\s*\"([^\"]+)\")").matcher(block.group(1));
        return item.find() ? firstNonBlank(item.group(1), item.group(2)) : "";
    }

    private static String dependencyVersion(String text, String id) {
        Matcher m = Pattern.compile("\"" + Pattern.quote(id) + "\"\\s*:\\s*\"([^\"]+)\"").matcher(text);
        return m.find() ? m.group(1) : "";
    }

    private static String unquote(String value) {
        value = value.strip();
        if ((value.startsWith("\"\"\"") && value.endsWith("\"\"\"")) || (value.startsWith("'''") && value.endsWith("'''")))
            return value.substring(3, value.length() - 3).strip();
        if (value.length() >= 2 && ((value.startsWith("\"") && value.endsWith("\"")) || (value.startsWith("'") && value.endsWith("'"))))
            return value.substring(1, value.length() - 1);
        return value;
    }

    private static String firstNonBlank(String... values) {
        for (String value : values) if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) return value.trim();
        return "";
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\minecraft\MinecraftProjectDetector.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.BuildTools;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.DirectoryStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.LinkOption;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Phase 1 file discovery and project-type detection. Does not import or rewrite anything.
 */
public final class MinecraftProjectDetector {
    private static final List<String> BUILD_NAMES = List.of(
            "build.gradle", "build.gradle.kts", "settings.gradle", "settings.gradle.kts", "gradle.properties");
    private static final List<String> METADATA_PATHS = List.of(
            "src/main/resources/META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml",
            "src/main/resources/META-INF/mods.toml",
            "src/main/resources/fabric.mod.json",
            "src/main/resources/quilt.mod.json",
            "src/main/resources/META-INF/mods.toml.template");
    private static final List<String> SOURCE_CANDIDATES = List.of(
            "src/main/java", "src/main/kotlin", "src/client/java", "src/common/java", "src/server/java",
            "src/client", "src/common", "src/server", "src");
    private static final List<String> RESOURCE_CANDIDATES = List.of(
            "src/main/resources", "src/client/resources", "src/common/resources", "src/server/resources", "resources");

    private MinecraftProjectDetector() {}

    public static ProjectStructure discover(Path root) throws IOException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(root);
        if (!root.isAbsolute()) throw new IOException("Select an absolute project directory");
        if (!Files.isDirectory(root, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) || Files.isSymbolicLink(root))
            throw new IOException("Select a regular project directory");

        List<String> buildFiles = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String name : BUILD_NAMES) {
            if (Files.isRegularFile(root.resolve(name), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) buildFiles.add(name);
        }
        List<String> metadataFiles = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String path : METADATA_PATHS) {
            if (Files.isRegularFile(root.resolve(path), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) metadataFiles.add(path);
        }
        List<String> sources = presentDirs(root, SOURCE_CANDIDATES);
        List<String> resources = presentDirs(root, RESOURCE_CANDIDATES);
        List<String> modules = discoverModules(root);
        boolean hasWrapper = Files.isRegularFile(root.resolve("gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar"), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)
                || Files.isRegularFile(root.resolve("gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties"), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
        boolean hasBuildLibs = Files.isDirectory(root.resolve("build/libs"), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
        boolean hasGradle = BuildTools.gradleRoot(root);
        return new ProjectStructure(root.toAbsolutePath().normalize(), hasGradle, !metadataFiles.isEmpty(),
                sources, resources, modules, buildFiles, metadataFiles, hasBuildLibs, hasWrapper);
    }

    public static ProjectType detectType(ProjectStructure structure, MinecraftLoader loader) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(structure);
        Objects.requireNonNull(loader);
        if (looksLikeServerModule(structure)) return ProjectType.SERVER_MODULE;
        if (loader != MinecraftLoader.UNKNOWN || structure.hasMinecraftMetadata()) {
            if (looksLikeLibrary(structure)) return ProjectType.MINECRAFT_LIBRARY;
            return ProjectType.MINECRAFT_MOD;
        }
        if (structure.hasGradle()) {
            if (looksLikeLibrary(structure)) return ProjectType.JAVA_LIBRARY;
            return ProjectType.GRADLE;
        }
        if (!structure.sourceFolders().isEmpty()) return ProjectType.JAVA;
        return ProjectType.UNKNOWN;
    }

    public static MinecraftProjectInfo analyze(Path root) throws IOException {
        MinecraftImportValidator.ValidationResult security = MinecraftImportValidator.validateRoot(root);
        if (!security.ok()) {
            throw new IOException(security.problems().isEmpty()
                    ? "Import validation failed"
                    : security.problems().get(0).message());
        }
        ProjectStructure structure = discover(root);
        MinecraftLoader loader = MinecraftLoaderDetector.detect(structure);
        ProjectType type = detectType(structure, loader);
        MinecraftMetadataReader.ModMetadata meta = MinecraftMetadataReader.read(structure, loader);
        List<String> dependencies = MinecraftDependencyReader.read(structure, loader, meta);
        String mainClass = MinecraftMetadataReader.detectMainClass(structure, loader, meta);
        MinecraftGradleAnalysis.GradleSnapshot gradle = structure.hasGradle()
                ? MinecraftGradleAnalysis.analyze(structure.rootPath())
                : MinecraftGradleAnalysis.GradleSnapshot.empty();
        List<String> runTasks = MinecraftRunTasks.suggest(structure, loader, gradle);
        List<MinecraftImportProblem> problems = new ArrayList<>(security.problems());
        if (type == ProjectType.UNKNOWN)
            problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.warning("unknown_project",
                    "Could not classify this folder as a Minecraft or Gradle project",
                    MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.SELECT_MANUALLY,
                    MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.IGNORE));
        if (loader == MinecraftLoader.UNKNOWN && structure.hasMinecraftMetadata())
            problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.warning("unknown_loader",
                    "Minecraft metadata found, but the loader family is unclear",
                    MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.AUTO_DETECT,
                    MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.SELECT_MANUALLY));
        if (meta.modId().isEmpty() && (type == ProjectType.MINECRAFT_MOD || type == ProjectType.MINECRAFT_LIBRARY))
            problems.add(MinecraftImportProblem.warning("missing_mod_id",
                    "Mod id was not found in metadata; Genesis can still import the project",
                    MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.SELECT_MANUALLY,
                    MinecraftImportProblem.Solution.IGNORE));

        String minecraftVersion = firstNonBlank(meta.minecraftVersion(),
                gradle.properties().getProperty("minecraft_version", ""),
                gradle.properties().getProperty("mc_version", ""));
        String javaVersion = firstNonBlank(meta.javaVersion(),
                gradle.properties().getProperty("java_version", ""),
                extractJavaToolchain(gradle));
        String loaderVersion = firstNonBlank(meta.loaderVersion(),
                gradle.properties().getProperty("neo_version", ""),
                gradle.properties().getProperty("forge_version", ""),
                gradle.properties().getProperty("loader_version", ""));
        String version = firstNonBlank(meta.version(), gradle.version());
        MinecraftProjectMetadata metadata = new MinecraftProjectMetadata(
                loader == MinecraftLoader.UNKNOWN ? "" : loader.name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT),
                minecraftVersion, javaVersion, meta.modId(), mainClass, dependencies);
        return new MinecraftProjectInfo(structure, type, loader, meta.modId(), meta.displayName(), version,
                meta.description(), meta.authors(), mainClass, minecraftVersion, javaVersion, loaderVersion,
                dependencies, gradle, runTasks, problems, metadata);
    }

    private static boolean looksLikeLibrary(ProjectStructure structure) {
        String leaf = structure.rootPath().getFileName() == null ? "" : structure.rootPath().getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return leaf.contains("api") || leaf.contains("lib") || leaf.endsWith("-common");
    }

    private static boolean looksLikeServerModule(ProjectStructure structure) {
        return Files.isRegularFile(structure.rootPath().resolve("src/WorldModule.java"), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)
                || Files.isRegularFile(structure.rootPath().resolve("libraries/genesis-server-api-v1.jar"), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
    }

    private static List<String> presentDirs(Path root, List<String> candidates) {
        List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String relative : candidates) {
            Path path = root.resolve(relative);
            if (Files.isDirectory(path, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) && !Files.isSymbolicLink(path)) result.add(relative);
        }
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }

    private static List<String> discoverModules(Path root) throws IOException {
        Path settings = firstExisting(root, "settings.gradle", "settings.gradle.kts");
        List<String> modules = new ArrayList<>();
        if (settings != null) {
            String text = MinecraftGradleAnalysis.read(settings);
            for (String line : text.split("\\R")) {
                String trimmed = line.strip();
                if (trimmed.startsWith("include")) {
                    for (String token : trimmed.replace("include", "").split("[,()]")) {
                        String name = token.strip().replace("'", "").replace("\"", "").replace(":", "");
                        if (!name.isEmpty() && name.length() <= 64 && modules.size() < 32) modules.add(name);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        try (DirectoryStream<Path> stream = Files.newDirectoryStream(root)) {
            for (Path child : stream) {
                if (!Files.isDirectory(child, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) || Files.isSymbolicLink(child)) continue;
                String name = child.getFileName().toString();
                if (name.startsWith(".") || name.equals("build") || name.equals("src") || name.equals("gradle") || name.equals("run")) continue;
                if (BuildTools.gradleRoot(child) && modules.size() < 32 && !modules.contains(name)) modules.add(name);
            }
        }
        modules.sort(Comparator.naturalOrder());
        return List.copyOf(modules);
    }

    private static Path firstExisting(Path root, String... names) {
        for (String name : names) {
            Path path = root.resolve(name);
            if (Files.isRegularFile(path, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return path;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static String extractJavaToolchain(MinecraftGradleAnalysis.GradleSnapshot gradle) {
        for (String plugin : gradle.plugins()) {
            if (plugin.contains("java")) {/* marker only */}
        }
        String props = gradle.properties().getProperty("org.gradle.java.home", "");
        return props;
    }

    private static String firstNonBlank(String... values) {
        for (String value : values) if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) return value.trim();
        return "";
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\minecraft\MinecraftProjectImporter.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.GradleProjectImport;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.SourceProjects;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.LinkOption;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Properties;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;

/**
 * Phase 2 Minecraft import orchestrator. Extension layer — does not live in the editor.
 * Never rewrites the user's Gradle build files.
 */
public final class MinecraftProjectImporter {
    public record Result(
            SourceProjects.Project project,
            MinecraftProjectInfo info,
            MinecraftImportMode mode,
            Path workingRoot,
            Path genesisDir,
            GradleProjectImport.Summary summary
    ) {}

    private final SourceProjects storage;

    public MinecraftProjectImporter(SourceProjects storage) {
        this.storage = Objects.requireNonNull(storage);
    }

    /** Analyze only (Phase 1). */
    public MinecraftProjectInfo analyze(Path external) throws IOException {
        return MinecraftProjectDetector.analyze(external);
    }

    public Result importProject(String id, Path external, MinecraftImportMode mode, BooleanSupplier cancelled) throws IOException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(id);
        Objects.requireNonNull(external);
        Objects.requireNonNull(mode);
        Objects.requireNonNull(cancelled);
        if (!SourceProjects.validProject(id)) throw new IOException("Invalid project name");
        if (!external.isAbsolute()) throw new IOException("Select an absolute project directory");
        if (cancelled.getAsBoolean()) throw new IOException("Import cancelled");

        MinecraftImportValidator.ValidationResult security = MinecraftImportValidator.validateRoot(external);
        if (!security.ok()) {
            throw new IOException(security.problems().isEmpty() ? "Import validation failed" : security.problems().get(0).message());
        }
        MinecraftProjectInfo info = MinecraftProjectDetector.analyze(external);
        if (cancelled.getAsBoolean()) throw new IOException("Import cancelled");

        return switch (mode) {
            case COPY -> copy(id, external, info, cancelled);
            case LINK -> link(id, external, info, cancelled);
        };
    }

    private Result copy(String id, Path external, MinecraftProjectInfo info, BooleanSupplier cancelled) throws IOException {
        SourceProjects.Imported imported = info.structure().hasGradle()
                ? storage.importGradle(id, external, cancelled)
                : storage.importFolder(id, external, cancelled);
        Path managed = storage.projectDirectory(id);
        mergeManifest(managed, info, MinecraftImportMode.COPY, null);
        Path genesis = MinecraftWorkspaceCreator.write(managed, info, MinecraftImportMode.COPY, null);
        // Also stamp analysis on the managed copy for tooling that looks beside sources.
        return new Result(imported.project(), info, MinecraftImportMode.COPY, managed, genesis, imported.summary());
    }

    private Result link(String id, Path external, MinecraftProjectInfo info, BooleanSupplier cancelled) throws IOException {
        Path real = external.toRealPath();
        Path managedRoot = storage.root().toRealPath();
        if (real.startsWith(managedRoot) || managedRoot.startsWith(real))
            throw new IOException("Link a project outside the Genesis storage tree");
        if (cancelled.getAsBoolean()) throw new IOException("Import cancelled");

        // Write .genesis on the original project (non-destructive metadata only).
        Path genesisOnSource = MinecraftWorkspaceCreator.write(external, info, MinecraftImportMode.LINK, external);

        SourceProjects.Project project = storage.createMinecraftLink(id, external, info);
        Path stub = storage.projectDirectory(id);
        Path genesisOnStub = MinecraftWorkspaceCreator.write(stub, info, MinecraftImportMode.LINK, external);
        return new Result(project, info, MinecraftImportMode.LINK, external.toAbsolutePath().normalize(),
                genesisOnStub, new GradleProjectImport.Summary(0, 0));
    }

    private void mergeManifest(Path project, MinecraftProjectInfo info, MinecraftImportMode mode, Path linked) throws IOException {
        Path manifest = project.resolve("genesis-project.properties");
        Properties props = new Properties();
        if (Files.isRegularFile(manifest, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
            try (var reader = Files.newBufferedReader(manifest, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                props.load(reader);
            }
        }
        props.setProperty("format", props.getProperty("format", "1"));
        props.setProperty("language", props.getProperty("language", "JAVA"));
        props.putAll(MinecraftWorkspaceCreator.manifestHints(info, mode, linked));
        String text = MinecraftWorkspaceCreator.encodeManifest(props);
        byte[] data = text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if (data.length > 4096) throw new IOException("Project metadata size limit");
        Path tmp = Files.createTempFile(project, ".manifest-", ".tmp");
        try {
            Files.write(tmp, data, StandardOpenOption.TRUNCATE_EXISTING);
            Files.move(tmp, manifest, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
        } finally {
            Files.deleteIfExists(tmp);
        }
    }

    public static String reportText(MinecraftProjectInfo info) {
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        out.append(info.summary()).append('\n');
        out.append("Type: ").append(info.projectType()).append('\n');
        out.append("Loader: ").append(info.loader()).append('\n');
        if (!info.modId().isEmpty()) out.append("Mod ID: ").append(info.modId()).append('\n');
        if (!info.displayName().isEmpty()) out.append("Name: ").append(info.displayName()).append('\n');
        if (!info.version().isEmpty()) out.append("Version: ").append(info.version()).append('\n');
        if (!info.minecraftVersion().isEmpty()) out.append("Minecraft: ").append(info.minecraftVersion()).append('\n');
        if (!info.javaVersion().isEmpty()) out.append("Java: ").append(info.javaVersion()).append('\n');
        if (!info.mainClass().isEmpty()) out.append("Main: ").append(info.mainClass()).append('\n');
        if (!info.description().isEmpty()) out.append("Description: ").append(info.description()).append('\n');
        if (!info.authors().isEmpty()) out.append("Authors: ").append(String.join(", ", info.authors())).append('\n');
        if (!info.suggestedRunTasks().isEmpty())
            out.append("Tasks: ").append(String.join(", ", info.suggestedRunTasks())).append('\n');
        if (!info.dependencies().isEmpty()) {
            out.append("\nDependencies:\n");
            for (String dep : info.dependencies()) out.append(" - ").append(dep).append('\n');
        }
        if (!info.problems().isEmpty()) {
            out.append("\nProblems:\n");
            for (var problem : info.problems()) {
                out.append(" - [").append(problem.severity()).append("] ").append(problem.message());
                if (!problem.solutions().isEmpty()) out.append(" → ").append(problem.solutions());
                out.append('\n');
            }
        }
        out.append("\nRoot: ").append(info.structure().rootPath()).append('\n');
        return out.toString();
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\minecraft\MinecraftProjectInfo.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

/** Complete Phase-1 analysis of an external Minecraft / Java project. */
public record MinecraftProjectInfo(
        ProjectStructure structure,
        ProjectType projectType,
        MinecraftLoader loader,
        String modId,
        String displayName,
        String version,
        String description,
        List<String> authors,
        String mainClass,
        String minecraftVersion,
        String javaVersion,
        String loaderVersion,
        List<String> dependencies,
        MinecraftGradleAnalysis.GradleSnapshot gradle,
        List<String> suggestedRunTasks,
        List<MinecraftImportProblem> problems,
        MinecraftProjectMetadata metadata
) {
    public MinecraftProjectInfo {
        Objects.requireNonNull(structure);
        Objects.requireNonNull(projectType);
        Objects.requireNonNull(loader);
        modId = Objects.requireNonNullElse(modId, "").trim();
        displayName = Objects.requireNonNullElse(displayName, "").trim();
        version = Objects.requireNonNullElse(version, "").trim();
        description = Objects.requireNonNullElse(description, "").trim();
        authors = authors == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(authors);
        mainClass = Objects.requireNonNullElse(mainClass, "").trim();
        minecraftVersion = Objects.requireNonNullElse(minecraftVersion, "").trim();
        javaVersion = Objects.requireNonNullElse(javaVersion, "").trim();
        loaderVersion = Objects.requireNonNullElse(loaderVersion, "").trim();
        dependencies = dependencies == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(dependencies);
        gradle = gradle == null ? MinecraftGradleAnalysis.GradleSnapshot.empty() : gradle;
        suggestedRunTasks = suggestedRunTasks == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(suggestedRunTasks);
        problems = problems == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(problems);
        metadata = metadata == null
                ? new MinecraftProjectMetadata(loader.name().toLowerCase(), minecraftVersion, javaVersion, modId, mainClass, dependencies)
                : metadata;
    }

    public boolean isMinecraft() {
        return projectType == ProjectType.MINECRAFT_MOD || projectType == ProjectType.MINECRAFT_LIBRARY;
    }

    public String summary() {
        String name = displayName.isEmpty() ? (modId.isEmpty() ? structure.rootPath().getFileName().toString() : modId) : displayName;
        return name + " · " + projectType + " · " + loader + (version.isEmpty() ? "" : " · " + version);
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\minecraft\MinecraftRunTasks.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;

/** Suggests Gradle run/build tasks for Minecraft loaders without executing Gradle. */
public final class MinecraftRunTasks {
    private MinecraftRunTasks() {}

    public static List<String> suggest(ProjectStructure structure, MinecraftLoader loader, MinecraftGradleAnalysis.GradleSnapshot gradle) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(structure);
        Objects.requireNonNull(loader);
        Objects.requireNonNull(gradle);
        Set<String> tasks = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        tasks.add("build");
        for (String declared : gradle.declaredTasks()) {
            String lower = declared.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (lower.contains("runclient") || lower.equals("client") || declared.equals("runClient")) tasks.add(normalize(declared, "runClient"));
            if (lower.contains("runserver") || lower.equals("server") || declared.equals("runServer")) tasks.add(normalize(declared, "runServer"));
            if (lower.contains("gametest") || lower.contains("rungametest")) tasks.add(normalize(declared, "runGameTestServer"));
            if (lower.contains("rundata") || lower.equals("data")) tasks.add(normalize(declared, "runData"));
            if (lower.contains("debug")) tasks.add(declared);
        }
        switch (loader) {
            case NEOFORGE, FORGE -> {
                tasks.add("runClient");
                tasks.add("runServer");
                tasks.add("runGameTestServer");
                tasks.add("runData");
            }
            case FABRIC, QUILT -> {
                tasks.add("runClient");
                tasks.add("runServer");
            }
            case UNKNOWN -> { }
        }
        if (!structure.hasGradle()) return List.of();
        return List.copyOf(new ArrayList<>(tasks));
    }

    private static String normalize(String declared, String canonical) {
        if (declared.equalsIgnoreCase(canonical) || declared.equalsIgnoreCase(canonical.substring(3))) return canonical;
        return declared;
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\minecraft\MinecraftWorkspaceCreator.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.StringWriter;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.LinkOption;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Properties;

/**
 * Writes Genesis `.genesis/` analysis artifacts beside a project without rewriting Gradle.
 */
public final class MinecraftWorkspaceCreator {
    public static final String DIR = ".genesis";

    private MinecraftWorkspaceCreator() {}

    public static Path write(Path projectRoot, MinecraftProjectInfo info, MinecraftImportMode mode, Path linkedSource) throws IOException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(projectRoot);
        Objects.requireNonNull(info);
        Objects.requireNonNull(mode);
        if (!Files.isDirectory(projectRoot, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) || Files.isSymbolicLink(projectRoot))
            throw new IOException("Invalid Genesis workspace root");
        Path genesis = projectRoot.resolve(DIR);
        if (Files.exists(genesis, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) && !Files.isDirectory(genesis, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))
            throw new IOException(".genesis exists and is not a directory");
        Files.createDirectories(genesis);
        if (Files.isSymbolicLink(genesis) || !genesis.toRealPath().startsWith(projectRoot.toRealPath()))
            throw new IOException(".genesis escapes project root");

        atomicWrite(genesis.resolve("project.json"), projectJson(info, mode, linkedSource));
        atomicWrite(genesis.resolve("workspace.json"), workspaceJson(info, mode, linkedSource, projectRoot));
        atomicWrite(genesis.resolve("analysis.json"), analysisJson(info));
        atomicWrite(genesis.resolve("dependencies.json"), dependenciesJson(info));
        return genesis;
    }

    private static String projectJson(MinecraftProjectInfo info, MinecraftImportMode mode, Path linkedSource) {
        return "{\n"
                + "  \"format\": 1,\n"
                + "  \"kind\": \"minecraft\",\n"
                + "  \"projectType\": \"" + esc(info.projectType().name()) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"loader\": \"" + esc(info.loader().name()) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"modId\": \"" + esc(info.modId()) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"displayName\": \"" + esc(info.displayName()) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"version\": \"" + esc(info.version()) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"mainClass\": \"" + esc(info.mainClass()) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"minecraftVersion\": \"" + esc(info.minecraftVersion()) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"javaVersion\": \"" + esc(info.javaVersion()) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"importMode\": \"" + esc(mode.name()) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"linkedSource\": \"" + esc(linkedSource == null ? "" : linkedSource.toString().replace('\\', '/')) + "\"\n"
                + "}\n";
    }

    private static String workspaceJson(MinecraftProjectInfo info, MinecraftImportMode mode, Path linkedSource, Path projectRoot) {
        String sources = join(info.structure().sourceFolders());
        String resources = join(info.structure().resourceFolders());
        String modules = join(info.structure().modules());
        return "{\n"
                + "  \"format\": 1,\n"
                + "  \"root\": \"" + esc(projectRoot.toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString().replace('\\', '/')) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"mode\": \"" + esc(mode.name()) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"workingRoot\": \"" + esc((mode == MinecraftImportMode.LINK && linkedSource != null ? linkedSource : projectRoot).toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString().replace('\\', '/')) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"hasGradle\": " + info.structure().hasGradle() + ",\n"
                + "  \"hasWrapper\": " + info.structure().hasWrapper() + ",\n"
                + "  \"sourceFolders\": [" + sources + "],\n"
                + "  \"resourceFolders\": [" + resources + "],\n"
                + "  \"modules\": [" + modules + "],\n"
                + "  \"suggestedRunTasks\": [" + join(info.suggestedRunTasks()) + "]\n"
                + "}\n";
    }

    private static String analysisJson(MinecraftProjectInfo info) {
        StringBuilder authors = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < info.authors().size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) authors.append(", ");
            authors.append('"').append(esc(info.authors().get(i))).append('"');
        }
        StringBuilder problems = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < info.problems().size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) problems.append(",\n");
            var p = info.problems().get(i);
            problems.append("    {\"code\":\"").append(esc(p.code())).append("\",\"severity\":\"")
                    .append(esc(p.severity().name())).append("\",\"message\":\"").append(esc(p.message())).append("\"}");
        }
        return "{\n"
                + "  \"format\": 1,\n"
                + "  \"summary\": \"" + esc(info.summary()) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"description\": \"" + esc(info.description()) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"authors\": [" + authors + "],\n"
                + "  \"loaderVersion\": \"" + esc(info.loaderVersion()) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"gradleVersion\": \"" + esc(info.gradle().version()) + "\",\n"
                + "  \"plugins\": [" + join(info.gradle().plugins()) + "],\n"
                + "  \"problems\": [\n" + problems + "\n  ]\n"
                + "}\n";
    }

    private static String dependenciesJson(MinecraftProjectInfo info) {
        return "{\n"
                + "  \"format\": 1,\n"
                + "  \"dependencies\": [" + join(info.dependencies()) + "],\n"
                + "  \"repositories\": [" + join(info.gradle().repositories()) + "]\n"
                + "}\n";
    }

    /** Compact properties fragment for genesis-project.properties (caller merges). */
    public static Properties manifestHints(MinecraftProjectInfo info, MinecraftImportMode mode, Path linkedSource) {
        Properties p = new Properties();
        p.setProperty("minecraft_loader", info.loader().name());
        p.setProperty("minecraft_project_type", info.projectType().name());
        if (!info.modId().isEmpty()) p.setProperty("mod_id", info.modId());
        if (!info.mainClass().isEmpty()) p.setProperty("main_class", info.mainClass());
        if (!info.minecraftVersion().isEmpty()) p.setProperty("minecraft_version", info.minecraftVersion());
        p.setProperty("workspace", mode == MinecraftImportMode.LINK ? "linked_minecraft" : "imported_gradle");
        if (mode == MinecraftImportMode.LINK && linkedSource != null)
            p.setProperty("linked_path", linkedSource.toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString());
        if (!info.suggestedRunTasks().isEmpty() && info.suggestedRunTasks().contains("build"))
            p.setProperty("gradle_task", "build");
        return p;
    }

    public static String encodeManifest(Properties base) throws IOException {
        var out = new StringWriter();
        base.store(out, "Genesis Minecraft import metadata");
        return out.toString();
    }

    private static void atomicWrite(Path target, String text) throws IOException {
        byte[] data = text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if (data.length > 256 * 1024) throw new IOException("Genesis workspace file exceeds 256 KiB: " + target.getFileName());
        Path parent = target.getParent();
        Files.createDirectories(parent);
        Path tmp = Files.createTempFile(parent, ".genesis-", ".tmp");
        try {
            Files.write(tmp, data, StandardOpenOption.TRUNCATE_EXISTING);
            Files.move(tmp, target, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
        } finally {
            Files.deleteIfExists(tmp);
        }
    }

    private static String join(java.util.List<String> values) {
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < values.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) out.append(", ");
            out.append('"').append(esc(values.get(i))).append('"');
        }
        return out.toString();
    }

    private static String esc(String value) {
        if (value == null) return "";
        return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"").replace("\r", "\\r").replace("\n", "\\n").replace("\t", "\\t");
    }
}
