===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\runtime\ExecutionScope.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.runtime;

import java.util.EnumMap;
import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;

/** Bounded ownership of a run's resources. Callbacks never execute under the scope lock. */
public final class ExecutionScope implements AutoCloseable {
    public enum Kind { EXECUTOR, EVENT, TIMER, BIND, BLOCK, ACTION }
    public record Snapshot(boolean cancelled, Map<Kind,Integer> counts, Throwable failure) {
        public int count(Kind kind) { return counts.getOrDefault(kind,0); }
        public int resources() { return counts.values().stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sum(); }
    }
    public final class Lease implements AutoCloseable {
        private final Kind kind;
        private final Runnable cancel;
        private boolean active=true, notified;
        private Lease(Kind kind, Runnable cancel) { this.kind=kind; this.cancel=cancel; }
        public boolean active() { synchronized(ExecutionScope.this){return active;} }
        @Override public void close() { synchronized(ExecutionScope.this){active=false;if(leases.remove(this)!=null){counts.computeIfPresent(kind,(k,n)->n==1?null:n-1);}} }
        private void notifyCancellation() {
            synchronized(ExecutionScope.this) {
                if (!active || notified) return;
                notified=true;
            }
            try { cancel.run(); }
            catch (Throwable error) { recordFailure(error); close(); }
            finally { if(kind!=Kind.EXECUTOR)close(); }
        }
    }
    private final Map<Lease,Boolean> leases=new IdentityHashMap<>();
    private final EnumMap<Kind,Integer> counts=new EnumMap<>(Kind.class);
    private final int limit;
    private volatile boolean cancelled;
    private volatile Throwable failure;
    public ExecutionScope(){this(1024);}
    public ExecutionScope(int limit){if(limit<1)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Resource limit must be positive");this.limit=limit;}
    public boolean cancelled(){return cancelled;}
    public Lease own(Kind kind, Runnable cancel) {
        Lease lease=new Lease(Objects.requireNonNull(kind),Objects.requireNonNull(cancel));
        boolean stopped;
        synchronized(this){
            stopped=cancelled;
            if(!stopped){
                if(leases.size()>=limit)throw new IllegalStateException("Run resource limit exceeded: "+limit);
                leases.put(lease,Boolean.TRUE);counts.merge(kind,1,Integer::sum);
            }
        }
        if(stopped){lease.notifyCancellation();lease.close();}
        return lease;
    }
    private synchronized void recordFailure(Throwable error){if(failure==null)failure=Objects.requireNonNull(error);}
    public void fail(Throwable error){recordFailure(error);close();}
    @Override public void close(){
        List<Lease> owned;
        synchronized(this){if(cancelled)return;cancelled=true;owned=List.copyOf(leases.keySet());}
        for(Lease lease:owned)lease.notifyCancellation();
    }
    public synchronized Snapshot snapshot(){
        return new Snapshot(cancelled,Map.copyOf(counts),failure);
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\runtime\FrameExecutor.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.runtime;

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.List;



/**
 * Executor стека кадров.
 *
 * Один tick = одна порция работы. Внутри tick'а мы можем выполнить
 * ограниченную ExecutionLimits порцию работы, затем отдаём управление.
 */
public class FrameExecutor {

    private final com.fixmer.genesis.technology.runtime.ExecutionLimits limits;
    private static final int FRAME_POOL_SIZE = 16;
    private static final Instruction[] EMPTY = new Instruction[0];

    // ============================================================
    //  Frame
    // ============================================================

    public static final class Frame {
        public Instruction[] commands = EMPTY;
        public int index = 0;
        public int waitTicks = 0;
        public boolean loopBody = false;
        public LoopOwner loopOwner = null;
        public boolean breakRequested = false;
        public boolean continueRequested = false;
        public boolean functionCall = false;
        public int retryIndex = -1;
        public int retryTicks;

        boolean finished() { return index >= commands.length; }

        void reset() {
            commands = EMPTY;
            index = 0;
            waitTicks = 0;
            loopBody = false;
            loopOwner = null;
            breakRequested = false;
            continueRequested = false;
            functionCall = false;
            retryIndex = -1;
            retryTicks = 0;
        }
    }

    public interface LoopOwner {
        boolean onBodyFinished(FrameExecutor exec, Frame bodyFrame);
        String describe();
        default void onDiscard() {}
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  State
    // ============================================================

    private final ExecutionScope scope;
    private final Deque<Frame> stack = new ArrayDeque<>(16);
    private final Deque<Frame> pool = new ArrayDeque<>(FRAME_POOL_SIZE);
    public interface Instruction { void execute(FrameExecutor executor) throws Exception; default int getDelayTicks(){return 0;} default String describe(){return getClass().getSimpleName();} }
    protected void trace(String kind,Object value) {}

    private boolean debuggerPaused = false;
    private boolean singleStep;

    private volatile boolean finished = false;
    private boolean yielded;
    private long totalSteps;
    private volatile Throwable failure;
    private volatile boolean stopRequested;
    private com.fixmer.genesis.technology.runtime.ExecutionScope.Lease ownership;
    public record Snapshot(boolean finished, boolean waiting, boolean paused, long steps, int depth, Throwable failure) {}
    private volatile Snapshot snapshot = new Snapshot(false, false, false, 0, 0, null);
    public Snapshot snapshot() { return snapshot; }
    /** Nonblocking request; stack cleanup runs on the executor's next owner tick. */
    public void requestStop() { stopRequested = true; }
    public synchronized void fail(Throwable error) { failure = error; stopAll(); }
    public Throwable failure() { return failure; }
    private boolean aborted = false;
    private Object returnValue = null;
    private boolean hasReturnValue = false;

    public FrameExecutor(List<Instruction> commands,ExecutionLimits limits,ExecutionScope scope){
        this(limits,scope);initialize(commands);
    }
    protected FrameExecutor(ExecutionLimits limits,ExecutionScope scope){this.limits=java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(limits);this.scope=scope;}
    protected final void initialize(List<Instruction> commands){
        if(commands!=null&&!commands.isEmpty())stack.push(borrowFrame(toArray(commands)));else finished=true;
        publishSnapshot();
        if(!finished&&scope!=null)ownership=scope.own(ExecutionScope.Kind.EXECUTOR,this::requestStop);
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  Frame pool
    // ============================================================

    private Frame borrowFrame(Instruction[] commands) {
        if (stack.size() >= limits.stackDepth()) throw new IllegalStateException("Script stack limit exceeded");
        Frame f = pool.pollFirst();
        if (f == null) f = new Frame();
        f.commands = commands;
        return f;
    }

    private void releaseFrame(Frame f) {
        if (f == null) return;
        f.reset();
        if (pool.size() < FRAME_POOL_SIZE) pool.addLast(f);
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  Public API
    // ============================================================

    public boolean isFinished() { return finished; }
    public boolean isStackEmpty() { return stack.isEmpty(); }

    public boolean isWaiting() {
        Frame top = stack.peek();
        return top != null && (top.waitTicks > 0 || yielded);
    }

    public Frame peekTopFrame() { return stack.peek(); }

    public int getStackDepth() { return stack.size(); }

    public Frame pushInstructions(List<Instruction> body) {
        Frame f = borrowFrame(toArray(body));
        stack.push(f);
        return f;
    }

    public Frame pushLoopInstructions(List<Instruction> body, LoopOwner owner) {
        Frame f = borrowFrame(toArray(body));
        f.loopBody = true;
        f.loopOwner = owner;
        stack.push(f);
        return f;
    }

    public Frame pushFunctionInstructions(List<Instruction> body, LoopOwner owner) {
        Frame f = borrowFrame(toArray(body));
        f.loopOwner = owner;
        f.functionCall = true;
        stack.push(f);
        return f;
    }

    public Frame findEnclosingLoop() {
        for (Frame f : stack) {
            if (f.functionCall) return null;
            if (f.loopBody) return f;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public Frame findEnclosingFunction() {
        for (Frame f : stack) {
            if (f.functionCall) return f;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public void abortFramesUpTo(Frame target) {
        while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            Frame top = stack.peek();
            if (top == target) {
                top.index = top.commands.length;
                return;
            }
            stack.pop();
            discardFrame(top);
        }
    }

    public void abortToFunction(Frame fnFrame) {
        while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            Frame top = stack.peek();
            if (top == fnFrame) {
                top.index = top.commands.length;
                return;
            }
            stack.pop();
            discardFrame(top);
        }
    }

    public void setReturnValue(Object value) {
        this.returnValue = value;
        this.hasReturnValue = true;
    }

    public Object getReturnValue() { return returnValue; }
    public boolean hasReturnValue() { return hasReturnValue; }

    public void clearReturnValue() {
        this.returnValue = null;
        this.hasReturnValue = false;
    }

    public void resumeFromDebugger() {
        debuggerPaused = false;
    }

    public void pauseFromDebugger() {
        debuggerPaused = true;
    }

    public void stepOverDebugger() {
        debuggerPaused = false;
        singleStep=true;
        try { tick(); } finally { singleStep=false;debuggerPaused=true;publishSnapshot(); }
    }

    private void discardFrame(Frame f) {
        try { if (f.loopOwner != null) f.loopOwner.onDiscard(); }
        finally { releaseFrame(f); }
    }

    public synchronized void stopAll() {
        aborted = true;
        try {
            while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                try { discardFrame(stack.pop()); }
                catch (RuntimeException error) { if (failure == null) failure = error; }
            }
        } finally {
            finished = true;
            publishSnapshot();
        }
    }

    private void publishSnapshot() {
        if (finished && ownership != null) ownership.close();
        if (failure != null && scope != null) scope.fail(failure);
        Frame top = stack.peek();
        snapshot = new Snapshot(finished, !finished && (yielded || top != null && top.waitTicks > 0),
            debuggerPaused, totalSteps, stack.size(), failure);
    }

    public void pauseCurrent(int ticks) {
        Frame top = stack.peek();
        if (top != null) top.waitTicks = ticks;
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  Tick
    // ============================================================

    /** Re-execute the current instruction on a later tick; state belongs to this frame. */
    public int retryCurrentInstruction() {
        Frame f = stack.peek();
        if (f == null || f.index == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("No active instruction");
        int instruction = f.index - 1;
        if (f.retryIndex != instruction) { f.retryIndex = instruction; f.retryTicks = 0; }
        f.index = instruction;
        yielded = true;
        return ++f.retryTicks;
    }

    public void completeRetry() {
        Frame f = stack.peek();
        if (f != null) { f.retryIndex = -1; f.retryTicks = 0; }
    }

    public synchronized void tick() {
        try {
            if (stopRequested && !finished) stopAll();
            tickInternal();
        } finally { publishSnapshot(); }
    }

    private void tickInternal() {
        if (finished) return;

        if (debuggerPaused) return;

        yielded = false;
        int steps = 0;
        long started = System.nanoTime();

        while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            if (stopRequested) { stopAll(); return; }
            Frame f = stack.peek();

            if (f.waitTicks > 0) {
                f.waitTicks--;
                if (f.waitTicks == 0) trace("pause_done",null);
                return;
            }

            // Completing a plain frame requires no script instruction or host callback.
            // Let a finite one-command expression finish even if its host call consumed the budget.
            if (f.index >= f.commands.length && f.loopOwner == null) {
                stack.pop(); releaseFrame(f); continue;
            }

            if (steps >= (singleStep?1:limits.stepsPerTick()) || (steps > 0 && System.nanoTime() - started >= limits.nanosPerTick())) return;
            steps++;
            if (++totalSteps > limits.totalSteps()) {
                failure = new IllegalStateException("Script instruction limit exceeded");
                trace("error",failure);
                stopAll(); return;
            }

            if (f.index >= f.commands.length) {
                stack.pop();
                if (f.loopOwner != null) {
                    boolean repeat;
                    try { repeat = f.loopOwner.onBodyFinished(this, f); }
                    catch (Exception error) {
                        failure = error;
                        try { discardFrame(f); } catch(RuntimeException cleanup){if(cleanup!=error)error.addSuppressed(cleanup);}
                        stopAll();
                        trace("error",error); return;
                    }
                    releaseFrame(f);

                    if (repeat) {
                        continue;
                    }
                } else {
                    releaseFrame(f);
                }
                continue;
            }

            Instruction cmd = f.commands[f.index];
            f.index++;

            trace("command",cmd.describe());

            try {
                cmd.execute(this);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                failure = e;
                trace("error",e);
                stopAll();
                return;
            }

            if (finished || yielded) return;

            int delay = cmd.getDelayTicks();
            if (delay > 0) {
                f.waitTicks = delay;
                trace("pause",delay);
                return;
            }

            if (f.breakRequested || f.continueRequested) return;
        }

        if (stack.isEmpty()) {
            trace(aborted?"aborted":"all_done",null);
            finished = true;
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  Util
    // ============================================================

    static Instruction[] toArray(List<Instruction> list) {
        if (list == null || list.isEmpty()) return EMPTY;
        int n = list.size();
        Instruction[] arr = new Instruction[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) arr[i] = list.get(i);
        return arr;
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\runtime\OwnedActions.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.runtime;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

/** Thread-safe bounded claims and pending host actions. Host effects run only in drain's caller thread. */
public final class OwnedActions<K,T> {
    private static final Object LEGACY=new Object();
    private final int limit;
    private final Map<Object,Map<K,Claim>> claims=new IdentityHashMap<>();
    private final ArrayDeque<Pending> pending=new ArrayDeque<>();
    private int held;
    private final class Claim { final Object owner; final K key; ExecutionScope.Lease lease; Claim(Object owner,K key){this.owner=owner;this.key=key;} }
    private final class Pending { final ExecutionScope owner; final T value; ExecutionScope.Lease lease; Pending(ExecutionScope owner,T value){this.owner=owner;this.value=value;} }
    public OwnedActions(int limit){if(limit<1)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Positive limit required");this.limit=limit;}
    private Object owner(ExecutionScope scope){return scope==null?LEGACY:scope;}
    public synchronized void press(ExecutionScope scope,K key){
        Objects.requireNonNull(key);if(scope!=null&&scope.cancelled())return;
        Object owner=owner(scope);var mine=claims.get(owner);if(mine!=null&&mine.containsKey(key))return;
        if(held+pending.size()>=limit)throw new IllegalStateException("Action limit exceeded");
        if(mine==null){mine=new HashMap<>();claims.put(owner,mine);}
        Claim claim=new Claim(owner,key);mine.put(key,claim);held++;
        try {if(scope!=null)claim.lease=scope.own(ExecutionScope.Kind.ACTION,()->remove(claim));}
        catch(RuntimeException error){remove(claim);throw error;}
    }
    private synchronized void remove(Claim claim){
        var mine=claims.get(claim.owner);
        if(mine!=null&&mine.remove(claim.key,claim)){held--;if(mine.isEmpty())claims.remove(claim.owner);}
        if(claim.lease!=null)claim.lease.close();
    }
    public synchronized void release(ExecutionScope scope,K key){var mine=claims.get(owner(scope));if(mine!=null){var claim=mine.get(key);if(claim!=null)remove(claim);}}
    public synchronized boolean pressed(ExecutionScope scope,K key){var mine=claims.get(owner(scope));return mine!=null&&mine.containsKey(key);}
    public synchronized Set<K> activeKeys(){var result=new HashSet<K>();for(var mine:claims.values())result.addAll(mine.keySet());return Set.copyOf(result);}
    public synchronized void enqueue(ExecutionScope scope,T value){
        Objects.requireNonNull(value);if(scope!=null&&scope.cancelled())return;
        if(held+pending.size()>=limit)throw new IllegalStateException("Action limit exceeded");
        Pending item=new Pending(scope,value);pending.addLast(item);
        try{if(scope!=null)item.lease=scope.own(ExecutionScope.Kind.ACTION,()->remove(item));}
        catch(RuntimeException error){remove(item);throw error;}
    }
    private synchronized void remove(Pending item){pending.remove(item);if(item.lease!=null)item.lease.close();}
    public void drain(int budget,Consumer<T> host){
        Objects.requireNonNull(host);
        for(int i=0;i<budget;i++){
            Pending item;synchronized(this){item=pending.pollFirst();}
            if(item==null)return;
            try{if(item.owner==null||!item.owner.cancelled())host.accept(item.value);}
            catch(RuntimeException error){if(item.owner!=null)item.owner.fail(error);else throw error;}
            finally{if(item.lease!=null)item.lease.close();}
        }
    }
    public synchronized void stop(ExecutionScope scope){
        var mine=claims.get(owner(scope));if(mine!=null)for(Claim claim:List.copyOf(mine.values()))remove(claim);
        for(Pending item:List.copyOf(pending))if(item.owner==scope)remove(item);
    }
    public synchronized void stopAll(){for(var mine:List.copyOf(claims.values()))for(Claim claim:List.copyOf(mine.values()))remove(claim);for(Pending item:List.copyOf(pending))remove(item);}
    public synchronized int pendingCount(){return pending.size();}
}

    }
    private static MessageDigest digest(){try{return MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");}catch(NoSuchAlgorithmException impossible){throw new IllegalStateException(impossible);}}
    private static Artifact fingerprint(Path root,Path file,BooleanSupplier cancelled)throws IOException{return fingerprint(root,file,cancelled,MAX_FILE_BYTES);}
    private static Artifact fingerprint(Path root,Path file,BooleanSupplier cancelled,long budget)throws IOException{

            }

            @Override public FileVisitResult visitFileFailed(Path file,IOException error)throws IOException{if(!visit())return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE;issue(root.relativize(file)+": "+error.getMessage());return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;}
        }

    }
    public static Path deliver(Path project,Artifact expected,Path destination,BooleanSupplier cancelled)throws IOException{
        Path root=project.toAbsolutePath().normalize(),exports=destination.toAbsolutePath().normalize();Objects.requireNonNull(expected);Objects.requireNonNull(cancelled);stop(cancelled);

        for(Path p=exports;p!=null;p=p.getParent())if(Files.isSymbolicLink(p))throw fail("Linked delivery folder is not supported");

        }finally{if(!published){if(part!=null)try{Files.deleteIfExists(part);}catch(IOException ignored){}try{Files.deleteIfExists(folder);}catch(IOException ignored){}}}
    }

package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.ProjectPath;
import java.net.URI;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.*;

/** Bounded, side-effect-free interpretation of compiler/Gradle output, not a build executor. */
public final class BuildDiagnostics {
    public enum Severity { ERROR, WARNING }
    public record Diagnostic(Severity severity,String file,int line,int column,String message,String raw){
        public Diagnostic{
            Objects.requireNonNull(severity);Objects.requireNonNull(file);Objects.requireNonNull(message);Objects.requireNonNull(raw);
            if(!file.isEmpty()&&(!ProjectPath.valid(file)||line<1||column<0)||file.isEmpty()&&(line!=0||column!=0))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid diagnostic position");
        }
    }
    public record Report(List<Diagnostic> diagnostics,boolean limited){public Report{diagnostics=List.copyOf(diagnostics);}}
    public static final int MAX_DIAGNOSTICS=200,MAX_OUTPUT=256*1024,MAX_LINE=4096;
    private static final Pattern ANSI=Pattern.compile("\\x1B\\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]");
    private static final Pattern JAVAC=Pattern.compile("^(.+?):([0-9]+)(?::([0-9]+))?:\\s*(error|warning|ошибка|предупреждение):\\s*(.*)$",Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE|Pattern.UNICODE_CASE);
    private static final Pattern GRADLE=Pattern.compile("^(?:Build file|Settings file|Script|Initialization script) ['\"](.+?)['\"] line: ([0-9]+).*$");
    private BuildDiagnostics(){}
    public static Report parse(String output,Path project){return parse(output,Objects.requireNonNull(project).toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString());}
    /** String root allows consumers to inspect Windows build output on another OS. */
    public static Report parse(String output,String projectDirectory){
        Objects.requireNonNull(output);Objects.requireNonNull(projectDirectory);boolean limited=output.length()>MAX_OUTPUT;
        if(limited)output=output.substring(output.length()-MAX_OUTPUT);var found=new LinkedHashSet<Diagnostic>();
        for(String raw:output.split("\\R",-1)){
            if(raw.length()>MAX_LINE){limited=true;continue;}String text=ANSI.matcher(raw).replaceAll("").strip();if(text.isEmpty())continue;
            Diagnostic diagnostic=null;Matcher javac=JAVAC.matcher(text),gradle=GRADLE.matcher(text);
            if(javac.matches()){
                int line=number(javac.group(2)),column=javac.group(3)==null?0:number(javac.group(3));String file=relative(javac.group(1),projectDirectory);
                if(line<1||column<0)file="";String type=javac.group(4).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);Severity severity=type.equals("warning")||type.equals("предупреждение")?Severity.WARNING:Severity.ERROR;
                diagnostic=new Diagnostic(severity,file,file.isEmpty()?0:line,file.isEmpty()?0:column,javac.group(5),text);
            }else if(gradle.matches()){
                int line=number(gradle.group(2));String file=relative(gradle.group(1),projectDirectory);if(line<1)file="";
                diagnostic=new Diagnostic(Severity.ERROR,file,file.isEmpty()?0:line,0,text,text);
            }else if(text.startsWith("Execution failed for task ")||text.startsWith("FAILURE: Build failed")||text.startsWith("> Could not resolve ")||text.startsWith("> Could not find ")){
                diagnostic=new Diagnostic(Severity.ERROR,"",0,0,text,text);
            }
            if(diagnostic!=null){if(found.contains(diagnostic))continue;if(found.size()==MAX_DIAGNOSTICS){limited=true;break;}found.add(diagnostic);}
        }
        return new Report(new ArrayList<>(found),limited);
    }
    private static int number(String value){try{int n=Integer.parseInt(value);return n>=0&&n<=10_000_000?n:-1;}catch(NumberFormatException invalid){return -1;}}
    private static String relative(String value,String root){
        value=value.strip();if(value.startsWith("file:"))try{URI uri=URI.create(value);if(uri.getAuthority()!=null&&!uri.getAuthority().isEmpty())return "";value=uri.getPath();if(value==null)return "";if(value.matches("^/[A-Za-z]:/.*"))value=value.substring(1);}catch(IllegalArgumentException invalid){return "";}
        value=value.replace('\\','/');root=root.replace('\\','/');while(root.endsWith("/")&&root.length()>1)root=root.substring(0,root.length()-1);
        boolean absolute=value.startsWith("/")||value.matches("^[A-Za-z]:/.*"),windows=root.matches("^[A-Za-z]:/.*")||root.startsWith("//");
        if(absolute){String prefix=root.endsWith("/")?root:root+"/";boolean inside=windows?value.regionMatches(true,0,prefix,0,prefix.length()):value.startsWith(prefix);if(!inside)return "";value=value.substring(prefix.length());}
        else if(value.startsWith("./"))value=value.substring(2);
        return ProjectPath.valid(value)&&GradleProjectImport.editable(value)?value:"";
    }
}

package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.file.attribute.*;
import java.security.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
/** Reproducible project input identity; output/cache/world folders do not count as sources. */
public final class BuildInputs  {
    private BuildInputs() {
    }
    private static final Set<String> OUTPUTS=Set.of("build","out","run","runs",".git",".gradle",".idea",".genesis-build",".genesis-gradle-cache",".genesis-recovery",".artifacts",".exports");
    public record Snapshot(Map<String,String> files) {
        public Snapshot {
            files=Map.copyOf(files);
        }
        public String fingerprint(Collection<String> excludes) {
            var hash=digest();
            for(var e:new TreeMap<>(files).entrySet()) {
                if(excludes.stream().anyMatch(p->e.getKey().equals(p)||e.getKey().startsWith(p+"/")))continue;
                hash.update(e.getKey().getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                hash.update((byte)0);
                hash.update(e.getValue().getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.US_ASCII));
                hash.update((byte)10);
            }
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(hash.digest());
        }
    }
    public static String capture(Path project,BooleanSupplier cancel)throws IOException {
        return snapshot(project,cancel).fingerprint(List.of());
    }
    public static String capture(Path project,BooleanSupplier cancel,Collection<String> excludes)throws IOException {
        return snapshot(project,cancel).fingerprint(excludes);
    }
    public static Snapshot snapshot(Path project,BooleanSupplier cancel)throws IOException {
        Path root=project.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        var files=new TreeMap<String,String>();
        long[] bytes= {
            0
        };
        int[] entries= {
            0
        };
        Files.walkFileTree(root,new SimpleFileVisitor<Path>() {
            void stop()throws IOException {
                if(cancel.getAsBoolean()||Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted())throw new IOException("Build input inspection cancelled");if(++entries[0]>50000)throw new IOException("Build input entry limit: 50000");
            }
            public FileVisitResult preVisitDirectory(Path p,BasicFileAttributes a)throws IOException {
                stop();if(!p.equals(root)&&OUTPUTS.contains(p.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)))return FileVisitResult.SKIP_SUBTREE;if(Files.isSymbolicLink(p)||!p.toRealPath().startsWith(root.toRealPath()))throw new IOException("Linked build input: "+p);return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
            }
            public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path p,BasicFileAttributes a)throws IOException {
                stop();if(p.getFileName().toString().equals(DependencyJournal.NAME))return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;if(!a.isRegularFile()||a.isSymbolicLink())throw new IOException("Non-regular build input: "+p);if((bytes[0]+=a.size())>1024L*1024*1024)throw new IOException("Build input byte limit: 1 GiB");var hash=digest();long count=0;try(var in=Files.newInputStream(p,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
                    byte[] b=new byte[65536];int n;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1) {
                        if(cancel.getAsBoolean())throw new IOException("Build input inspection cancelled");count+=n;if(count>a.size())throw new IOException("Build input changed: "+p);hash.update(b,0,n);
                    }
                }
                var after=Files.readAttributes(p,BasicFileAttributes.class,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);if(count!=a.size()||!after.isRegularFile()||!Objects.equals(a.fileKey(),after.fileKey())||!a.lastModifiedTime().equals(after.lastModifiedTime()))throw new IOException("Build input changed: "+p);files.put(root.relativize(p).toString().replace('\\','/'),HexFormat.of().formatHex(hash.digest()));return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
            }
        });
        return new Snapshot(files);
    }
    private static MessageDigest digest() {
        try {
            return MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
        }
        catch(NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(e);
        }
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\scripts\BuildTools.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.StringReader;
import java.net.URI;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.charset.CodingErrorAction;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Properties;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.jar.JarFile;

/** Static local tool inspection. Does not launch executables, download Gradle or load JAR classes. */
public final class BuildTools {
    private static final int MAX_PROPERTIES_BYTES = 16 * 1024;
    private static final long MAX_WRAPPER_BYTES = 8L * 1024 * 1024;

    private BuildTools() {}

    public record Settings(Path javaHome, Path wrapperJar) {
        public Settings {
            Objects.requireNonNull(javaHome);
            Objects.requireNonNull(wrapperJar);
            if (!javaHome.isAbsolute() || !wrapperJar.isAbsolute())
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Build tool paths must be absolute");
            javaHome = javaHome.normalize();
            wrapperJar = wrapperJar.normalize();
        }
    }

    /** Accept copied Explorer paths (quoted paths included); no shell expansion. */
    public static String cleanPath(String value) {
        if(value==null)return "";
        value=value.trim();
        if(value.length()>=2 && value.startsWith("\"") && value.endsWith("\""))value=value.substring(1,value.length()-1);
        return value;
    }
    public static Path javaHome(String value) throws IOException {
        value=cleanPath(value);
        if(!validAbsolutePath(value))throw new IOException("JDK: use an absolute local path to a full JDK 21 or newer");
        Path home=Path.of(value).normalize();String leaf=home.getFileName()==null?"":home.getFileName().toString();
        if(Set.of("java","java.exe","javac","javac.exe").contains(leaf.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)))home=home.getParent();
        if(home!=null && home.getFileName()!=null && home.getFileName().toString().equalsIgnoreCase("bin"))home=home.getParent();
        validateJavaHome(home);return home;
    }
    public static Path wrapperJar(String value) throws IOException {
        value=cleanPath(value);
        if(!validAbsolutePath(value))throw new IOException("Gradle: select gradle-wrapper.jar or its project folder");
        Path jar=Path.of(value).normalize();
        if(Files.isDirectory(jar)) {
            Path nested=jar.resolve("gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar");
            jar=(Files.exists(nested,java.nio.file.LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)||Files.exists(nested.resolveSibling("gradle-wrapper.properties"),java.nio.file.LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))?nested:jar.resolve("gradle-wrapper.jar");
        } else if(jar.getFileName()!=null && jar.getFileName().toString().equalsIgnoreCase("gradle-wrapper.properties"))jar=jar.resolveSibling("gradle-wrapper.jar");
        validateWrapper(jar);return jar;
    }
    public static boolean validAbsolutePath(String value) {
        try {
            value=cleanPath(value);return !value.isBlank() && value.length() <= 2048 && value.chars().noneMatch(c->c<32) && Path.of(value).isAbsolute();
        } catch (RuntimeException invalid) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** A multi-project root may contain settings only and build files in its subprojects. */
    public static boolean gradleRoot(Path directory){
        for(String name:java.util.List.of("build.gradle","build.gradle.kts","settings.gradle","settings.gradle.kts"))
            if(Files.isRegularFile(directory.resolve(name),java.nio.file.LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))return true;
        return false;
    }
    public static void validate(Settings settings) throws IOException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(settings);
        validateJavaHome(settings.javaHome());
        validateWrapper(settings.wrapperJar());
    }

    public static int javaFeature(Path home)throws IOException{var value=properties(home.resolve("release")).getProperty("JAVA_VERSION","");var m=java.util.regex.Pattern.compile("\"?(\\d+).*?").matcher(value);if(!m.matches())throw new IOException("Invalid JDK version");try{return Integer.parseInt(m.group(1));}catch(NumberFormatException e){throw new IOException("Invalid JDK version",e);}}
    public static void validateCompilerForHost(Path home)throws IOException{int host=Runtime.version().feature(),compiler=javaFeature(home);if(compiler<host)throw new IOException("Selected compiler JDK "+compiler+" cannot compile for running JVM "+host+"; choose JDK "+host+" or newer (target remains host-compatible)");}
    public static void validateJavaHome(Path home) throws IOException {
        requireAbsolute(home);
        String extension = System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("win") ? ".exe" : "";
        for (String name : new String[]{"java", "javac"}) {
            Path executable = home.resolve("bin").resolve(name + extension);
            if (!Files.isRegularFile(executable) || !Files.isExecutable(executable))
                throw new IOException("Full JDK required: missing executable " + executable);
        }
        String version = properties(home.resolve("release")).getProperty("JAVA_VERSION", "");
        var matcher = java.util.regex.Pattern.compile("\"?(\\d+)(?:[.\\-+][^\"\\r\\n]*)?\"?").matcher(version);
        try {
            if (!matcher.matches() || Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(1)) < 21)
                throw new IOException("JDK 21 or newer required; JAVA_VERSION=" + version);
        } catch (NumberFormatException invalid) {
            throw new IOException("Invalid JDK release version", invalid);
        }
    }

    public static void validateWrapper(Path jar) throws IOException {
        requireAbsolute(jar);
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(jar) || Files.size(jar) > MAX_WRAPPER_BYTES)
            throw new IOException("Gradle Wrapper JAR is missing or exceeds 8 MiB: " + jar + ". Select gradle-wrapper.jar, not gradlew.bat; gradle-wrapper.properties must be beside it");
        try (var archive = new JarFile(jar.toFile(), false)) {
            var main = archive.getJarEntry("org/gradle/wrapper/GradleWrapperMain.class");
            if (main == null || main.isDirectory())
                throw new IOException("Selected JAR does not contain GradleWrapperMain");
        }
        Properties props = properties(jar.resolveSibling("gradle-wrapper.properties"));
        String distribution = props.getProperty("distributionUrl", "");
        try {
            URI uri = URI.create(distribution);
            String scheme = uri.getScheme();
            if (!uri.isAbsolute() || scheme == null || !Set.of("https", "http", "file").contains(scheme.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))
                    || !scheme.equalsIgnoreCase("file") && (uri.getHost() == null || uri.getHost().isBlank())
                    || uri.getPath() == null || uri.getPath().isBlank())
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected absolute distribution URL");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException invalid) {
            throw new IOException("Invalid or missing distributionUrl in gradle-wrapper.properties", invalid);
        }
        String checksum = props.getProperty("distributionSha256Sum");
        if (checksum != null && !checksum.matches("[0-9a-fA-F]{64}"))
            throw new IOException("distributionSha256Sum must contain 64 hexadecimal characters");
    }

    private static void requireAbsolute(Path path) throws IOException {
        if (path == null || !validAbsolutePath(path.toString()))
            throw new IOException("Use an absolute local path");
    }

    private static Properties properties(Path file) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(file)) throw new IOException("Missing tool properties: " + file);
        byte[] data;
        try (var input = Files.newInputStream(file)) {
            data = input.readNBytes(MAX_PROPERTIES_BYTES + 1);
        }
        if (data.length > MAX_PROPERTIES_BYTES) throw new IOException("Tool properties exceed 16 KiB: " + file);
        var decoder = StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newDecoder().onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT).onUnmappableCharacter(CodingErrorAction.REPORT);
        var result = new Properties(){@Override public synchronized Object put(Object key,Object value){
            if(containsKey(key))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate tool property: "+key);return super.put(key,value);
        }};
        try {
            result.load(new StringReader(decoder.decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(data)).toString()));
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException invalid) {
            throw new IOException("Malformed tool properties: " + file, invalid);
        }
        return result;
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\scripts\DependencyJournal.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.channels.FileChannel;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
/** Durable bounded intent log for the four owned dependency files. */
final class DependencyJournal  {
    static final String NAME=".genesis-dependency-update";
    private DependencyJournal() {
    }
    static Path path(Path root)throws IOException {
        Path p=root.resolve(NAME);
        for(Path a=p;a!=null;a=a.getParent())if(Files.isSymbolicLink(a))throw new IOException("Linked dependency journal");
        return p;
    }
    static final class Transaction implements AutoCloseable {
        final FileChannel channel;
        final java.nio.channels.FileLock lock;
        Transaction(FileChannel c,java.nio.channels.FileLock l) {
            channel=c;
            lock=l;
        }
        public void close()throws IOException {
            try {
                lock.close();
            }
            finally {
                channel.close();
            }
        }
    }
    static Transaction acquire(Path root)throws IOException {
        Path dir=root.resolve(".genesis-build");
        if(Files.isSymbolicLink(dir))throw new IOException("Linked dependency lock directory");
        Files.createDirectories(dir);
        if(!dir.toRealPath().startsWith(root.toRealPath()))throw new IOException("Dependency lock directory escapes project");
        Path file=dir.resolve("dependencies.lock");
        var channel=FileChannel.open(file,StandardOpenOption.CREATE,StandardOpenOption.WRITE,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
        try {
            var lock=channel.tryLock();
            if(lock==null)throw new IOException("Another process is updating dependencies");
            return new Transaction(channel,lock);
        }
        catch(java.nio.channels.OverlappingFileLockException busy) {
            channel.close();
            throw new IOException("Another editor is updating dependencies",busy);
        }
        catch(IOException|RuntimeException bad) {
            channel.close();
            throw bad;
        }
    }
    static Transaction start(Path root,Map<String,byte[]> before,Map<String,byte[]> after)throws IOException {
        var transaction=acquire(root);
        try {
            Path file=path(root);
            if(Files.exists(file,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))throw new IOException("Unrecovered dependency transaction");
            var data=new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            try(var out=new DataOutputStream(data)) {
                out.writeInt(0x47445431);
                out.writeInt(after.size());
                for(var e:after.entrySet()) {
                    out.writeUTF(e.getKey());
                    bytes(out,before.get(e.getKey()));
                    bytes(out,e.getValue());
                }
            }
            Path pending=Files.createTempFile(root,".dependency-journal-",".tmp");
            try {
                Files.write(pending,data.toByteArray());
                try(var channel=FileChannel.open(pending,StandardOpenOption.WRITE)) {
                    channel.force(true);
                }
                Files.move(pending,file,StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
            }
            finally {
                Files.deleteIfExists(pending);
            }
            return transaction;
        }
        catch(IOException|RuntimeException failure) {
            transaction.close();
            throw failure;
        }
    }
    static void bytes(DataOutputStream out,byte[] bytes)throws IOException {
        out.writeInt(bytes==null?-1:bytes.length);
        if(bytes!=null)out.write(bytes);
    }
    static byte[] bytes(DataInputStream in)throws IOException {
        int size=in.readInt();
        if(size==-1)return null;
        if(size<0||size>SourceProjects.MAX_BYTES)throw new IOException("Dependency journal file limit");
        byte[] b=in.readNBytes(size);
        if(b.length!=size)throw new EOFException("Truncated dependency journal");
        return b;
    }
    static void recover(Path root)throws IOException {
        if(!Files.exists(path(root),LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))return;
        try(var lock=acquire(root)) {
            recoverOwned(root);
        }
    }
    static void recoverOwned(Path root)throws IOException {
        Path journal=path(root);
        if(!Files.exists(journal,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))return;
        if(Files.size(journal)>40L*1024*1024)throw new IOException("Dependency journal limit");
        var before=new LinkedHashMap<String,byte[]>();
        var after=new LinkedHashMap<String,byte[]>();
        try(var in=new DataInputStream(Files.newInputStream(journal,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))) {
            if(in.readInt()!=0x47445431)throw new IOException("Invalid dependency journal");
            int count=in.readInt();
            if(count<1||count>4)throw new IOException("Invalid dependency journal count");
            for(int i=0;i<count;i++) {
                String name=in.readUTF();
                if(!ProjectDependencies.FILES.contains(name)||after.containsKey(name))throw new IOException("Invalid dependency journal path");
                before.put(name,bytes(in));
                byte[] next=bytes(in);
                if(next==null)throw new IOException("Missing journal after bytes");
                after.put(name,next);
            }
            if(in.read()!=-1)throw new IOException("Dependency journal trailing data");
        }
        boolean completed=true;
        var current=new HashMap<String,byte[]>();
        for(String name:after.keySet()) {
            Path p=safe(root,name);
            byte[] actual=Files.exists(p,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)?read(p):null;
            current.put(name,actual);
            boolean done=Arrays.equals(actual,after.get(name));
            completed&=done;
            if(!done&&!Arrays.equals(actual,before.get(name)))throw new IOException("Dependency transaction conflicts with external edit: "+name+"; preserve the journal and resolve the file before retrying");
        }
        if(!completed)for(String name:after.keySet())if(Arrays.equals(current.get(name),after.get(name))) {
            Path p=safe(root,name);
            byte[] original=before.get(name);
            if(original==null)Files.deleteIfExists(p);
            else {
                Files.createDirectories(p.getParent());
                Path temp=Files.createTempFile(p.getParent(),".dependency-recover-",".tmp");
                try {
                    Files.write(temp,original);
                    Files.move(temp,p,StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
                }
                finally {
                    Files.deleteIfExists(temp);
                }
            }
        }
        Files.delete(journal);
    }
    private static byte[] read(Path p)throws IOException {
        try(var in=Files.newInputStream(p,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
            byte[] b=in.readNBytes(SourceProjects.MAX_BYTES+1);
            if(b.length>SourceProjects.MAX_BYTES)throw new IOException("Dependency file limit");
            return b;
        }
    }
    private static Path safe(Path root,String name)throws IOException {
        Path p=root.resolve(name).normalize();
        for(Path a=p;a!=null;a=a.getParent())if(Files.isSymbolicLink(a))throw new IOException("Linked dependency recovery file");
        Path ancestor=p;
        while(!Files.exists(ancestor,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))ancestor=ancestor.getParent();
        if(!ancestor.toRealPath().startsWith(root.toRealPath()))throw new IOException("Dependency recovery path escapes project");
        return p;
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\scripts\DependencySyntax.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.*;
/** Lexical comments and TOML string handling; never evaluates project scripts. */
final class DependencySyntax  {
    private DependencySyntax() {
    }
    static String gradle(String s) {
        var out=new StringBuilder();
        char quote=0;
        boolean line=false,block=false,escape=false;
        for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++) {
            char c=s.charAt(i),n=i+1<s.length()?s.charAt(i+1):0;
            if(line) {
                if(c=='\n')line=false;
                out.append(c=='\n'?'\n':' ');
                continue;
            }
            if(block) {
                if(c=='*'&&n=='/') {
                    out.append("  ");
                    i++;
                    block=false;
                }
                else out.append(c=='\n'?'\n':' ');
                continue;
            }
            if(quote!=0) {
                out.append(c);
                if(escape)escape=false;
                else if(c=='\\')escape=true;
                else if(c==quote)quote=0;
                continue;
            }
            if(c=='\''||c=='"') {
                quote=c;
                out.append(c);
            }
            else if(c=='/'&&n=='/') {
                line=true;
                out.append("  ");
                i++;
            }
            else if(c=='/'&&n=='*') {
                block=true;
                out.append("  ");
                i++;
            }
            else out.append(c);
        }
        return out.toString();
    }
    private record Token(String text,boolean string) {
    }
    private static List<Token> tokens(String build) {
        String s=gradle(build);
        var tokens=new ArrayList<Token>();
        for(int i=0;i<s.length();) {
            char c=s.charAt(i);
            if(Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                i++;
                continue;
            }
            if(c=='\''||c=='"') {
                char quote=c;
                i++;
                var text=new StringBuilder();
                boolean triple=i+1<s.length()&&s.charAt(i)==quote&&s.charAt(i+1)==quote;
                if(triple) {
                    i+=2;
                    while(i+2<s.length()&&!(s.charAt(i)==quote&&s.charAt(i+1)==quote&&s.charAt(i+2)==quote))text.append(s.charAt(i++));
                    i=Math.min(s.length(),i+3);
                }
                else {
                    while(i<s.length()) {
                        char q=s.charAt(i++);
                        if(q==quote)break;
                        if(q=='\\'&&i<s.length())q=s.charAt(i++);
                        text.append(q);
                    }
                }
                tokens.add(new Token(text.toString(),true));
            }
            else if(Character.isJavaIdentifierStart(c)) {
                int start=i++;
                while(i<s.length()&&Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(s.charAt(i)))i++;
                tokens.add(new Token(s.substring(start,i),false));
            }
            else {
                tokens.add(new Token(String.valueOf(c),false));
                i++;
            }
        }
        return tokens;
    }
    static boolean neo(String build) {
        var tokens=tokens(build);
        var scopes=new ArrayDeque<Boolean>();
        for(int i=0;i<tokens.size();i++) {
            Token t=tokens.get(i);
            if(t.string())continue;
            if(t.text().equals("{")) {
                boolean plugin=i>0&&!tokens.get(i-1).string()&&tokens.get(i-1).text().equals("plugins")||!scopes.isEmpty()&&scopes.peek();
                scopes.push(plugin);
            }
            else if(t.text().equals("}")) {
                if(!scopes.isEmpty())scopes.pop();
            }
            else if(t.text().equals("id")&&!scopes.isEmpty()&&scopes.peek()) {
                int at=i+1;
                if(at<tokens.size()&&tokens.get(at).text().equals("("))at++;
                if(at<tokens.size()&&tokens.get(at).string()&&tokens.get(at).text().equals("net.neoforged.gradle.userdev"))return true;
            }
            else if(t.text().equals("apply")&&i+3<tokens.size()&&tokens.get(i+1).text().equals("plugin")&&tokens.get(i+2).text().equals(":")) {
                Token value=tokens.get(i+3);
                if(value.string()&&value.text().equals("net.neoforged.gradle.userdev"))return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    static boolean declares(String build,String coordinate) {
        String[] own=coordinate.split(":");
        var tokens=tokens(build);
        for(int i=0;i<tokens.size();i++) {
            Token t=tokens.get(i);
            if(t.string()||!Set.of("implementation","api","compileOnly","compileOnlyApi","runtimeOnly","jarJar","testImplementation").contains(t.text()))continue;
            int at=i+1;
            if(at<tokens.size()&&tokens.get(at).text().equals("("))at++;
            if(at>=tokens.size()||!tokens.get(at).string())continue;
            String[] p=tokens.get(at).text().split(":");
            if(p.length>=3&&p[0].equals(own[0])&&p[1].equals(own[1])&&(p.length>3?p[3]:"").equals(own.length>3?own[3]:""))return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    static String uncomment(String line) {
        char q=0;
        boolean escaped=false;
        for(int i=0;i<line.length();i++) {
            char c=line.charAt(i);
            if(q==0) {
                if(c=='#')return line.substring(0,i).strip();
                if(c=='\''||c=='"')q=c;
            }
            else if(q=='"'&&c=='\\'&&!escaped) {
                escaped=true;
                continue;
            }
            else if(c==q&&!escaped)q=0;
            escaped=false;
        }
        return line.strip();
    }
    static String string(String value)throws IOException {
        value=value.strip();
        if(value.length()<2)throw new IOException("Expected literal TOML string");
        char q=value.charAt(0);
        if((q!='\''&&q!='"')||value.charAt(value.length()-1)!=q)throw new IOException("Expected literal TOML string");
        String inner=value.substring(1,value.length()-1);
        if(q=='\'')return inner;
        if(inner.contains("\\")) {
            var out=new StringBuilder();
            for(int i=0;i<inner.length();i++) {
                char c=inner.charAt(i);
                if(c!='\\') {
                    out.append(c);
                    continue;
                }
                if(++i>=inner.length())throw new IOException("Invalid TOML escape");
                char e=inner.charAt(i);
                switch(e) {
                    case '"','\\'->out.append(e);
                    case 'n'->out.append('\n');
                    case 'r'->out.append('\r');
                    case 't'->out.append('\t');
                    case 'b'->out.append('\b');
                    case 'f'->out.append('\f');
                    case 'u','U'-> {
                        int len=e=='u'?4:8;
                        if(i+len>=inner.length())throw new IOException("Invalid TOML unicode escape");
                        try {
                            out.appendCodePoint(Integer.parseInt(inner.substring(i+1,i+1+len),16));
                        }
                        catch(IllegalArgumentException bad) {
                            throw new IOException("Invalid TOML unicode escape",bad);
                        }
                        i+=len;
                    }
                    default->throw new IOException("Invalid TOML escape");
                }
            }
            return out.toString();
        }
        return inner;
    }
    static Map<String,List<String>> modIds(String toml)throws IOException {
        var result=new LinkedHashMap<String,List<String>>();
        String table="";
        char multiline=0;
        for(String raw:toml.split("\\R")) {
            String line=uncomment(raw);
            if(multiline!=0) {
                String mark=String.valueOf(multiline).repeat(3);
                if(raw.contains(mark))multiline=0;
                continue;
            }
            int a=line.indexOf("\"\"\""),b=line.indexOf(String.valueOf((char)39).repeat(3));
            if(a>=0||b>=0) {
                char q=a>=0?'"':'\'';
                String mark=String.valueOf(q).repeat(3);
                int n=line.indexOf(mark);
                if(line.indexOf(mark,n+3)<0)multiline=q;
                continue;
            }
            if(line.startsWith("[[")&&line.endsWith("]]")) {
                table=line.substring(2,line.length()-2).strip();
                continue;
            }
            if(line.startsWith("[")) {
                table="";
                continue;
            }
            var m=Pattern.compile("^(?:modId|\"modId\"|'modId')\\s*=\\s*(.*)$").matcher(line);
            if(m.matches())result.computeIfAbsent(table,k->new ArrayList<>()).add(string(m.group(1)));
        }
        return result;
    }
    static boolean validRange(String s) {
        if(s==null||s.length()>128)return false;
        if(s.matches("\\[[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*\\]"))return true;
        if(!s.matches("[\\[(][A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*,[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*[\\])]")&&!s.matches("\\(,[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*[\\])]")&&!s.matches("[\\[(][A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*,\\)"))return false;
        String[] p=s.substring(1,s.length()-1).split(",",-1);
        if(!p[0].isEmpty()&&!p[1].isEmpty()&&p[0].matches("[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)*")&&p[1].matches("[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)*")) {
            int n=numericCompare(p[0],p[1]);
            if(n>0||n==0&&(s.charAt(0)!='['||s.charAt(s.length()-1)!=']'))return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    static boolean numericContains(String range,String version) {
        if(!version.matches("[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)*"))return true;
        if(range.matches("\\[[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)*\\]"))return numericCompare(range.substring(1,range.length()-1),version)==0;
        String[] p=range.substring(1,range.length()-1).split(",",-1);
        if(p.length!=2)return true;
        for(String bound:p)if(!bound.isEmpty()&&!bound.matches("[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)*"))return true;
        if(!p[0].isEmpty()) {
            int n=numericCompare(version,p[0]);
            if(n<0||n==0&&range.charAt(0)=='(')return false;
        }
        if(!p[1].isEmpty()) {
            int n=numericCompare(version,p[1]);
            if(n>0||n==0&&range.charAt(range.length()-1)==')')return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    static int numericCompare(String a,String b) {
        String[] x=a.split("\\."),y=b.split("\\.");
        for(int i=0;i<Math.max(x.length,y.length);i++) {
            var p=new java.math.BigInteger(i<x.length?x[i]:"0");
            var q=new java.math.BigInteger(i<y.length?y[i]:"0");
            int n=p.compareTo(q);
            if(n!=0)return n;
        }
        return 0;
    }
}

/** Portable local editor context. Stores paths/UI state, never source text or executable settings. */
public final class EditorWorkspaceState {
    public static final int MAX_BYTES=64*1024,MAX_DOCUMENTS=16,MAX_VIEWS=32,MAX_EXPANDED=128;
    private static final String NAME=".genesis-workspace.properties";
    public record Document(String project,String file,boolean selected) {}
    public record View(String project,List<String> expanded,String folder,String entry,int scroll){public View{expanded=List.copyOf(expanded);}}
    public record State(String project,List<Document> documents,List<View> views){public State{documents=List.copyOf(documents);views=List.copyOf(views);}}
    public static State empty(){return new State("",List.of(),List.of());}
    private final Path root;
    public EditorWorkspaceState(Path root){this.root=Objects.requireNonNull(root).toAbsolutePath().normalize();}
    private static void require(boolean condition,String reason)throws IOException{if(!condition)throw new IOException(reason);}
    private static boolean path(String value,boolean empty){return value!=null&&(empty&&value.isEmpty()||ProjectPath.valid(value));}
    private static void validate(State state)throws IOException{
        require(state!=null&&state.project()!=null&&(state.project().isEmpty()||SourceProjects.validProject(state.project())),"Invalid workspace project");
        require(state.documents().size()<=MAX_DOCUMENTS&&state.views().size()<=MAX_VIEWS,"Workspace count limit");
        var docs=new HashSet<String>();var selected=new HashSet<String>();var views=new HashSet<String>();
        for(Document d:state.documents()){
            require(d!=null&&SourceProjects.validProject(d.project())&&path(d.file(),false),"Invalid workspace document");
            require(docs.add(d.project().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)+"/"+d.file().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)),"Duplicate workspace document");
            require(!d.selected()||selected.add(d.project().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)),"Multiple selected documents in project");
        }
        for(View v:state.views()){
            require(v!=null&&SourceProjects.validProject(v.project())&&views.add(v.project().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)),"Invalid or duplicate workspace view");
            require(v.expanded().size()<=MAX_EXPANDED&&path(v.folder(),true)&&path(v.entry(),true)&&v.scroll()>=0&&v.scroll()<=10000,"Invalid workspace view state");
            var paths=new HashSet<String>();for(String p:v.expanded())require(path(p,false)&&paths.add(p.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)),"Invalid expanded workspace folder");
        }
    }
    private void safeRoot()throws IOException{
        for(Path p=root;p!=null;p=p.getParent())require(!Files.isSymbolicLink(p),"Linked workspace root is not supported");
        if(Files.exists(root,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))require(Files.isDirectory(root,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS),"Workspace root is not a directory");
    }
    public State load()throws IOException{
        safeRoot();Path file=root.resolve(NAME);if(!Files.exists(file,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))return empty();
        require(!Files.isSymbolicLink(file)&&Files.isRegularFile(file,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS),"Invalid workspace file");
        require(file.toRealPath().getParent().equals(root.toRealPath()),"Workspace file escapes root");
        byte[] bytes;try(var in=Files.newInputStream(file,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)){bytes=in.readNBytes(MAX_BYTES+1);}
        require(bytes.length<=MAX_BYTES,"Workspace file exceeds 64 KiB");Properties p=new Properties();
        try{String text=StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newDecoder().onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT).decode(java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes)).toString();p.load(new StringReader(text));}
        catch(IllegalArgumentException|CharacterCodingException error){throw new IOException("Malformed workspace context",error);}
        require("1".equals(p.getProperty("format")),"Unsupported workspace context format");
        int dc=number(p,"documents",MAX_DOCUMENTS),vc=number(p,"views",MAX_VIEWS);var docs=new ArrayList<Document>();var views=new ArrayList<View>();
        for(int i=0;i<dc;i++){String k="document."+i+".";String selected=p.getProperty(k+"selected","");require(selected.equals("true")||selected.equals("false"),"Invalid workspace selection");docs.add(new Document(p.getProperty(k+"project"),p.getProperty(k+"file"),Boolean.parseBoolean(selected)));}
        for(int i=0;i<vc;i++){String k="view."+i+".";int count=number(p,k+"expanded",MAX_EXPANDED);var expanded=new ArrayList<String>();for(int j=0;j<count;j++)expanded.add(p.getProperty(k+"folder."+j,""));views.add(new View(p.getProperty(k+"project"),expanded,p.getProperty(k+"folder",""),p.getProperty(k+"entry",""),number(p,k+"scroll",10000)));}
        State state=new State(p.getProperty("project",""),docs,views);validate(state);return state;
    }
    private static int number(Properties p,String key,int max)throws IOException{try{int n=Integer.parseInt(p.getProperty(key,""));require(n>=0&&n<=max,"Invalid workspace count: "+key);return n;}catch(NumberFormatException error){throw new IOException("Invalid workspace number: "+key,error);}}
    public void save(State state)throws IOException{
        validate(state);Properties p=new Properties();p.setProperty("format","1");p.setProperty("project",state.project());p.setProperty("documents",Integer.toString(state.documents().size()));p.setProperty("views",Integer.toString(state.views().size()));
        for(int i=0;i<state.documents().size();i++){var d=state.documents().get(i);String k="document."+i+".";p.setProperty(k+"project",d.project());p.setProperty(k+"file",d.file());p.setProperty(k+"selected",Boolean.toString(d.selected()));}
        for(int i=0;i<state.views().size();i++){var v=state.views().get(i);String k="view."+i+".";p.setProperty(k+"project",v.project());p.setProperty(k+"folder",v.folder());p.setProperty(k+"entry",v.entry());p.setProperty(k+"scroll",Integer.toString(v.scroll()));p.setProperty(k+"expanded",Integer.toString(v.expanded().size()));for(int j=0;j<v.expanded().size();j++)p.setProperty(k+"folder."+j,v.expanded().get(j));}
        var text=new StringWriter();p.store(text,"Genesis editor context; no source text");byte[] bytes=text.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);require(bytes.length<=MAX_BYTES,"Workspace context exceeds 64 KiB");
        safeRoot();Files.createDirectories(root);safeRoot();Path target=root.resolve(NAME),tmp=null;
        require(!Files.isSymbolicLink(target),"Linked workspace file is not supported");
        try{tmp=Files.createTempFile(root,".workspace-",".tmp");Files.write(tmp,bytes,StandardOpenOption.TRUNCATE_EXISTING);try{Files.move(tmp,target,StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);}catch(AtomicMoveNotSupportedException unsupported){Files.move(tmp,target,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);}}
        finally{if(tmp!=null)Files.deleteIfExists(tmp);}
    }
}

    private boolean start(Path project,Settings settings,String task,boolean listing,Options options){
        if(closed||pending!=null)return false;Objects.requireNonNull(project);Objects.requireNonNull(settings);Objects.requireNonNull(options);
        var token=new AtomicBoolean();

    }
    public void stop(){if(cancellation!=null)cancellation.set(true);}
    public void poll(java.util.function.Consumer<Result> completed){
        if(pending==null||!pending.isDone())return;var task=pending;pending=null;
        try{completed.accept(task.get());}catch(InterruptedException e){Thread.currentThread().interrupt();}
        catch(ExecutionException e){completed.accept(new Result(Status.IO_ERROR,-1,e.getCause().toString(),false,List.of()));}
    }
    public synchronized String drainOutput(){var text=new StringBuilder();for(int i=0;i<4&&!live.isEmpty();i++)text.append(live.removeFirst());return text.toString();}
    // A delayed reader from a completed job cannot contaminate the next build's logs.
    private synchronized void append(String text,AtomicBoolean token){if(cancellation==token)append(text);}
    private synchronized void append(String text){

    }

    private static void terminate(Process child,Set<ProcessHandle> known){

    }
    @Override public void close(){if(closed)return;closed=true;stop();worker.shutdown();}

package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
/** Per-invocation Gradle output report. The init script runs only with an explicitly requested build. */
public final class GradleOutputs  {
    private GradleOutputs() {
    }
    public static List<String> prune(Path project)throws IOException {
        Path state=project.resolve(".genesis-build");var folders=new ArrayList<Path>();var issues=new ArrayList<String>();int entries=0;
        if(!Files.isDirectory(state,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))return issues;
        try(var files=Files.newDirectoryStream(state)){for(Path p:files){if(++entries>10000)throw new IOException("Build state entry limit");if(p.getFileName().toString().matches("[a-f0-9-]{36}")&&Files.isDirectory(p,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))folders.add(p);}}
        folders.sort(Comparator.comparingLong(p->{try{return Files.getLastModifiedTime(p,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS).toMillis();}catch(IOException e){return Long.MAX_VALUE;}}));
        for(int i=0;i<folders.size()-15;i++){Path folder=folders.get(i);try{Files.walkFileTree(folder,new SimpleFileVisitor<Path>(){
            public FileVisitResult preVisitDirectory(Path p,java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes attributes)throws IOException{if(Files.isSymbolicLink(p)||!p.toRealPath().startsWith(state.toRealPath()))throw new IOException("Linked build snapshot");return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;}
            public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path p,java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes attributes)throws IOException{Files.delete(p);return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;}
            public FileVisitResult postVisitDirectory(Path p,IOException error)throws IOException{if(error!=null)throw error;Files.delete(p);return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;}
        });}catch(IOException e){if(issues.size()<16)issues.add("Build snapshot cleanup deferred: "+e.getMessage());}}
        return List.copyOf(issues);
    }
    public static Path script(Path work,String id)throws IOException {
        Files.createDirectories(work);
        Path script=work.resolve("capture.gradle");
        Files.writeString(script,SCRIPT,StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        return script;
    }
    public static List<Path> outputs(Path project,String id)throws IOException {
        var p=read(project,id);
        var result=new ArrayList<Path>();
        for(int i=0;i<Integer.parseInt(p.getProperty("archives","0"));i++) {
            String path=decode(p.getProperty("archive."+i));
            Path file=Path.of(path).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
            if(!file.startsWith(project.toAbsolutePath().normalize()))throw new IOException("Gradle archive is outside project: "+file);
            result.add(file);
        }
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }
    public static List<String> inputExclusions(Path project,String id)throws IOException {
        var p=read(project,id);
        var paths=new ArrayList<String>();
        int count;
        try {
            count=Integer.parseInt(p.getProperty("excludes","0"));
        }
        catch(NumberFormatException e) {
            throw new IOException("Malformed output exclusions",e);
        }
        if(count<0||count>10000)throw new IOException("Output exclusion count limit");
        Path root=project.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        for(int i=0;i<count;i++) {
            Path path=Path.of(decode(p.getProperty("exclude."+i))).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
            if(path.equals(root)||!path.startsWith(root))continue;
            paths.add(root.relativize(path).toString().replace('\\','/'));
        }
        return List.copyOf(paths);
    }
    public static boolean reported(Path project,String id) {
        return Files.isRegularFile(project.resolve(".genesis-build").resolve(id).resolve("outputs.properties"),LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
    }
    public static Map<String,byte[]> runtime(Path project,String id,String artifact,BooleanSupplier cancelled)throws IOException {
        var p=read(project,id);
        int at=-1;
        for(int i=0;i<Integer.parseInt(p.getProperty("archives","0"));i++)if(project.resolve(artifact).toAbsolutePath().normalize().equals(Path.of(decode(p.getProperty("archive."+i))).toAbsolutePath().normalize())) {
            at=i;
            break;
        }
        if(at<0)throw new IOException("Artifact absent from this Gradle invocation");
        int count=Integer.parseInt(p.getProperty("runtime."+at+".count","0"));
        if(count>128)throw new IOException("Runtime classpath limit: 128 JARs");
        long total=0;
        var result=new LinkedHashMap<String,byte[]>();
        Path root=project.resolve(".genesis-build").resolve(id).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        for(int i=0;i<count;i++) {
            if(cancelled.getAsBoolean())throw new IOException("Runtime snapshot cancelled");
            String name=p.getProperty("runtime."+at+"."+i);
            if(name==null||!name.matches("[0-9a-f]{64}\\.jar"))throw new IOException("Invalid runtime report filename");
            Path file=root.resolve("runtime").resolve(name);
            if(Files.isSymbolicLink(file)||!file.toRealPath().startsWith(root.toRealPath()))throw new IOException("Linked runtime snapshot");
            long size=Files.size(file);
            if(size>64L*1024*1024||(total+=size)>512L*1024*1024)throw new IOException("Runtime snapshot size limit: 64 MiB per JAR / 512 MiB total");
            byte[] data;
            try(var in=Files.newInputStream(file,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
                data=in.readNBytes(64*1024*1024+1);
            }
            if(data.length!=size||!hash(data).equals(name.substring(0,64)))throw new IOException("Runtime dependency changed since build: "+name);
            result.put(name,data);
        }
        return Collections.unmodifiableMap(result);
    }
    public static String hash(byte[] bytes) {
        try {
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes));
        }
        catch(java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(e);
        }
    }
    private static String decode(String value)throws IOException {
        try {
            return new String(Base64.getDecoder().decode(value),StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        }
        catch(RuntimeException e) {
            throw new IOException("Malformed Gradle output path",e);
        }
    }
    private static Properties read(Path project,String id)throws IOException {
        if(id==null||!id.matches("[a-f0-9-]{36}"))throw new IOException("Invalid Gradle build identity");
        Path folder=project.resolve(".genesis-build").resolve(id),file=folder.resolve("outputs.properties");
        for(Path f=file;f!=null;f=f.getParent())if(Files.isSymbolicLink(f))throw new IOException("Linked Gradle output report");
        if(!file.toRealPath().startsWith(project.toRealPath()))throw new IOException("Gradle output report escapes project");
        var p=new Properties();
        try(var in=Files.newInputStream(file,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
            byte[] b=in.readNBytes(4*1024*1024+1);
            if(b.length>4*1024*1024)throw new IOException("Gradle output report limit");
            p.load(new StringReader(new String(b,StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
        }
        if(!id.equals(p.getProperty("id")))throw new IOException("Stale Gradle output report");
        try {
            int count=Integer.parseInt(p.getProperty("archives","0"));
            if(count<0||count>128)throw new IOException("Gradle archive count limit");
        }
        catch(NumberFormatException bad) {
            throw new IOException("Malformed Gradle archive count",bad);
        }
        return p;
    }
    private static final String SCRIPT="""
 import org.gradle.api.tasks.bundling.AbstractArchiveTask
 import java.nio.file.Files
 import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption
 import java.security.MessageDigest
 import java.util.Base64
 def genesisId = System.getProperty('genesis.build.id')
 def genesisRoot = new File(System.getProperty('genesis.build.root')).canonicalFile
 def genesisFolder = new File(genesisRoot, '.genesis-build/' + genesisId)
 def genesisPackagingTask = { task -> task instanceof AbstractArchiveTask || task.name.toLowerCase().contains('jarjar') || ['remapjar', 'shadowjar'].contains(task.name.toLowerCase()) }
 def genesisArchives = []
 def genesisExcludes = []
 gradle.taskGraph.whenReady { graph ->
     genesisArchives = graph.allTasks.findAll { genesisPackagingTask(it) }
     genesisExcludes = graph.allTasks.collectMany { it.outputs.files.files as List }.findAll { it.canonicalFile != genesisRoot && it.canonicalFile.toPath().startsWith(genesisRoot.toPath()) }.collect { it.canonicalPath }.unique()
 }
 def genesisCapture = {
     def report = new Properties()
     report.setProperty('id', genesisId)
     if (genesisExcludes.size() > 10000) throw new GradleException('Genesis output exclusion limit: 10000')
     report.setProperty('excludes', genesisExcludes.size().toString())
     genesisExcludes.eachWithIndex { path, i -> report.setProperty('exclude.' + i, Base64.encoder.encodeToString(path.getBytes('UTF-8'))) }
     int index = 0
     def snapshotCache = [:]
     long snapshotBytes = 0
     genesisArchives.each { task ->
         def candidates = task instanceof AbstractArchiveTask ? [task.archiveFile.get().asFile] : task.outputs.files.files.findAll { it.isFile() && it.name.toLowerCase().matches('.*[.](jar|zip|tar|tgz)') }
         candidates.each { candidate ->
         def archive = candidate.canonicalFile
         if (!archive.isFile()) return
         if (!archive.toPath().startsWith(genesisRoot.toPath())) throw new GradleException('Genesis output outside project: ' + archive)
         if (index >= 128) throw new GradleException('Genesis archive limit: 128')
         report.setProperty('archive.' + index, Base64.encoder.encodeToString(archive.absolutePath.getBytes('UTF-8')))
         def runtime = task.project.configurations.findByName('runtimeClasspath')
         def names = []
         if (runtime != null && runtime.canBeResolved) {
             runtime.files.findAll { it.isFile() && it.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.jar') && it.canonicalFile != archive }.each { dependency ->
                 // Game/API classes belong to the host loader; do not duplicate the Minecraft distribution.
                 def gameArchive = false
                 def zip = new java.util.zip.ZipFile(dependency)
                 try { gameArchive = zip.getEntry('net/minecraft/server/MinecraftServer.class') != null || zip.getEntry('net/minecraft/client/Minecraft.class') != null } finally { zip.close() }
                 if (gameArchive) return
                 def key = dependency.canonicalPath
                 def hash = snapshotCache[key]
                 if (hash == null) {
                     if ((snapshotBytes += dependency.length()) > 512L * 1024 * 1024) throw new GradleException('Genesis runtime snapshot exceeds 512 MiB')
                     if (dependency.length() > 64L * 1024 * 1024) throw new GradleException('Genesis runtime dependency exceeds 64 MiB: ' + dependency)
                     def digest = MessageDigest.getInstance('SHA-256')
                     dependency.withInputStream { input -> byte[] buf = new byte[65536]; int n; while ((n = input.read(buf)) != -1) digest.update(buf, 0, n) }
                     hash = digest.digest().encodeHex().toString()
                     def destination = new File(genesisFolder, 'runtime/' + hash + '.jar')
                     destination.parentFile.mkdirs()
                     Files.copy(dependency.toPath(), destination.toPath(), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
                     snapshotCache[key] = hash
                 }
                 names.add(hash + '.jar')
             }
         }
         names = names.unique()
         if (names.size() > 128) throw new GradleException('Genesis runtime classpath exceeds 128 JARs')
         report.setProperty('runtime.' + index + '.count', names.size().toString())
         names.eachWithIndex { name, i -> report.setProperty('runtime.' + index + '.' + i, name) }
         index++
         }
     }
     report.setProperty('archives', index.toString())
     genesisFolder.mkdirs()
     def pending = new File(genesisFolder, 'outputs.part')
     pending.withWriter('UTF-8') { report.store(it, 'Genesis build outputs') }
     Files.move(pending.toPath(), new File(genesisFolder, 'outputs.properties').toPath(), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
 }
  gradle.projectsEvaluated {
     def capture = gradle.rootProject.tasks.register('genesisCaptureOutputs_' + genesisId.replace('-', '_')) {
         group = 'genesis'
         description = 'Capture verified archive outputs and runtime libraries for this invocation'
         doLast { genesisCapture() }
     }
     def archivePaths = []
     gradle.allprojects { project ->
         project.tasks.configureEach { archive ->
             if (!genesisPackagingTask(archive)) return
             archive.finalizedBy(capture)
             archivePaths << archive.path
         }
     }
     capture.configure { mustRunAfter(*archivePaths) }
  }
 """;
}
