package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.RepositoryPath;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.charset.*;
import java.nio.file.*;

import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;

/** Bounded local directory copy/export. Never evaluates Gradle, downloads dependencies or follows links. */
public final class GradleProjectImport {
    public static final int MAX_ENTRIES=2000, MAX_FILE_BYTES=16*1024*1024;
    public static final long MAX_TOTAL_BYTES=128L*1024*1024;
    public record Summary(int files,long bytes) {}
    public record Edit(String baseline,String text) {}
    // Snapshot equality describes the copied data, not provider-specific metadata.
    private record Stamp(long size,String sha256,boolean directory) {}
    private record Snapshot(SortedMap<String,Stamp> entries,long bytes) {}
    private static final Set<String> HIDDEN=Set.of(".gitignore",".gitattributes",".editorconfig",".gitkeep",".github");
    private static final Set<String> SKIP=Set.of(".git",".gradle",".idea",".vscode",".settings",".genesis",".genesis-gradle-cache",".genesis-recovery",".exports",".genesis-build");
    private GradleProjectImport() {}
    public static boolean editable(String path){
        return com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.ProjectPath.valid(path)&&!path.equalsIgnoreCase("genesis-project.properties")&&
                (com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.ProjectPath.plainTextDotfile(path)||path.equals("gradlew")||path.equals("gradlew.bat")||path.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).matches(".+\\.(java|kt|kts|gradle|groovy|scala|py|rs|cpp|c|h|hpp|json|txt|md|toml|properties|xml|yaml|yml|cfg|conf|mcmeta|mr|mcfunction|csv|js|ts|css|html|glsl|vert|frag|sql|bat|sh)"));
    }
    private static boolean validPath(String path){
        return com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.ProjectPath.valid(path);
    }
    private static boolean skipped(Path relative,boolean directory){
        String name=relative.getFileName().toString();
        if(SKIP.contains(name))return true;
        if(!directory&&(name.equals(".build-tools.properties")||name.equals(DependencyJournal.NAME)||relative.toString().equals("genesis-project.properties")))return true;
        if(directory&&(name.equals("build")||name.equals("out"))){for(Path part:relative)if(part.toString().equals("src")||part.toString().equals("tests"))return false;return true;}
        return false;
    }
    private static void cancelled(BooleanSupplier stop)throws IOException{if(stop.getAsBoolean())throw new IOException("Import/export cancelled");}
    private static Snapshot scan(Path root,BooleanSupplier stop,boolean fingerprint)throws IOException{return scan(root,stop,fingerprint,"");}
    private static Snapshot scan(Path root,BooleanSupplier stop,boolean fingerprint,String prefix)throws IOException{
        if(!root.isAbsolute()||!Files.isDirectory(root,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)||Files.isSymbolicLink(root))throw new IOException("Select an absolute regular project directory");
        Path real=root.toRealPath();var result=new TreeMap<String,Stamp>();var aliases=new HashSet<String>();long[] total={0};int[] count={0};
        Files.walkFileTree(root,new SimpleFileVisitor<>(){
            private void inspect(Path path,BasicFileAttributes attributes)throws IOException{
                cancelled(stop);
                // walkFileTree may supply cached directory-enumeration attributes on Windows.
                attributes=Files.readAttributes(path,BasicFileAttributes.class,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
                if(++count[0]>MAX_ENTRIES)throw new IOException("Imported project exceeds 2000 entries");
                String relative=root.relativize(path).toString().replace('\\','/');
                if(!validPath(relative)||!aliases.add(relative.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)))throw new IOException("Invalid or case-aliased project path: "+relative);
                if(attributes.isSymbolicLink()||!path.toRealPath().startsWith(real))throw new IOException("Link or junction escapes project: "+relative);
                if(!attributes.isDirectory()&&!attributes.isRegularFile())throw new IOException("Not a regular project file: "+relative);
                if(!attributes.isDirectory()){
                    if(attributes.size()>MAX_FILE_BYTES)throw new IOException("Imported file exceeds 16 MiB: "+relative);
                    if(editable(prefix.isEmpty()?relative:prefix+"/"+relative)&&attributes.size()>SourceProjects.MAX_BYTES)throw new IOException("Editable file exceeds 4 MiB: "+relative);
                    total[0]+=attributes.size();if(total[0]>MAX_TOTAL_BYTES)throw new IOException("Imported project exceeds 128 MiB");
                }
                String hash=null;
                if(fingerprint&&!attributes.isDirectory())hash=transfer(path,OutputStream.nullOutputStream(),attributes.size(),null,stop);
                // Directory sizes/timestamps are not a portable representation of their contents.
                result.put(relative,new Stamp(attributes.isDirectory()?0:attributes.size(),hash,attributes.isDirectory()));
            }
            @Override public FileVisitResult preVisitDirectory(Path dir,BasicFileAttributes a)throws IOException{
                cancelled(stop);if(dir.equals(root))return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
                if(skipped(prefix.isEmpty()?root.relativize(dir):Path.of(prefix).resolve(root.relativize(dir)),true))return FileVisitResult.SKIP_SUBTREE;inspect(dir,a);return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
            }
            @Override public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path file,BasicFileAttributes a)throws IOException{
                if(!skipped(prefix.isEmpty()?root.relativize(file):Path.of(prefix).resolve(root.relativize(file)),false))inspect(file,a);return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
            }
        });
        return new Snapshot(Collections.unmodifiableSortedMap(result),total[0]);
    }
    private static void unchanged(Path source,Snapshot before,BooleanSupplier stop)throws IOException{
        if(!before.equals(scan(source,stop,true)))throw new IOException("Project changed while copying/exporting; retry with external writers stopped");
    }
    /** Destination must be an empty staging directory owned by the caller. Caller publishes or removes it. */
    public static Summary copy(Path source,Path destination,BooleanSupplier stop)throws IOException{
        return copy(source,destination,stop,true,false);
    }
    public static Summary copy(Path source,Path destination,BooleanSupplier stop,boolean requireBuild,boolean allowMetadata)throws IOException{return copy(source,destination,stop,requireBuild,allowMetadata,"");}
    static Summary copyContents(Path source,Path destination,BooleanSupplier stop,String prefix)throws IOException{return copy(source,destination,stop,false,true,prefix);}
    private static Summary copy(Path source,Path destination,BooleanSupplier stop,boolean requireBuild,boolean allowMetadata,String prefix)throws IOException{
        Objects.requireNonNull(stop);if(!Files.isDirectory(destination,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)||Files.isSymbolicLink(destination))throw new IOException("Invalid import staging directory");
        try(var entries=Files.list(destination)){if(entries.findAny().isPresent())throw new IOException("Import staging directory must be empty");}
        Path from=source.toAbsolutePath().normalize(),to=destination.toRealPath();Path real=from.toRealPath();
        if(real.startsWith(to)||to.startsWith(real))throw new IOException("Source and destination must not contain each other");
        if(!allowMetadata&&Files.exists(from.resolve("genesis-project.properties"),LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))throw new IOException("Source already has Genesis metadata");
        if(requireBuild&&!BuildTools.gradleRoot(from))throw new IOException("Select a Gradle root with build.gradle(.kts) or settings.gradle(.kts)");
        Snapshot snapshot=scan(from,stop,true,prefix);for(String path:snapshot.entries.keySet())if(prefix.isEmpty()&&path.equalsIgnoreCase("genesis-project.properties"))throw new IOException("Source already has Genesis metadata");int files=0;
        for(var e:snapshot.entries.entrySet()){
            cancelled(stop);Path input=from.resolve(e.getKey()),output=to.resolve(e.getKey());
            if(e.getValue().directory){Files.createDirectories(output);continue;}
            Files.createDirectories(output.getParent());try(var out=Files.newOutputStream(output,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW)){transfer(input,out,e.getValue().size,e.getValue().sha256,stop);}
            // Preserve executable Wrapper scripts on Unix; copy does not execute them.
            if(Files.isExecutable(input))output.toFile().setExecutable(true);
            files++;
        }
        if(!snapshot.equals(scan(from,stop,true,prefix)))throw new IOException("Copy source changed; retry with external writers stopped");return new Summary(files,snapshot.bytes);
    }
    public static List<String> editableFiles(Path root)throws IOException{
        var result=new ArrayList<String>();for(var e:scan(root,()->false,false).entries.entrySet())if(!e.getValue().directory&&editable(e.getKey()))result.add(e.getKey());return List.copyOf(result);
    }
    /** Refuse publishing an addition that would make the complete project unreadable. */
    static void validateAddition(Path project,Path data,boolean directory,String destination)throws IOException{
        Snapshot current=scan(project,()->false,false);long bytes;int count;
        if(directory){Snapshot addition=scan(data,()->false,false,"src");bytes=addition.bytes;count=addition.entries.size()+1;
            for(String path:addition.entries.keySet())if(!com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.ProjectPath.valid(destination+"/"+path))throw new IOException("Destination path limit: "+path);
        }else{bytes=Files.size(data);count=1;if(editable(destination)&&bytes>SourceProjects.MAX_BYTES)throw new IOException("Editable copy exceeds 4 MiB");}
        if(current.entries.size()+count>MAX_ENTRIES||current.bytes+bytes>MAX_TOTAL_BYTES)throw new IOException("Copy exceeds project entry or byte limit");
    }
    public static List<String> allFiles(Path root)throws IOException{
        var result=new ArrayList<String>();for(var e:scan(root,()->false,false).entries.entrySet())if(!e.getValue().directory&&com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.ProjectPath.valid(e.getKey()))result.add(e.getKey());return List.copyOf(result);
    }
    public static List<String> folders(Path root)throws IOException{
        var result=new ArrayList<String>();for(var e:scan(root,()->false,false).entries.entrySet())if(e.getValue().directory&&com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.ProjectPath.valid(e.getKey()))result.add(e.getKey());return List.copyOf(result);
    }
    private static MessageDigest digest(){
        try{return MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");}
        catch(NoSuchAlgorithmException impossible){throw new AssertionError("SHA-256 is required by Java",impossible);}
    }
    private static String transfer(Path input,OutputStream output,long expected,String expectedHash,BooleanSupplier stop)throws IOException{
        MessageDigest hash=digest();long count=0;
        try(var in=Files.newInputStream(input,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)){
            byte[] buffer=new byte[64*1024];int n;
            while((n=in.read(buffer))!=-1){
                cancelled(stop);count+=n;
                if(count>expected||count>MAX_FILE_BYTES)throw new IOException("File changed or size limit exceeded: "+input.getFileName());
                hash.update(buffer,0,n);output.write(buffer,0,n);
            }
        }
        cancelled(stop);
        if(count!=expected)throw new IOException("File changed while reading: "+input.getFileName());
        String value=HexFormat.of().formatHex(hash.digest());
        if(expectedHash!=null&&!expectedHash.equals(value))throw new IOException("File content changed while copying/exporting: "+input.getFileName());
        return value;
    }
    private static String text(byte[] data)throws IOException{return StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newDecoder().onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT).decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(data)).toString().replace("\r\n","\n").replace('\r','\n');}
    public static Path export(Path project,Path exports,String id,Map<String,Edit> edits,byte[] metadata)throws IOException{
        if(!SourceProjects.validProject(id)||metadata==null||metadata.length>4096)throw new IOException("Invalid export project id or metadata");
        Objects.requireNonNull(edits);
        Snapshot snapshot=scan(project,()->false,true);for(String path:edits.keySet())if(!editable(path)||!snapshot.entries.containsKey(path)||snapshot.entries.get(path).directory)throw new IOException("Missing editable file: "+path);
        Files.createDirectories(exports);Path temporary=Files.createTempFile(exports,".export-",".tmp"),target=exports.resolve(id+"-"+UUID.randomUUID()+".zip");
        long[] total={0};
        try{
            try(var out=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(temporary),StandardCharsets.UTF_8)){
                ZipEntry manifest=new ZipEntry("genesis-project.properties");manifest.setTime(0);out.putNextEntry(manifest);out.write(metadata);out.closeEntry();
                for(var e:snapshot.entries.entrySet()){
                    String path=e.getKey();boolean dir=e.getValue().directory;var entry=new ZipEntry(path+(dir?"/":""));entry.setTime(0);out.putNextEntry(entry);
                    if(!dir){Edit edit=edits.get(path);if(edit!=null){
                        if(edit.text==null||edit.text.length()>SourceProjects.MAX_BYTES)throw new IOException("Draft size limit: "+path);
                        byte[] disk;try(var input=Files.newInputStream(project.resolve(path),LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)){disk=input.readNBytes(SourceProjects.MAX_BYTES+1);}
                        if(disk.length>SourceProjects.MAX_BYTES||!HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest().digest(disk)).equals(e.getValue().sha256)||!text(disk).equals(edit.baseline))throw new IOException("Source changed outside Scripts: "+path);
                        byte[] data=disk;
                        if(!edit.text.equals(edit.baseline)){ByteBuffer encoded=StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newEncoder().onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT).encode(java.nio.CharBuffer.wrap(edit.text));data=new byte[encoded.remaining()];encoded.get(data);}
                        if(data.length>SourceProjects.MAX_BYTES)throw new IOException("Draft exceeds 4 MiB: "+path);out.write(data);total[0]+=data.length;
                    }else{transfer(project.resolve(path),out,e.getValue().size,e.getValue().sha256,()->false);total[0]+=e.getValue().size;}
                    if(total[0]>MAX_TOTAL_BYTES)throw new IOException("Export exceeds 128 MiB");}out.closeEntry();
                }
            }
            unchanged(project,snapshot,()->false);
            byte[] current;try(var input=Files.newInputStream(project.resolve("genesis-project.properties"),LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)){current=input.readNBytes(4097);}
            if(!Arrays.equals(metadata,current))throw new IOException("Project metadata changed while exporting");
            Files.move(temporary,target,StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);return target;
        }finally{Files.deleteIfExists(temporary);}
    }

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\scripts\GradleTasks.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;

import java.util.*;

/** Bounded parser for plain Gradle tasks --all output; never executes project code. */
public final class GradleTasks {
    public static final int MAX_TASKS=512,MAX_CHARS=256*1024,MAX_LINE=2048;
    public record Task(String path,String description,String group) {
        public Task {Objects.requireNonNull(description);Objects.requireNonNull(group);if(!GradleBuildRunner.validTask(path))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported Gradle task path");}
    }
    public record Catalog(List<Task> tasks,boolean limited) {
        public Catalog {tasks=List.copyOf(tasks);}
        public List<Task> filter(String query) {
            String q=Objects.requireNonNullElse(query,"").strip().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if(q.isEmpty())return tasks;
            String[] words=q.split("\\s+");return tasks.stream().filter(t->{String hay=(t.path()+" "+t.description()+" "+t.group()).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);for(String word:words)if(!hay.contains(word))return false;return true;}).toList();
        }
    }
    private GradleTasks() {}
    public static Catalog parse(String output,boolean outputTruncated) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(output);boolean limited=outputTruncated||output.length()>MAX_CHARS;
        String text=output.substring(0,Math.min(output.length(),MAX_CHARS)).replaceAll("\u001B\\[[0-9;?]*[ -/]*[@-~]","");
        var found=new LinkedHashMap<String,Task>();String heading="",group="";
        for(String raw:text.split("\\R",-1)) {
            if(raw.length()>MAX_LINE){limited=true;heading="";group="";continue;}
            String line=raw.strip();
            if(line.matches("-{3,}")) {String h=heading.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);group=h.endsWith(" tasks")||h.equals("tasks")||h.startsWith("задачи ")||h.endsWith(" задачи")?heading:"";heading="";continue;}
            if(line.isEmpty()){heading="";continue;}
            if(!group.isEmpty()) {
                int separator=line.indexOf(" - ");String path=separator<0?line:line.substring(0,separator);
                if(GradleBuildRunner.validTask(path)) {
                    Task t=new Task(path,separator<0?"":line.substring(separator+3),group);
                    if(found.containsKey(path)){if(found.get(path).description().isEmpty())found.put(path,t);}
                    else if(found.size()<MAX_TASKS)found.put(path,t);else limited=true;
                    heading="";continue;
                }
            }
            heading=line;group="";
        }
        return new Catalog(found.values().stream().sorted(Comparator.comparing(Task::path)).toList(),limited);
    }
}

package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.jar.*;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
/** Archive structure and explicit classpath only; nested JARs are resolved separately. */
public final class JarInspection  {
    private JarInspection() {
    }
    public record Info(boolean mod,boolean embedded,String entry,List<String> modIds,long expandedBytes) {
    }
    public static Map<String,String> modVersions(Path file)throws IOException {
        var result=new LinkedHashMap<String,String>();
        try(var jar=new JarFile(file.toFile(),false)) {
            var entry=jar.getJarEntry("META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml");
            if(entry==null)return result;
            String text;
            try(var in=jar.getInputStream(entry)) {
                byte[] b=in.readNBytes(256*1024+1);
                if(b.length>256*1024)throw new IOException("Mod metadata size limit");
                text=new String(b,java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            }
            String id="",version="",table="";
            char multiline=0;
            for(String raw:text.split("\\R")) {
                String line=DependencySyntax.uncomment(raw);
                if(multiline!=0) {
                    if(raw.contains(String.valueOf(multiline).repeat(3)))multiline=0;
                    continue;
                }
                int literal=line.indexOf(String.valueOf((char)39).repeat(3)),basic=line.indexOf(String.valueOf((char)34).repeat(3));
                if(literal>=0||basic>=0) {
                    char q=literal>=0?(char)39:(char)34;
                    String mark=String.valueOf(q).repeat(3);
                    int start=line.indexOf(mark);
                    if(line.indexOf(mark,start+3)<0)multiline=q;
                    continue;
                }
                if(line.startsWith("[")) {
                    if(table.equals("[[mods]]")&&!id.isEmpty()) {
                        if(result.putIfAbsent(id,version)!=null)throw new IOException("Duplicate modId in archive: "+id);
                    }
                    id="";
                    version="";
                    table=line;
                    continue;
                }
                if(!table.equals("[[mods]]"))continue;
                var m=java.util.regex.Pattern.compile("^(modId|version)\\s*=\\s*(['\"]).*\\2$").matcher(line);
                if(m.matches()) {
                    String value=DependencySyntax.string(line.substring(line.indexOf('=')+1));
                    if(m.group(1).equals("modId"))id=value;
                    else version=value;
                }
            }
            if(table.equals("[[mods]]")&&!id.isEmpty())if(result.putIfAbsent(id,version)!=null)throw new IOException("Duplicate modId in archive: "+id);
            var manifest=jar.getManifest();
            String implementation=manifest==null?"":Objects.toString(manifest.getMainAttributes().getValue("Implementation-Version"),"");
            result.replaceAll((key,value)->value.equals("${file.jarVersion}")?implementation:value);
        }
        return Collections.unmodifiableMap(result);
    }
    public static Info inspect(Path file,BooleanSupplier cancelled)throws IOException {return inspect(file,cancelled,true,512L*1024*1024);}
    static Info inspect(Path file,BooleanSupplier cancelled,boolean metadata)throws IOException {return inspect(file,cancelled,metadata,512L*1024*1024);}
    public static Info inspect(Path file,BooleanSupplier cancelled,long remaining)throws IOException {return inspect(file,cancelled,true,remaining);}
    private static Info inspect(Path file,BooleanSupplier cancelled,boolean metadata,long remaining)throws IOException {
        long expanded=0;
        int count=0;
        var names=new HashSet<String>();
        boolean embedded=false,mod=false;
        String entry="";
        List<String> ids=List.of();
        try(var jar=new JarFile(file.toFile(),false)) {
            var en=jar.entries();
            byte[] buffer=new byte[65536];
            while(en.hasMoreElements()) {
                if(cancelled.getAsBoolean()||Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted())throw new IOException("Archive inspection cancelled");
                var e=en.nextElement();
                String n=e.getName();
                if(++count>20000||!names.add(n)||n.startsWith("/")||n.contains("\\")||n.contains(":")||Arrays.stream(n.split("/")).anyMatch(p->p.equals("..")||p.equals(".")))throw new IOException("Invalid or excessive archive entries: "+file.getFileName());
                if(e.isDirectory())continue;
                long size=0;
                try(var in=jar.getInputStream(e)) {
                    int k;
                    while((k=in.read(buffer))!=-1) {
                        if(cancelled.getAsBoolean())throw new IOException("Archive inspection cancelled");
                        size+=k;
                        expanded+=k;
                        if(size>256L*1024*1024||expanded>remaining)throw new IOException("Expanded archive limit: "+n);
                    }
                }
                if(n.equals("META-INF/jarjar/metadata.json"))embedded=true;
                if(metadata&&n.equals("META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml")) {
                    if(size>256*1024)throw new IOException("Mod metadata size limit");
                    try(var in=jar.getInputStream(e)) {
                        String text=new String(in.readAllBytes(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                        ids=List.copyOf(DependencySyntax.modIds(text).getOrDefault("mods",List.of()));
                        if(ids.isEmpty())throw new IOException("No literal modId in packaged mod metadata");
                        for(String id:ids)if(!id.matches("[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}"))throw new IOException("Invalid packaged modId: "+id);
                        mod=true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if(count==0)throw new IOException("Empty JAR archive");
            var manifest=jar.getManifest();
            if(manifest!=null) {
                String cp=manifest.getMainAttributes().getValue("Class-Path");
                if(cp!=null&&!cp.isBlank())throw new IOException("Implicit Manifest Class-Path is unsupported; use explicit runtime libraries");
                entry=Objects.toString(manifest.getMainAttributes().getValue("Main-Class"),"");
            }
        }
        return new Info(mod,embedded,entry,ids,expanded);
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\scripts\JavaFileTemplate.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;

import java.util.Set;

/** Conservative conventional-source-root inference; custom Gradle sourceSets are not guessed. */
public final class JavaFileTemplate {
    private JavaFileTemplate() {}
    private static final Set<String> RESERVED=Set.of(
        "abstract","assert","boolean","break","byte","case","catch","char","class","const","continue",
        "default","do","double","else","enum","extends","final","finally","float","for","goto","if",
        "implements","import","instanceof","int","interface","long","native","new","package","private",
        "protected","public","return","short","static","strictfp","super","switch","synchronized","this",
        "throw","throws","transient","try","void","volatile","while","true","false","null","_",
        "var","yield","record","sealed","permits");
    private static boolean identifier(String value) {
        if(value.isEmpty()||RESERVED.contains(value))return false;
        int first=value.codePointAt(0);if(!Character.isJavaIdentifierStart(first))return false;
        for(int i=Character.charCount(first);i<value.length();) {
            int code=value.codePointAt(i);if(!Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(code))return false;i+=Character.charCount(code);
        }return true;
    }
    public static String source(String path) {
        if(path==null||!path.endsWith(".java"))return "";
        int slash=path.lastIndexOf('/');String name=path.substring(slash+1,path.length()-5);
        if(name.equals("module-info")||name.equals("package-info")||!identifier(name))return "";
        String prefix="";
        for(String root:new String[]{"src/main/java/","src/test/java/","src/","tests/"}) {
            if(path.startsWith(root)) {
                String folder=slash>=root.length()?path.substring(root.length(),slash):"";
                if(!folder.isEmpty()) {
                    String[] parts=folder.split("/",-1);boolean valid=true;
                    for(String part:parts)valid&=identifier(part);
                    if(valid)prefix="package "+String.join(".",parts)+";\n\n";
                }break;
            }
        }
        return prefix+"public class "+name+" {\n\n}\n";
    }
}

    static Map<String,byte[]> validated(Map<String,String> sources)throws IOException {
        if(sources==null||sources.isEmpty()||sources.size()>MAX_SOURCES)throw new IOException("Java source count must be 1..512");
        Map<String,byte[]> result=new TreeMap<>();Set<String> aliases=new HashSet<>();long total=0;
        for(var e:sources.entrySet()){

            if(b.length>SourceProjects.MAX_BYTES||(total+=b.length)>MAX_SOURCE_BYTES)throw new IOException("Java project exceeds source size limits");

        }
        return result;
    }

    static Map<String,byte[]> librarySnapshot(Map<String,byte[]> libraries)throws IOException {

        }

    }
    /** Inspect the same central-directory entries that javac/java will read. No class loading. */
    static long verifyLibrary(Path path,long remaining,Cancellation cancellation)throws IOException {
        long expanded=0;int count=0,manifests=0;Set<String> names=new HashSet<>();
        try(var jar=new java.util.jar.JarFile(path.toFile(),false)){
            var entries=jar.entries();byte[] buffer=new byte[8192];
            while(entries.hasMoreElements()){
                if(cancellation.cancelled())throw new IOException("Library inspection cancelled");
                var e=entries.nextElement();String name=e.getName();
                if(++count>4096||!names.add(name)||name.startsWith("/")||name.indexOf('\\')>=0||name.indexOf(':')>=0||Arrays.stream(name.split("/",-1)).anyMatch(part->part.equals("..")||part.equals(".")))throw new IOException("Invalid or excessive JAR entries: "+path.getFileName());
                if(name.equalsIgnoreCase("META-INF/INDEX.LIST"))throw new IOException("JAR indexes are unsupported; use explicit libraries: "+path.getFileName());
                if(name.equalsIgnoreCase("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF")&&++manifests>1)throw new IOException("Ambiguous JAR manifests: "+path.getFileName());
                if(e.isDirectory())continue;
                long fileBytes=0;int n;
                try(var in=jar.getInputStream(e)){while((n=in.read(buffer))!=-1){
                    if(cancellation.cancelled())throw new IOException("Library inspection cancelled");
                    fileBytes+=n;expanded+=n;
                    if(fileBytes>MAX_LIBRARY_BYTES||expanded>remaining||name.equalsIgnoreCase("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF")&&fileBytes>64*1024)throw new IOException("Expanded JAR size limit: "+path.getFileName());
                }}
            }
            if(count==0)throw new IOException("Empty library archive: "+path.getFileName());
            var manifest=jar.getManifest();
            if(manifest!=null){String cp=manifest.getMainAttributes().getValue(java.util.jar.Attributes.Name.CLASS_PATH);
                if(cp!=null&&!cp.isBlank())throw new IOException("Manifest Class-Path is unsupported; place every dependency explicitly in libraries: "+path.getFileName());}
        }
        return expanded;
    }
    public static boolean validResource(String name){return com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.ProjectPath.valid(name)&&!name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".class");}
    static Map<String,byte[]> resourceSnapshot(Map<String,byte[]> resources)throws IOException {
        if(resources==null||resources.size()>MAX_RESOURCES)throw new IOException("Resource count exceeds 512");
        Map<String,byte[]> result=new TreeMap<>();Map<String,String> spelling=new HashMap<>();Set<String> files=new HashSet<>(),folders=new HashSet<>();long total=0;
        for(var e:new TreeMap<>(resources).entrySet()){

            String prefix="";String[] parts=path.split("/");

                if(i<parts.length-1){if(files.contains(folded))throw new IOException("Resource file/directory conflict: "+prefix);folders.add(folded);}
                else{if(folders.contains(folded)||!files.add(folded))throw new IOException("Resource file/directory conflict: "+prefix);}
            }
            if(data==null||data.length>MAX_RESOURCE_BYTES||(total+=data.length)>MAX_RESOURCES_BYTES)throw new IOException("Resource size limit (8 MiB each / 32 MiB total)");
            result.put(path,data.clone());
        }

    }
    public Result run(Map<String,String> sources,String mainClass,Limits limits,Cancellation cancellation){

    public Result run(Map<String,String> sources,Map<String,byte[]> libraries,Map<String,byte[]> resources,String mainClass,Limits limits,Cancellation cancellation){
        Objects.requireNonNull(limits);Objects.requireNonNull(cancellation);Path scratch=null;String output="";
        try{
            if(cancellation.cancelled())return new Result(Status.CANCELLED,"prepare",-1,"");
            if(!validMainClass(mainClass))return new Result(Status.INPUT_ERROR,"prepare",-1,"Invalid main class");
            Map<String,byte[]> sourceBytes,libraryBytes,resourceBytes;
            try{sourceBytes=validated(sources);libraryBytes=librarySnapshot(libraries);resourceBytes=resourceSnapshot(resources);}catch(IOException e){return new Result(Status.INPUT_ERROR,"prepare",-1,e.getMessage());}
            if(!available())return new Result(Status.UNAVAILABLE,"prepare",-1,"Java runtime must include the jdk.compiler module (use a full JDK).");
            try{BuildTools.validateCompilerForHost(javaHome);}catch(IOException incompatible){return new Result(Status.INPUT_ERROR,"prepare",-1,incompatible.getMessage());}
            scratch=Files.createTempDirectory("genesis-java-");Path classes=Files.createDirectory(scratch.resolve("classes"));Path empty=Files.createDirectory(scratch.resolve("empty"));
            Path libs=Files.createDirectory(scratch.resolve("libraries"));var classpath=new ArrayList<String>();long expanded=0;
            for(var e:libraryBytes.entrySet()){
                if(cancellation.cancelled())return new Result(Status.CANCELLED,"prepare",-1,"");
                Path file=libs.resolve(e.getKey());Files.write(file,e.getValue());
                try{expanded+=verifyLibrary(file,128L*1024*1024-expanded,cancellation);}
                catch(IOException bad){return new Result(cancellation.cancelled()?Status.CANCELLED:Status.INPUT_ERROR,"prepare",-1,bad.getMessage());}
                classpath.add(file.toString());
            }
            String libraryPath=classpath.isEmpty()?empty.toString():String.join(File.pathSeparator,classpath);
            var compilerArgs=new ArrayList<String>(List.of("-encoding","UTF-8","-proc:none","-processorpath",empty.toString(),"-implicit:none","--release",Integer.toString(Runtime.version().feature()),"-classpath",libraryPath,"-sourcepath",scratch.resolve("src").toString(),"-d",classes.toString()));
            for(var e:sourceBytes.entrySet()){if(cancellation.cancelled())return new Result(Status.CANCELLED,"prepare",-1,"");Path file=scratch.resolve(e.getKey());Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());Files.write(file,e.getValue());compilerArgs.add(file.toString());}
            StringBuilder args=new StringBuilder();for(String arg:compilerArgs)args.append(argument(arg)).append('\n');
            Path argFile=scratch.resolve("javac.args");Files.writeString(argFile,args,StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            var compile=new ArrayList<String>(jvm(256));compile.addAll(List.of("-m","jdk.compiler/com.sun.tools.javac.Main","@"+argFile));
            cancellation.phase="compile";ProcessResult compiled=process(compile,scratch,limits.compileMillis,limits.outputBytes,cancellation);
            output=compiled.output;
            if(compiled.status!=Status.SUCCESS)return new Result(compiled.status==Status.RUNTIME_ERROR?Status.COMPILE_ERROR:compiled.status,"compile",compiled.exitCode,output);
            cancellation.phase="prepare";
            for(var e:resourceBytes.entrySet()){
                if(cancellation.cancelled())return new Result(Status.CANCELLED,"prepare",-1,output);
                Path file=classes.resolve(e.getKey());
                if(Files.exists(file))return new Result(Status.INPUT_ERROR,"prepare",-1,output+"Resource conflicts with compiled output: "+e.getKey());
                Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());Files.write(file,e.getValue(),StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
            }
            cancellation.phase="run";var launch=new ArrayList<String>(jvm(limits.memoryMiB));launch.addAll(List.of("-cp",classes+ (classpath.isEmpty()?"":File.pathSeparator+libraryPath),mainClass));
            ProcessResult executed=process(launch,scratch,limits.runMillis,limits.outputBytes,cancellation);
            return new Result(executed.status,"run",executed.exitCode,output+executed.output);
        }catch(InterruptedException e){Thread.currentThread().interrupt();cancellation.cancel();return new Result(Status.CANCELLED,cancellation.phase,-1,output);}
        catch(IOException|RuntimeException e){return new Result(Status.IO_ERROR,cancellation.phase,-1,output+e.getMessage());}
        finally{cancellation.phase="cleanup";if(scratch!=null)cleanup(scratch);cancellation.phase="finished";}
    }
    List<String> jvm(int memory){return List.of(executable().toString(),"-Xmx"+memory+"m","-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=96m","-XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError","-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8","-Dstdout.encoding=UTF-8","-Dstderr.encoding=UTF-8");}
    static ProcessResult process(List<String> command,Path directory,long timeout,int limit,Cancellation cancellation)throws IOException,InterruptedException {
        if(cancellation.cancelled())return new ProcessResult(Status.CANCELLED,-1,"");
        var builder=new ProcessBuilder(command).directory(directory.toFile()).redirectErrorStream(true);
        for(String key:List.of("JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS","_JAVA_OPTIONS","JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS","JDK_JAVAC_OPTIONS","CLASSPATH"))builder.environment().remove(key);
        Process child=builder.start();
        try{child.getOutputStream().close();}catch(IOException e){child.destroyForcibly();throw e;}
        Set<ProcessHandle> descendants=ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
        var bytes=new ByteArrayOutputStream(Math.min(limit,8192));var overflow=new AtomicBoolean();var readError=new AtomicReference<IOException>();
        Thread reader=new Thread(()->{try(InputStream in=child.getInputStream()){byte[] b=new byte[4096];int n;
            while((n=in.read(b))>=0){synchronized(bytes){int room=limit-bytes.size();if(n>room)overflow.set(true);if(room>0)bytes.write(b,0,Math.min(room,n));}if(overflow.get())break;}
        }catch(IOException e){readError.set(e);}},"Genesis Java output");reader.setDaemon(true);
        Thread shutdown=new Thread(()->terminate(child,descendants),"Genesis Java shutdown");boolean hook=false,descendantsAvailable=true;Status status=Status.SUCCESS;
        long deadline=System.nanoTime()+TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(timeout);
        try{
            Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(shutdown);hook=true;reader.start();
            while(true){
                if(descendantsAvailable)try(var stream=child.descendants()){stream.limit(1024).forEach(h->{if(descendants.size()<1024)descendants.add(h);});}catch(RuntimeException ignored){descendantsAvailable=false; /* Some hosts deny process-tree enumeration. */ }
                if(cancellation.cancelled()||Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()){status=Status.CANCELLED;break;}
                if(overflow.get()){status=Status.OUTPUT_LIMIT;break;}
                if(readError.get()!=null){status=Status.IO_ERROR;break;}
                if(!child.isAlive())break;
                if(System.nanoTime()>=deadline){status=Status.TIMEOUT;break;}
                child.waitFor(25,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
            }
        }finally{
            // Also remove ordinary descendants after successful main() completion.
            terminate(child,descendants);
            if(hook)try{Runtime.getRuntime().removeShutdownHook(shutdown);}catch(IllegalStateException ignored){}
            child.waitFor(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS);reader.join(1000);
            if(reader.isAlive()){child.getInputStream().close();reader.join(1000);}
        }
        int code=child.isAlive()?-1:child.exitValue();
        if(status==Status.SUCCESS){if(overflow.get())status=Status.OUTPUT_LIMIT;else if(readError.get()!=null)status=Status.IO_ERROR;else if(code!=0)status=Status.RUNTIME_ERROR;}
        String text;synchronized(bytes){text=bytes.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);}
        return new ProcessResult(status,code,text);
    }
    private static void terminate(Process process,Set<ProcessHandle> known){
        try(var stream=process.descendants()){stream.limit(1024).forEach(h->{if(known.size()<1024)known.add(h);if(h.isAlive())h.destroyForcibly();});}catch(RuntimeException ignored){}
        for(ProcessHandle handle:known)try{if(handle.isAlive())handle.destroyForcibly();}catch(RuntimeException ignored){}
        if(process.isAlive())process.destroyForcibly();
    }
    private static void cleanup(Path root){
        // Do not follow symlinks created by user code; cap work on an unexpectedly large tree.
        try(var stream=Files.walk(root)){var paths=stream.limit(4097).toList();if(paths.size()>4096)return;
            for(Path p:paths.stream().sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toList())Files.deleteIfExists(p);
        }catch(IOException|RuntimeException ignored){ /* A locked or oversized scratch directory may remain in the OS temp folder. */ }
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\scripts\NestedRuntimeJars.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.jar.*;
import java.util.regex.*;
/** Explicit Jar-in-Jar extraction. Snapshot paths, hashes and total bytes are bounded. */
final class NestedRuntimeJars  {
    private NestedRuntimeJars() {
    }
    static void expand(Collection<Path> mains,Path destination,List<Path> paths,JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation token,long[] expanded)throws IOException {
        var seen=new HashSet<String>();for(Path file:mains){String name=file.getFileName().toString();if(name.matches("[0-9a-f]{64}\\.jar"))seen.add(name.substring(0,64));}
        var identities=new HashMap<String,String>();for(Path main:List.copyOf(mains))walk(main,destination,paths,token,seen,expanded,identities,0);
    }
    private static void walk(Path file,Path dest,List<Path> paths,JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation token,Set<String> seen,long[] total,Map<String,String> identities,int depth)throws IOException {
        if(depth>8)throw new IOException("Jar-in-Jar nesting limit: 8");
        try(var jar=new JarFile(file.toFile(),false)) {
            var meta=jar.getJarEntry("META-INF/jarjar/metadata.json");
            if(meta==null)return;
            String text;
            try(var in=jar.getInputStream(meta)) {
                byte[] data=in.readNBytes(256*1024+1);
                if(data.length>256*1024)throw new IOException("Jar-in-Jar metadata limit");
                text=new String(data,java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            }
            Object parsed=new Json(text).parse();
            if(!(parsed instanceof Map<?,?> object)||!(object.get("jars") instanceof List<?> entries))throw new IOException("Invalid Jar-in-Jar metadata");
            if(entries.size()>128)throw new IOException("Jar-in-Jar entry limit: 128");
            for(Object e:entries) {
                if(token.cancelled())throw new IOException("Jar-in-Jar extraction cancelled");
                if(!(e instanceof Map<?,?> item)||!(item.get("path") instanceof String path)||!(item.get("identifier") instanceof Map<?,?> id)||!(id.get("group") instanceof String group)||!(id.get("artifact") instanceof String artifact)||!(item.get("version") instanceof Map<?,?> version)||!(version.get("artifactVersion") instanceof String actual)||!(version.get("range") instanceof String range)||!ProjectDependencies.validRange(range))throw new IOException("Invalid Jar-in-Jar entry metadata");
                if(!DependencySyntax.numericContains(range,actual))throw new IOException("Nested library version is outside its declared range: "+actual);
                String identity=group+":"+artifact;
                String prior=identities.putIfAbsent(identity,actual);
                if(prior!=null&&!prior.equals(actual))throw new IOException("Conflicting nested versions: "+identity);
                if(!path.startsWith("META-INF/jarjar/")||!path.endsWith(".jar")||path.contains("..")||path.contains("\\")||path.contains(":"))throw new IOException("Invalid nested JAR path: "+path);
                var entry=jar.getJarEntry(path);
                if(entry==null||entry.isDirectory())throw new IOException("Missing nested JAR: "+path);
                byte[] bytes;
                try(var in=jar.getInputStream(entry)) {
                    bytes=in.readNBytes(64*1024*1024+1);
                }
                if(bytes.length>64*1024*1024)throw new IOException("Nested JAR byte limit");
                String hash=GradleOutputs.hash(bytes);
                if(!seen.add(hash))continue;
                if(paths.size()>=128)throw new IOException("Runtime classpath limit: 128");
                Files.createDirectories(dest);
                Path nested=dest.resolve(hash+".jar");
                Files.write(nested,bytes,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
                total[0]+=JarInspection.inspect(nested,token::cancelled,512L*1024*1024-total[0]).expandedBytes();
                paths.add(nested);
                walk(nested,dest,paths,token,seen,total,identities,depth+1);
            }
        }
    }
    private static final class Json  {
        final String text;
        int at;
        Json(String text) {
            this.text=text;
        }
        Object parse()throws IOException {
            Object v=value(0);
            ws();
            if(at!=text.length())throw bad();
            return v;
        }
        IOException bad() {
            return new IOException("Malformed Jar-in-Jar JSON at "+at);
        }
        void ws() {
            while(at<text.length()&&Character.isWhitespace(text.charAt(at)))at++;
        }
        Object value(int depth)throws IOException {
            ws();
            if(depth>32||at>=text.length())throw bad();
            char c=text.charAt(at);
            if(c=='"')return string();
            if(c=='{') {
                at++;
                var map=new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
                ws();
                if(take('}'))return map;
                do {
                    ws();
                    String key=string();
                    ws();
                    if(!take(':')||map.containsKey(key))throw bad();
                    map.put(key,value(depth+1));
                    ws();
                    if(take('}'))return map;
                }
                while(take(','));
                throw bad();
            }
            if(c=='[') {
                at++;
                var list=new ArrayList<Object>();
                ws();
                if(take(']'))return list;
                do {
                    list.add(value(depth+1));
                    ws();
                    if(take(']'))return list;
                }
                while(take(','));
                throw bad();
            }
            for(String lit:List.of("true","false","null"))if(text.startsWith(lit,at)) {
                at+=lit.length();
                return lit.equals("true")?Boolean.TRUE:lit.equals("false")?Boolean.FALSE:null;
            }
            int start=at;
            while(at<text.length()&&"-+0123456789.eE".indexOf(text.charAt(at))>=0)at++;
            if(start==at)throw bad();
            String number=text.substring(start,at);
            if(!number.matches("-?(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\\.[0-9]+)?(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?"))throw bad();
            try {
                return new java.math.BigDecimal(number);
            }
            catch(NumberFormatException e) {
                throw bad();
            }
        }
        boolean take(char c) {
            if(at<text.length()&&text.charAt(at)==c) {
                at++;
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        String string()throws IOException {
            if(!take('"'))throw bad();
            var b=new StringBuilder();
            while(at<text.length()) {
                char c=text.charAt(at++);
                if(c=='"')return b.toString();
                if(c<32)throw bad();
                if(c=='\\') {
                    if(at>=text.length())throw bad();
                    char e=text.charAt(at++);
                    switch(e) {
                        case '"','\\','/'->b.append(e);
                        case 'b'->b.append('\b');
                        case 'f'->b.append('\f');
                        case 'n'->b.append('\n');
                        case 'r'->b.append('\r');
                        case 't'->b.append('\t');
                        case 'u'-> {
                            if(at+4>text.length())throw bad();
                            try {
                                b.append((char)Integer.parseInt(text.substring(at,at+4),16));
                            }
                            catch(NumberFormatException n) {
                                throw bad();
                            }
                            at+=4;
                        }
                        default->throw bad();
                    }
                }
                else b.append(c);
            }
            throw bad();
        }
    }
}

package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;
import java.io.*;import java.net.URI;import java.util.*;import java.util.regex.*;
/** Validated project dependencies; pure rendering, no downloads or script execution. */
public final class ProjectDependencies {
 public static final String CONFIG="genesis-dependencies.properties",SCRIPT="genesis-dependencies.gradle",TOML="src/main/resources/META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml";
 public static final List<String> FILES=List.of("build.gradle",CONFIG,SCRIPT,TOML);
 private static final String BEGIN="// BEGIN GENESIS DEPENDENCIES",END="// END GENESIS DEPENDENCIES",TB="# BEGIN GENESIS DEPENDENCIES",TE="# END GENESIS DEPENDENCIES";
 public enum Mode{LIBRARY,COMPILE_ONLY,EMBED,MOD}
 public record Dependency(Mode mode,String coordinate,String modId,String range,String type,String side){
  public Dependency{Objects.requireNonNull(mode);if(!validCoordinate(coordinate))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Use group:artifact:version (fixed version, optional classifier)");
   if(mode==Mode.MOD){if((modId==null||!modId.matches("[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}"))||Set.of("minecraft","neoforge").contains(modId)||!validRange(range)||!Set.of("required","optional").contains(type)||!Set.of("BOTH","CLIENT","SERVER").contains(side))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid mod ID, version range, dependency type or side");}
   else if(!"".equals(modId)||!("".equals(range)||mode==Mode.EMBED&&validRange(range))||!"".equals(type)||!"".equals(side))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Library has mod metadata");
   if(mode==Mode.EMBED&&!range.isEmpty()&&!DependencySyntax.numericContains(range,coordinate.split(":")[2]))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Preferred library version is outside the embedding range");
   if(mode==Mode.EMBED&&coordinate.split(":").length!=3)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Embedded dependencies require group:artifact:version");
  }
  public String key(){String[] p=coordinate.split(":");return p[0]+":"+p[1]+(p.length==4?":"+p[3]:"");}
  public static Dependency embedded(String coordinate,String range){return new Dependency(Mode.EMBED,coordinate,"",range,"","");}
  public static Dependency library(Mode mode,String coordinate){return new Dependency(mode,coordinate,"","","","");}
 }
 public record Config(List<Dependency> dependencies,List<String> repositories,boolean localLibraries){
  public Config{dependencies=List.copyOf(dependencies);repositories=List.copyOf(repositories);if(dependencies.size()>64||repositories.size()>16)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Dependency count limit");var keys=new HashSet<String>();var mods=new HashSet<String>();for(var d:dependencies){if(!keys.add(d.key())||d.mode()==Mode.MOD&&!mods.add(d.modId()))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate dependency");}var urls=new HashSet<String>();for(String r:repositories)if(!validRepository(r)||!urls.add(r))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid or duplicate HTTPS Maven repository");}
  public Config add(Dependency d){var list=new ArrayList<>(dependencies);list.add(d);return new Config(list,repositories,localLibraries);}
  public Config remove(int index){var list=new ArrayList<>(dependencies);list.remove(index);return new Config(list,repositories,localLibraries);}
  public Config repository(String url){var list=new ArrayList<>(repositories);list.add(url);return new Config(dependencies,list,localLibraries);}
 }
 public record State(Map<String,String> files){public State{files=Map.copyOf(files);}public Config config()throws IOException{return parse(files.getOrDefault(CONFIG,""));}}
 private ProjectDependencies(){}
 public static boolean validCoordinate(String s){return s!=null&&s.length()<=256&&s.matches("[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*(?::[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)?")&&!s.split(":")[2].toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("SNAPSHOT")&&!s.split(":")[2].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith("latest.");}
 public static boolean validRange(String s){return DependencySyntax.validRange(s);}
 public static boolean validRepository(String s){try{var u=URI.create(s);return s.length()<=1024&&s.matches("[A-Za-z0-9:/._%~-]+")&&"https".equals(u.getScheme())&&u.getHost()!=null&&u.getUserInfo()==null&&u.getQuery()==null&&u.getFragment()==null;}catch(RuntimeException bad){return false;}}
 public static Config parse(String text)throws IOException{
  if(text.isEmpty())return new Config(List.of(),List.of(),false);if(text.length()>32768)throw new IOException("Dependency configuration limit");var values=new Properties(){@Override public synchronized Object put(Object key,Object value){if(containsKey(key))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate declaration");return super.put(key,value);}};
  try{values.load(new StringReader(text));if(!"1".equals(values.getProperty("format")))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported dependency format");String local=values.getProperty("localLibraries","false");if(!Set.of("true","false").contains(local))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid localLibraries value");var deps=new TreeMap<Integer,Dependency>();var repos=new TreeMap<Integer,String>();
   for(String key:values.stringPropertyNames()){if(key.equals("format")||key.equals("localLibraries"))continue;if(key.matches("repository\\.[0-9]{1,2}")){int n=Integer.parseInt(key.substring(11));if(n>=16||repos.putIfAbsent(n,values.getProperty(key))!=null)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid repository index");}
    else if(key.matches("dependency\\.[0-9]{1,2}")){int n=Integer.parseInt(key.substring(11));String[] p=values.getProperty(key).split("\\|",-1);if(p.length!=6||n>=64||deps.putIfAbsent(n,new Dependency(Mode.valueOf(p[0]),p[1],p[2],p[3],p[4],p[5]))!=null)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid dependency index");}else throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown declaration");}
   if(!deps.isEmpty()&&deps.lastKey()!=deps.size()-1||!repos.isEmpty()&&repos.lastKey()!=repos.size()-1)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dependency/repository index");return new Config(new ArrayList<>(deps.values()),new ArrayList<>(repos.values()),Boolean.parseBoolean(local));
  }catch(IllegalArgumentException bad){throw new IOException("Malformed dependencies: "+bad.getMessage(),bad);}
 }
 public static String encode(Config c){var s=new StringBuilder("# Managed by Genesis dependency manager\nformat=1\nlocalLibraries="+c.localLibraries()+"\n");for(int i=0;i<c.repositories().size();i++)s.append("repository.").append(i).append('=').append(c.repositories().get(i)).append('\n');for(int i=0;i<c.dependencies().size();i++){var d=c.dependencies().get(i);s.append("dependency.").append(i).append('=').append(d.mode()).append('|').append(d.coordinate()).append('|').append(d.modId()).append('|').append(d.range()).append('|').append(d.type()).append('|').append(d.side()).append('\n');}if(s.length()>32768)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Dependency configuration exceeds 32 KiB");return s.toString();}
 private static String without(String text,String begin,String end)throws IOException{
  int a=text.indexOf(begin),b=text.indexOf(end);if(a<0&&b<0)return text;if(a<0||b<a||text.indexOf(begin,a+begin.length())>=0||text.indexOf(end,b+end.length())>=0)throw new IOException("Broken or duplicate Genesis managed block");return text.substring(0,a)+text.substring(b+end.length()).replaceFirst("^\\r?\\n","");
 }
 public static void verifyResolved(Config config,Collection<java.nio.file.Path> jars)throws IOException{var versions=new HashMap<String,String>();for(var file:jars)for(var e:JarInspection.modVersions(file).entrySet()){String old=versions.putIfAbsent(e.getKey(),e.getValue());if(old!=null&&!old.equals(e.getValue()))throw new IOException("Conflicting resolved mod versions: "+e.getKey());}for(var d:config.dependencies())if(d.mode()==Mode.MOD){String actual=versions.get(d.modId());if(actual==null){if(d.type().equals("required"))throw new IOException("Resolved artifact does not provide required modId: "+d.modId());continue;}if(actual.isBlank()||actual.contains("${"))throw new IOException("Cannot verify resolved mod version: "+d.modId());if(!DependencySyntax.numericContains(d.range(),actual))throw new IOException("Resolved mod "+d.modId()+" version "+actual+" is outside "+d.range());}}
 public static Map<String,String> render(State state,Config c)throws IOException{
  String build=state.files().get("build.gradle");if(build==null)throw new IOException("Dependency manager requires build.gradle (Groovy)");
  String toml=state.files().get(TOML);boolean neo=DependencySyntax.neo(build);if(c.dependencies().stream().anyMatch(d->d.mode()==Mode.MOD||d.mode()==Mode.EMBED)&&(!neo||toml==null))throw new IOException("Mod dependencies and embedding require a NeoGradle NeoForge project");
  Config old=state.config();String existing=state.files().get(SCRIPT);if(existing!=null&&!existing.equals(script(old,neo))&&!existing.equals(legacyScript(old,neo)))throw new IOException("Managed dependency script changed externally; preserve edits before updating");
  without(build,BEGIN,END);
  String owned=BEGIN+"\napply from: '"+SCRIPT+"'\n"+END;
  if(build.contains(BEGIN)&&!build.substring(build.indexOf(BEGIN),build.indexOf(END)+END.length()).equals(owned))throw new IOException("Managed build block changed externally");
  String manual=without(build,BEGIN,END);for(var d:c.dependencies())if(DependencySyntax.declares(manual,d.coordinate()))throw new IOException("Dependency is already declared manually: "+d.key());if(DependencySyntax.gradle(manual).contains("genesis-dependencies.gradle"))throw new IOException("Dependency script is already applied outside managed block");
  var out=new LinkedHashMap<String,String>();out.put("build.gradle",manual+(manual.endsWith("\n")?"":"\n")+BEGIN+"\napply from: '"+SCRIPT+"'\n"+END+"\n");out.put(CONFIG,encode(c));out.put(SCRIPT,script(c,neo));
  if(toml!=null){String original=without(toml,TB,TE);var ids=DependencySyntax.modIds(original);int mods=ids.getOrDefault("mods",List.of()).size();String id=mods==1?ids.get("mods").get(0):"";
   if(mods!=1&&!c.dependencies().stream().filter(d->d.mode()==Mode.MOD).toList().isEmpty())throw new IOException("Exactly one mod declaration is required for automatic dependency metadata");if(toml.contains(TB)){int a=toml.indexOf(TB),b=toml.indexOf(TE);if(b<a||!toml.substring(a,b+TE.length()).equals(modBlock(old,id)))throw new IOException("Managed mod metadata changed externally");}
   var tail=new StringBuilder(TB+"\n");
   for(var d:c.dependencies())if(d.mode()==Mode.MOD){if(d.modId().equals(id))throw new IOException("A mod cannot depend on itself");if(ids.entrySet().stream().filter(e->e.getKey().startsWith("dependencies.")).anyMatch(e->e.getValue().contains(d.modId())))throw new IOException("Mod dependency is already declared manually: "+d.modId());tail.append("[[dependencies.").append(id).append("]]\nmodId=\"").append(d.modId()).append("\"\ntype=\"").append(d.type()).append("\"\nversionRange=\"").append(d.range()).append("\"\nordering=\"NONE\"\nside=\"").append(d.side()).append("\"\n");}
   out.put(TOML,original+(original.endsWith("\n")?"":"\n")+tail+TE+"\n");}
  return Collections.unmodifiableMap(out);
 }
 private static String modBlock(Config c,String owner){var s=new StringBuilder(TB+"\n");for(var d:c.dependencies())if(d.mode()==Mode.MOD)s.append("[[dependencies.").append(owner).append("]]\nmodId=\"").append(d.modId()).append("\"\ntype=\"").append(d.type()).append("\"\nversionRange=\"").append(d.range()).append("\"\nordering=\"NONE\"\nside=\"").append(d.side()).append("\"\n");return s.append(TE).toString();}
 static String script(Config c,boolean neo){
  var s=new StringBuilder("// Generated by Genesis; edit through the dependency manager\nrepositories {\n    mavenCentral()\n");for(String r:c.repositories())s.append("    maven { url = uri('").append(r).append("') }\n");s.append("}\ndependencies {\n");if(c.localLibraries())s.append("    implementation fileTree(dir: 'libraries', includes: ['*.jar', '*.JAR'])\n");

 } private static String legacyScript(Config c,boolean neo){
