package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;
/** Capability for other systems: disk-backed project discovery and reads, no write methods. */
public final class ProjectReadView {
 private final SourceProjects projects;
 public ProjectReadView(SourceProjects projects){this.projects=java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(projects);}
 public record Snapshot(SourceProjects.Project project,List<String> files,List<String> folders){public Snapshot{files=List.copyOf(files);folders=List.copyOf(folders);}}
 public SourceProjects.Catalog catalog()throws IOException{return projects.list();}
 public Snapshot snapshot(String id)throws IOException{synchronized(projects){return new Snapshot(projects.project(id),projects.entries(id),projects.folders(id));}}
 public byte[] asset(String id,String path)throws IOException{return projects.asset(id,path);}
 public String text(String id,String path)throws IOException{return projects.read(id,path);}
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\scripts\RuntimeModuleCompiler.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.server.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.jar.*;

/** Bounded child javac; immutable snapshot, no user classes loaded while compiling. */
public final class RuntimeModuleCompiler {
    public record Prepared(RuntimeBundle bundle,String diagnostics) {}
    private RuntimeModuleCompiler() {}
    public static byte[] apiJar() throws IOException {
        var bytes=new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try(var jar=new JarOutputStream(bytes)) {
            for(Class<?> type:List.of(ServerModule.class,ServerContext.class,ServerContext.Subscription.class)) {
                String name=type.getName().replace('.','/')+".class";
                try(var in=type.getResourceAsStream("/"+name)) {
                    if(in==null)throw new IOException("Packaged runtime API missing: "+name);
                    var entry=new JarEntry(name);entry.setTime(0);jar.putNextEntry(entry);in.transferTo(jar);jar.closeEntry();
                }
            }
        }
        return bytes.toByteArray();
    }
    private static void entry(String name) throws IOException {
        if(!JavaSourceRunner.validMainClass(name)||RuntimeBundle.protectedName(name))throw new IOException("Use your own ServerModule entry class");
    }
    private static List<Path> libraries(Path root,Map<String,byte[]> libraries,JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation token,long remaining) throws IOException {
        var result=new ArrayList<Path>();long expanded=0;
        Path folder=Files.createDirectory(root.resolve("libraries"));
        for(var e:JavaSourceRunner.librarySnapshot(libraries).entrySet()) {
            if(token.cancelled())throw new IOException("Compilation cancelled");
            Path file=folder.resolve(e.getKey());Files.write(file,e.getValue());
            expanded+=JavaSourceRunner.verifyLibrary(file,remaining-expanded,token);result.add(file);
        }
        return result;
    }
    public static Prepared compile(Map<String,String> sources,Map<String,byte[]> libraries,Map<String,byte[]> resources,String entry,JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation token) throws IOException,InterruptedException {
        return compile(sources,libraries,resources,entry,token,Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home")));
    }
    public static Prepared compile(Map<String,String> sources,Map<String,byte[]> libraries,Map<String,byte[]> resources,String entry,JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation token,Path javaHome) throws IOException,InterruptedException {
        RuntimeBundle.retryCleanup();BuildTools.validateCompilerForHost(javaHome);entry(entry);if(token.cancelled())throw new IOException("Compilation cancelled");
        var inputs=JavaSourceRunner.validated(sources);var assets=JavaSourceRunner.resourceSnapshot(resources);
        var runner=new JavaSourceRunner(javaHome);if(!runner.available())throw new IOException("Client Java needs full JDK with jdk.compiler");
        Path root=Files.createTempDirectory("genesis-server-module-");RuntimeBundle bundle=null;
        try {
            Path classes=Files.createDirectory(root.resolve("classes")),empty=Files.createDirectory(root.resolve("empty"));
            var jars=libraries(root,libraries,token,128L*1024*1024);Path api=root.resolve("genesis-server-api.jar");Files.write(api,apiJar());
            var cp=new ArrayList<String>();cp.add(api.toString());jars.forEach(p->cp.add(p.toString()));
            var args=new ArrayList<String>(List.of("-encoding","UTF-8","-proc:none","-processorpath",empty.toString(),"-implicit:none","--release",Integer.toString(Runtime.version().feature()),"-classpath",String.join(File.pathSeparator,cp),"-sourcepath",root.resolve("src").toString(),"-d",classes.toString()));
            for(var e:inputs.entrySet()){Path file=root.resolve(e.getKey());Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());Files.write(file,e.getValue());args.add(file.toString());}
            var text=new StringBuilder();for(String arg:args)text.append(JavaSourceRunner.argument(arg)).append('\n');
            Path arguments=root.resolve("javac.args");Files.writeString(arguments,text,StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            var command=new ArrayList<>(runner.jvm(256));command.addAll(List.of("-m","jdk.compiler/com.sun.tools.javac.Main","@"+arguments));
            var result=JavaSourceRunner.process(command,root,20_000,64*1024,token);
            if(result.status()!=JavaSourceRunner.Status.SUCCESS)throw new IOException("Runtime compilation "+(result.status()==JavaSourceRunner.Status.RUNTIME_ERROR?JavaSourceRunner.Status.COMPILE_ERROR:result.status())+":\n"+result.output());
            int count=0;long size=0;try(var stream=Files.walk(classes)){var entries=stream.filter(Files::isRegularFile).iterator();while(entries.hasNext()){Path file=entries.next();
                if(++count>10000||(size+=Files.size(file))>64L*1024*1024)throw new IOException("Compiled runtime output limit");
                String name=classes.relativize(file).toString().replace(File.separatorChar,'.');
                if(name.endsWith(".class")&&RuntimeBundle.protectedName(name.substring(0,name.length()-6)))throw new IOException("Runtime cannot replace host/API classes: "+name);
            }}
            for(var e:assets.entrySet()){Path file=classes.resolve(e.getKey());if(Files.exists(file))throw new IOException("Resource/output conflict: "+e.getKey());Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());Files.write(file,e.getValue());}
            if(token.cancelled())throw new IOException("Compilation cancelled");
            var paths=new ArrayList<Path>();paths.add(classes);paths.addAll(jars);bundle=new RuntimeBundle(root,paths,entry);return new Prepared(bundle,result.output());
        } finally {if(bundle==null)cleanup(root);}
    }
    /** An already verified build artifact is copied again; deployment never runs a mutable build output. */
    public static Prepared fromJar(byte[] jarBytes,Map<String,byte[]> libraries,String entry,JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation token) throws IOException {
        RuntimeBundle.retryCleanup();entry(entry);if(jarBytes==null||jarBytes.length<1||jarBytes.length>64*1024*1024)throw new IOException("Runtime JAR limit: 64 MiB");
        Path root=Files.createTempDirectory("genesis-server-jar-");RuntimeBundle bundle=null;
        try {
            Path main=root.resolve("module.jar");Files.write(main,jarBytes);
            long[] expanded={JarInspection.inspect(main,token::cancelled).expandedBytes()};
            if(token.cancelled())throw new IOException("Deployment cancelled");
            var paths=new ArrayList<Path>();paths.add(main);paths.addAll(runtimeLibraries(root,libraries,token,expanded));NestedRuntimeJars.expand(List.copyOf(paths),root.resolve("nested"),paths,token,expanded);
            bundle=new RuntimeBundle(root,paths,entry);return new Prepared(bundle,"");
        } finally {if(bundle==null)cleanup(root);}
    }
    private static List<Path> runtimeLibraries(Path root,Map<String,byte[]> libraries,JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation token,long[] expanded)throws IOException{if(libraries==null||libraries.size()>128)throw new IOException("Runtime library count limit: 128");var out=new ArrayList<Path>();Path folder=Files.createDirectory(root.resolve("libraries"));long total=0;var hashes=new HashSet<String>();for(var e:libraries.entrySet()){if(token.cancelled())throw new IOException("Runtime library preparation cancelled");byte[] bytes=e.getValue();if(bytes==null||bytes.length>64*1024*1024||(total+=bytes.length)>512L*1024*1024)throw new IOException("Runtime libraries size limit");String hash=GradleOutputs.hash(bytes);if(!hashes.add(hash))continue;Path file=folder.resolve(hash+".jar");Files.write(file,bytes);expanded[0]+=JarInspection.inspect(file,token::cancelled,512L*1024*1024-expanded[0]).expandedBytes();out.add(file);}return out;}
    private static void cleanup(Path root){new RuntimeBundle(root,List.of(root),"genesis.cleanup.Entry").close();}
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\scripts\ScriptSearch.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.editor.DocumentSearch;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
import java.io.IOException;

/** Snapshot adapter over the shared literal search engine; never reads project files. */
public final class ScriptSearch {
    public static final int MAX_QUERY=DocumentSearch.MAX_QUERY,MAX_HITS=DocumentSearch.MAX_RESULTS;
    public record Hit(String path,int line,int column,int length,String preview) {}
    public record Result(List<Hit> hits,boolean limited,Map<String,String> errors) {
        public Result{hits=List.copyOf(hits);errors=Map.copyOf(errors);}
        public Result(List<Hit> hits,boolean limited){this(hits,limited,Map.of());}
    }
    private ScriptSearch() {}
    private static void check(BooleanSupplier cancelled){if(cancelled.getAsBoolean()||Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted())throw new java.util.concurrent.CancellationException();}
    private static Result convert(DocumentSearch.Result result){return new Result(result.hits().stream().map(h->new Hit(h.path(),h.line(),h.column(),h.matchedText().length(),h.preview())).toList(),result.limited(),result.errors());}
    public static Result files(List<String> paths,String query,BooleanSupplier cancelled) {
        check(cancelled);
        if(query.isEmpty())return new Result(paths.stream().limit(DocumentSearch.MAX_FILES).map(p->new Hit(p,-1,0,0,p)).toList(),paths.size()>DocumentSearch.MAX_FILES);
        try {return convert(DocumentSearch.search(paths,p->"",query,DocumentSearch.Mode.PATH,false,cancelled));}
        catch(IOException impossible){throw new IllegalStateException(impossible);}
    }
    public static Result project(List<String> paths,DocumentSearch.Reader reader,String query,BooleanSupplier cancelled) throws IOException {
        return convert(DocumentSearch.search(paths,reader,query,DocumentSearch.Mode.CONTENT,false,cancelled));
    }
    public static Result text(String path,String source,String query,BooleanSupplier cancelled) {
        check(cancelled);if(source.length()>4*1024*1024)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Document snapshot too large");
        try {return convert(DocumentSearch.search(List.of(path),p->source,query,DocumentSearch.Mode.CONTENT,false,cancelled));}
        catch(IOException impossible){throw new IllegalStateException(impossible);}
    }
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\scripts\SourceProjects.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.RepositoryPath;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.charset.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.security.*;
import java.util.*;

/** Local source projects only. No compiler, class loader, script engine or network access. */
public final class SourceProjects {
    public static final int MAX_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024, MAX_FILES = 2000;
    private static final String MANIFEST = "genesis-project.properties";
    public enum Language {
        JAVA("Java", "java", "Main.java", "public final class Main {\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        System.out.println(\"Hello, Genesis\");\n    }\n}\n"),
        PYTHON("Python", "py", "main.py", "def main():\n    print(\"Hello, Genesis\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"),
        RUST("Rust", "rs", "main.rs", "fn main() {\n    println!(\"Hello, Genesis\");\n}\n"),
        CPP("C++", "cpp", "main.cpp", "#include <iostream>\n\nint main() {\n    std::cout << \"Hello, Genesis\\n\";\n    return 0;\n}\n");
        public final String label, extension, entry, starter;
        Language(String label, String extension, String entry, String starter) { this.label=label;this.extension=extension;this.entry=entry;this.starter=starter; }
    }
    public record Project(String id, Language language) {}
    public record Catalog(List<Project> projects, List<String> errors) { public Catalog { projects=List.copyOf(projects);errors=List.copyOf(errors); } }
    public record Recovery(String baseline, String text) {}
    private final Path root;private boolean dependencyUpdate;
    /** When non-null, {@link #safe(Path)} binds to a linked Minecraft working tree instead of {@link #root}. */
    private Path temporaryBound;
    public SourceProjects(Path root) { this.root=Objects.requireNonNull(root).toAbsolutePath().normalize(); }
    public Path root() { return root; }
    private Path bound(){return temporaryBound!=null?temporaryBound:root;}
    private <T> T withBound(Path bound,CallableIO<T> action)throws IOException{
        Path previous=temporaryBound;temporaryBound=Objects.requireNonNull(bound).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        try{return action.call();}finally{temporaryBound=previous;}
    }
    @FunctionalInterface private interface CallableIO<T>{T call()throws IOException;}
    public static boolean validProject(String id) { return com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.ProjectPath.valid(id)&&id.indexOf('/')<0&&!id.startsWith("."); }
    public static boolean validFile(String path) {
        if (!RepositoryPath.valid(path)) return false;
        if(Set.of("build.gradle","settings.gradle","gradle.properties","build.gradle.kts","settings.gradle.kts","gradlew","gradlew.bat","gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties").contains(path))return true;
        if(!path.startsWith("src/")&&!path.startsWith("tests/"))return false;
        String leaf=RepositoryPath.leaf(path).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return leaf.matches(".+\\.(java|py|rs|cpp|c|h|hpp|json|txt|md|toml|properties)");
    }
    private static IOException fail(String reason) { return new IOException(reason); }
    /**
     * Accepts paths under either the current bound (linked workspace) or the managed root.
     * Linked projects keep their genesis-project.properties under root/id while their
     * working tree lives outside; both must remain addressable during a withBound() block.
     */
    private void safe(Path path) throws IOException {
        Path bound=bound();
        Path normalized=path.normalize();
        boolean underBound=normalized.startsWith(bound);
        boolean underRoot=normalized.startsWith(root);
        if(!underBound&&!underRoot)throw fail("Outside project root");
        Path p=path.toAbsolutePath();
        while(p!=null){if(Files.isSymbolicLink(p))throw fail("Symbolic links are not supported: "+p.getFileName());p=p.getParent();}
        // Resolve existing ancestors as well: Windows junctions need not report isSymbolicLink.
        Path check=underBound?bound:root;
        if(Files.exists(check,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)){
            Path existing=normalized;
            while(existing!=null&&!Files.exists(existing,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))existing=existing.getParent();
            if(existing==null||!existing.toRealPath().startsWith(check.toRealPath()))
                throw fail("Resolved path escapes project root");
        }
    }
    private void directories(Path path) throws IOException { safe(path);Files.createDirectories(path);safe(path); }
    private Path projectPath(String id) throws IOException {
        if(!validProject(id)) throw fail("Invalid project name");
        Path p=root.resolve(id);safe(p);return p;
    }
    private static byte[] bytes(String text) throws IOException {
        if(text==null||text.length()>MAX_BYTES) throw fail("Source exceeds 4 MiB");
        try { ByteBuffer b=StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newEncoder().onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT).encode(java.nio.CharBuffer.wrap(text));
            if(b.remaining()>MAX_BYTES)throw fail("Source exceeds 4 MiB");byte[] result=new byte[b.remaining()];b.get(result);return result;
        } catch(CharacterCodingException e) { throw fail("Invalid UTF-8 source"); }
    }
    private byte[] readBytes(Path path,int limit) throws IOException {
        safe(path);if(!Files.isRegularFile(path,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))throw fail("Missing regular file: "+path.getFileName());
        try(InputStream in=Files.newInputStream(path,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) { byte[] b=in.readNBytes(limit+1);if(b.length>limit)throw fail("File size limit");return b; }
    }
    private static String decode(byte[] b) throws IOException {
        try{return StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newDecoder().onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT).decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(b)).toString().replace("\r\n","\n").replace('\r','\n');}
        catch(CharacterCodingException e){throw fail("Invalid UTF-8 source");}
    }
    public synchronized Project project(String id) throws IOException {
        if(!dependencyUpdate)DependencyJournal.recover(projectPath(id));
        Properties p=new Properties();
        try { p.load(new StringReader(decode(readBytes(projectPath(id).resolve(MANIFEST),4096)))); }
        catch(IllegalArgumentException e){throw fail("Malformed project metadata: "+id);}
        if(!"1".equals(p.getProperty("format")))throw fail("Unsupported project format: "+id);
        try { return new Project(id,Language.valueOf(p.getProperty("language",""))); }
        catch(IllegalArgumentException e){throw fail("Unsupported project language: "+id);}
    }
    public synchronized Catalog list() throws IOException {
        directories(root);var result=new ArrayList<Project>();var errors=new ArrayList<String>();
        try(var entries=Files.newDirectoryStream(root)) { int count=0;for(Path p:entries){
            if(++count>MAX_FILES)throw fail("Too many project entries");String id=p.getFileName().toString();
            if(id.startsWith("."))continue;
            try{if(!Files.isDirectory(p,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)||Files.isSymbolicLink(p))throw fail("Not a regular project directory");result.add(project(id));}
            catch(IOException e){errors.add(id+": "+e.getMessage());}
        }}
        result.sort(Comparator.comparing(Project::id));return new Catalog(result,errors);
    }
    private void noAlias(Path path) throws IOException {
        Path parent=path.getParent();if(!Files.isDirectory(parent,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))return;
        try(var entries=Files.newDirectoryStream(parent)){for(Path p:entries)
            if(p.getFileName().toString().equalsIgnoreCase(path.getFileName().toString()))throw fail("Name already exists: "+path.getFileName());}
    }
    public synchronized Project create(String id,Language language) throws IOException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(language);directories(root);Path target=projectPath(id);noAlias(target);
        Path staging=Files.createTempDirectory(root,".create-");
        try {
            Files.createDirectory(staging.resolve("src"));Files.createDirectory(staging.resolve("libraries"));Files.createDirectory(staging.resolve("resources"));
            Files.writeString(staging.resolve(MANIFEST),"format=1\nlanguage="+language.name()+"\nmod_version=0.4.0\nproject_layout=shared\n",StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            Files.writeString(staging.resolve("src").resolve(language.entry),language.starter,StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            safe(target);Files.move(staging,target);return new Project(id,language);
        } finally { if(Files.exists(staging,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))try(var paths=Files.walk(staging)){for(Path p:paths.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toList())Files.deleteIfExists(p);} }
    }
    private boolean sharedLayout(String id)throws IOException{
        var properties=new Properties();properties.load(new StringReader(decode(readBytes(projectPath(id).resolve(MANIFEST),4096))));return "shared".equals(properties.getProperty("project_layout"));
    }
    /** Atomic server-module starter, including the exact standalone API JAR for Gradle use. */
    public synchronized Project createServerModule(String id)throws IOException {
        byte[] api=RuntimeModuleCompiler.apiJar();directories(root);Path target=projectPath(id);noAlias(target);
        Path staging=Files.createTempDirectory(root,".create-server-module-");
        try {
            Files.createDirectory(staging.resolve("src"));Files.createDirectory(staging.resolve("libraries"));Files.createDirectory(staging.resolve("resources"));
            Files.writeString(staging.resolve(MANIFEST),"format=1\nlanguage=JAVA\nmod_version=0.4.0\nproject_layout=shared\nworkspace=local_sources\n",StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            Files.writeString(staging.resolve("src/WorldModule.java"),com.fixmer.genesis.technology.server.ServerModuleTemplate.source(),StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            Files.write(staging.resolve("libraries/genesis-server-api-v1.jar"),api);
            safe(target);Files.move(staging,target);return project(id);
        } finally {if(Files.exists(staging,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))try(var paths=Files.walk(staging)){for(Path path:paths.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toList())Files.deleteIfExists(path);}}
    }
    public synchronized Path exportServerApi(String id)throws IOException {
        Path path=projectDirectory(id).resolve("libraries/genesis-server-api-v1.jar");safe(path);directories(path.getParent());
        byte[] api=RuntimeModuleCompiler.apiJar();

        try {Files.write(temporary,api);safe(path);noAlias(path);Files.move(temporary,path);return path;}
        finally {Files.deleteIfExists(temporary);}
    }

    /** Linked Minecraft workspace: Genesis stores metadata only; builds use the original path. */
    public synchronized Project createMinecraftLink(String id,Path external,com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft.MinecraftProjectInfo info)throws IOException {
        if(external==null||!external.isAbsolute())throw fail("Select an absolute project directory");
        Objects.requireNonNull(info);
        Path real=external.toRealPath(),managed=root.toRealPath();
        if(real.startsWith(managed)||managed.startsWith(real))throw fail("Link a project outside the Genesis storage tree");
        directories(root);Path target=projectPath(id);noAlias(target);
        Path staging=Files.createTempDirectory(root,".link-minecraft-");
        try{
            var hints=com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft.MinecraftWorkspaceCreator.manifestHints(info,com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft.MinecraftImportMode.LINK,external);
            // Прямые слеши: Properties.load() не трогает '/', путь остаётся валидным на Windows.
            String normalizedPath = external.toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString().replace('\\', '/');
            hints.setProperty("linked_path", normalizedPath);

            StringBuilder manifest=new StringBuilder("format=1\nlanguage=JAVA\nmod_version=0.4.0\nproject_layout=shared\nworkspace=linked_minecraft\n");
            for(String key:hints.stringPropertyNames())manifest.append(key).append('=').append(hints.getProperty(key)).append('\n');
            Files.writeString(staging.resolve(MANIFEST),manifest.toString(),StandardCharsets.UTF_8,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
            if(bytes(manifest.toString()).length>4096)throw fail("Project metadata size limit");
            safe(target);noAlias(target);Files.move(staging,target);return new Project(id,Language.JAVA);
        }finally{if(Files.exists(staging,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))try(var entries=Files.walk(staging)){for(Path p:entries.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toList())Files.deleteIfExists(p);}}
    }
    public synchronized boolean linkedMinecraft(String id)throws IOException {
        project(id);var properties=new Properties();try{properties.load(new StringReader(decode(readBytes(projectPath(id).resolve(MANIFEST),4096))));}
        catch(IllegalArgumentException bad){throw fail("Malformed project metadata");}
        return "linked_minecraft".equals(properties.getProperty("workspace"));
    }
    /** Build / browse root: linked Minecraft projects resolve to the original path. */
    public synchronized Path workingDirectory(String id)throws IOException {
        Path managed=projectDirectory(id);
        var properties=new Properties();try{properties.load(new StringReader(decode(readBytes(managed.resolve(MANIFEST),4096))));}
        catch(IllegalArgumentException bad){throw fail("Malformed project metadata");}
        if(!"linked_minecraft".equals(properties.getProperty("workspace")))return managed;
        String linked=properties.getProperty("linked_path","");
        if(linked.isEmpty())throw fail("Invalid linked Minecraft path");
        Path path;
        try { path=Path.of(linked).toAbsolutePath().normalize(); }
        catch (RuntimeException ex) { throw fail("Invalid linked Minecraft path: "+linked); }
        if(!path.isAbsolute())throw fail("Invalid linked Minecraft path: "+linked);
        if(!Files.isDirectory(path,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)||Files.isSymbolicLink(path))throw fail("Linked Minecraft project is missing");
        Path real=path.toRealPath(),own=root.toRealPath();
        if(real.startsWith(own)||own.startsWith(real))throw fail("Linked Minecraft path collides with Genesis storage");
        return path;
    }
    private Imported importProject(String id,Path external,java.util.function.BooleanSupplier cancelled,boolean requireBuild)throws IOException {
        if(external==null||!external.isAbsolute())throw fail("Select an absolute project directory");
        Objects.requireNonNull(cancelled);directories(root);Path target=projectPath(id);noAlias(target);
        Path real=external.toRealPath(),managed=root.toRealPath();if(real.startsWith(managed)||managed.startsWith(real))throw fail("Import a project outside the Genesis storage tree");
        Path staging=Files.createTempDirectory(root,".import-");
        try{
            byte[] metadata=importMetadata(external);Language language=Language.JAVA;
            if(metadata!=null){if(requireBuild)throw fail("Use folder import for Genesis exports");var props=new Properties();
                try{props.load(new StringReader(decode(metadata)));if(!"1".equals(props.getProperty("format")))throw new IllegalArgumentException();language=Language.valueOf(props.getProperty("language",""));}
                catch(IllegalArgumentException bad){throw fail("Invalid exported Genesis metadata");}}
            var summary=GradleProjectImport.copy(external,staging,cancelled,requireBuild,!requireBuild);
            if(!Arrays.equals(metadata,importMetadata(external)))throw fail("Import metadata changed while copying");
            boolean gradle=Files.isRegularFile(staging.resolve("build.gradle"))||Files.isRegularFile(staging.resolve("build.gradle.kts"));if(gradle)language=Language.JAVA;
            Files.writeString(staging.resolve(MANIFEST),"format=1\nlanguage="+language.name()+"\nmod_version=0.4.0\nproject_layout=shared\nworkspace="+(gradle?"imported_gradle":"local_sources")+"\n",StandardCharsets.UTF_8,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
            if(cancelled.getAsBoolean())throw fail("Import cancelled");safe(target);noAlias(target);Files.move(staging,target);
            return new Imported(new Project(id,language),summary);
        }finally{if(Files.exists(staging,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))try(var entries=Files.walk(staging)){for(Path p:entries.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toList())Files.deleteIfExists(p);}}
    }
    /** Creates a new, independent mod project. Existing projects are never converted or replaced. */
    public synchronized Project createNeoForge(String id)throws IOException {
        if(!NeoForgeProjectTemplate.validId(id))throw fail("Invalid or reserved mod id");
        directories(root);Path target=projectPath(id);noAlias(target);
        BuildTools.Settings tools=buildTools();
        byte[] wrapper,properties;
        try(var in=Files.newInputStream(tools.wrapperJar(),LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)){wrapper=in.readNBytes(8*1024*1024+1);}
        try(var in=Files.newInputStream(tools.wrapperJar().resolveSibling("gradle-wrapper.properties"),LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)){properties=in.readNBytes(64*1024+1);}
        if(wrapper.length>8*1024*1024||properties.length>64*1024)throw fail("Wrapper size limit");
        Path staging=Files.createTempDirectory(root,".create-");
        try{
            for(var entry:NeoForgeProjectTemplate.files(id).entrySet()){
                Path output=staging.resolve(entry.getKey());Files.createDirectories(output.getParent());
                Files.writeString(output,entry.getValue(),StandardCharsets.UTF_8,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
            }
            Path jar=staging.resolve("gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar");Files.createDirectories(jar.getParent());
            Files.write(jar,wrapper,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);Files.write(jar.resolveSibling("gradle-wrapper.properties"),properties,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
            BuildTools.validate(new BuildTools.Settings(tools.javaHome(),jar));
            staging.resolve("gradlew").toFile().setExecutable(true);
            safe(target);noAlias(target);Files.move(staging,target);return new Project(id,Language.JAVA);
        }finally{if(Files.exists(staging,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))try(var entries=Files.walk(staging)){for(Path path:entries.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toList())Files.deleteIfExists(path);}}
    }
    private byte[] importMetadata(Path source)throws IOException{
        Path path=source.resolve(MANIFEST);if(!Files.exists(path,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))return null;
        try(var in=Files.newInputStream(path,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)){byte[] data=in.readNBytes(4097);if(data.length>4096)throw fail("Import metadata size limit");return data;}
    }
    private Path source(String id,String file) throws IOException {

    /**
     * Linked projects: workingDirectory(id) is computed ONCE, before withBound(), so the
     * second call inside the lambda never re-enters safe() with a mismatched bound.
     */

        }
        return GradleProjectImport.editableFiles(workingDirectory(id));
    }

    private Path entryPath(String id,String path)throws IOException{
        project(id);if(!com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.ProjectPath.valid(path)||path.equalsIgnoreCase(MANIFEST)||path.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith(".build-tools"))throw fail("Invalid or protected project path");
        if(linkedMinecraft(id))return linkedEntry(id,path);
        Path result=projectPath(id).resolve(path);safe(result);return result;
    }
    private Path linkedEntry(String id,String path)throws IOException{
        Path rootDir=workingDirectory(id);
        Path result=rootDir.resolve(path).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        if(!result.startsWith(rootDir.toAbsolutePath().normalize()))throw fail("Outside linked project root");
        for(Path p=result;p!=null;p=p.getParent()){
            if(p.equals(rootDir.toAbsolutePath().normalize()))break;
            if(Files.isSymbolicLink(p))throw fail("Symbolic links are not supported: "+p.getFileName());
        }
        if(Files.exists(result,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)&&!result.toRealPath().startsWith(rootDir.toRealPath()))throw fail("Resolved path escapes linked project root");
        return result;
    }
    public synchronized void createDirectory(String id,String folder)throws IOException {
        Path current=linkedMinecraft(id)?workingDirectory(id):projectPath(id);
        Path path=entryPath(id,folder);var created=new ArrayList<Path>();
        CallableIO<Void> action=()->{
            Path cursor=current;
            for(Path segment:cursor.relativize(path)){Path next=cursor.resolve(segment);safe(next);if(Files.exists(next,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)){
                if(!Files.isDirectory(next,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))throw fail("Not a directory");
                try(var entries=Files.list(cursor)){for(Path entry:entries.toList())if(entry.getFileName().toString().equalsIgnoreCase(segment.toString())&&!entry.getFileName().toString().equals(segment.toString()))throw fail("Case alias");}
            }else{noAlias(next);Files.createDirectory(next);created.add(next);}cursor=next;}
            return null;
        };
        try{if(linkedMinecraft(id))withBound(current,action);else action.call();}
        catch(IOException bad){Collections.reverse(created);for(Path entry:created)try{Files.delete(entry);}catch(IOException rollback){bad.addSuppressed(rollback);}throw bad;}
    }
    /** Copies saved content; never saves drafts or replaces an existing entry. */
    public synchronized void copyEntry(String id,String from,String to,Map<String,String> expected)throws IOException{
        copyEntry(id,from,to,expected,()->false);
    }
    public synchronized void copyEntry(String id,String from,String to,Map<String,String> expected,java.util.function.BooleanSupplier stop)throws IOException{
        Objects.requireNonNull(expected);Objects.requireNonNull(stop);Path source=entryPath(id,from),target=entryPath(id,to);
        if(from.equals(to)||to.startsWith(from+"/"))throw fail("Cannot copy inside the source");
        if(!Files.exists(source,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))throw fail("Missing copy source");
        for(Path current=source;!current.equals(root);current=current.getParent()){
            String spelling=current.getFileName().toString();try(var siblings=Files.list(current.getParent())){for(Path sibling:siblings.toList())if(sibling.getFileName().toString().equalsIgnoreCase(spelling)&&!sibling.getFileName().toString().equals(spelling))throw fail("Copy source case alias");}
        }
        if(!Files.isDirectory(target.getParent(),LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))throw fail("Destination parent must exist");
        String parent=RepositoryPath.parent(to);if(!parent.isEmpty())createDirectory(id,parent);noAlias(target);
        for(var e:expected.entrySet())if(!read(id,e.getKey()).equals(e.getValue()))throw fail("File changed outside Scripts: "+e.getKey());
        for(String file:files(id))if(file.equals(from)||file.startsWith(from+"/"))if(recovery(id,file)!=null)throw fail("Resolve recovered drafts before copying");
        if(stop.getAsBoolean())throw fail("Copy cancelled");boolean directory=Files.isDirectory(source,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);Path staging=Files.createTempDirectory(root,".genesis-copy-");boolean published=false;
        try{Path data=staging.resolve("data");
            if(directory){Files.createDirectory(data);GradleProjectImport.copyContents(source,data,stop,from);}
            else{byte[] content=readBytes(source,GradleProjectImport.MAX_FILE_BYTES);Files.write(data,content,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);if(!Arrays.equals(content,readBytes(source,GradleProjectImport.MAX_FILE_BYTES)))throw fail("Copy source changed");}
            for(var e:expected.entrySet())if(!read(id,e.getKey()).equals(e.getValue()))throw fail("File changed outside Scripts: "+e.getKey());
            GradleProjectImport.validateAddition(projectPath(id),data,directory,to);
            if(stop.getAsBoolean())throw fail("Copy cancelled");safe(target);noAlias(target);Files.move(data,target);published=true;
        }finally{try(var paths=Files.walk(staging)){for(Path entry:paths.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toList())Files.deleteIfExists(entry);}catch(IOException cleanup){if(!published)throw cleanup;}}
    }
    public synchronized void renameEntry(String id,String from,String to,Map<String,String> expected)throws IOException {
        Path source=entryPath(id,from),target=entryPath(id,to);
        if(from.equals(to)||to.startsWith(from+"/"))throw fail("Invalid move destination");
        if(!Files.exists(source,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))throw fail("Missing project entry");
        for(var e:expected.entrySet())if(!read(id,e.getKey()).equals(e.getValue()))throw fail("File changed outside Scripts: "+e.getKey());
        for(String file:files(id))if(file.equals(from)||file.startsWith(from+"/")){
            if(recovery(id,file)!=null)throw fail("Save or resolve recovered drafts before renaming");
            String destination=to+file.substring(from.length());if(!GradleProjectImport.editable(destination))throw fail("Unsupported destination file type");
        }
        if(Files.isRegularFile(source,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)&&GradleProjectImport.editable(from)&&!GradleProjectImport.editable(to))throw fail("Unsupported destination file type");
        if(!Files.isDirectory(target.getParent(),LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))throw fail("Destination parent must exist");
        noAlias(target);safe(target);Files.move(source,target);
    }
    /** Reversible delete: entries go to local trash outside projects; no recursive permanent deletion. */
    public synchronized Path trashEntry(String id,String path,Map<String,String> expected)throws IOException{
        Path source=entryPath(id,path);if(!Files.exists(source,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))throw fail("Missing project entry");
        for(var e:expected.entrySet())if(!read(id,e.getKey()).equals(e.getValue()))throw fail("File changed outside Scripts: "+e.getKey());
        for(String file:files(id))if(file.equals(path)||file.startsWith(path+"/"))if(recovery(id,file)!=null)throw fail("Save or resolve recovered drafts before deletion");
        Path trash=root.resolve(".genesis-trash");directories(trash);Path target=Files.createTempDirectory(trash,id+"-");
        try{Files.writeString(target.resolve("origin.properties"),"project="+id+"\npath="+path+"\n",StandardCharsets.UTF_8);Files.move(source,target.resolve("data"));return target;}
        catch(IOException bad){Files.deleteIfExists(target.resolve("origin.properties"));Files.deleteIfExists(target);throw bad;}
    }
    public synchronized String restoreTrash(Path directory)throws IOException{
        Path trash=root.resolve(".genesis-trash"),item=directory.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        if(!trash.equals(item.getParent()))throw fail("Invalid trash entry");safe(item);var properties=new Properties();
        try{properties.load(new StringReader(decode(readBytes(item.resolve("origin.properties"),4096))));}catch(IllegalArgumentException bad){throw fail("Invalid trash metadata");}
        String id=properties.getProperty("project",""),path=properties.getProperty("path","");Path target=entryPath(id,path),data=item.resolve("data");safe(data);
        if(!Files.exists(data,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)||Files.isSymbolicLink(data))throw fail("Missing trash data");noAlias(target);
        String parent=RepositoryPath.parent(path);if(!parent.isEmpty())createDirectory(id,parent);safe(target);Files.move(data,target);
        try{Files.deleteIfExists(item.resolve("origin.properties"));Files.deleteIfExists(item);}catch(IOException ignored){ /* Restored data is already at its destination; residue is not a failed restore. */ }
        return id+"/"+path;
    }
    public synchronized String read(String id,String file) throws IOException {
        if(linkedMinecraft(id))return withBound(workingDirectory(id),()->decode(readBytes(source(id,file),MAX_BYTES)));

    }
    public synchronized String javaMainClass(String id)throws IOException {
        if(project(id).language()!=Language.JAVA)throw fail("Java entry point requires a Java project");

    }
    public synchronized void setJavaMainClass(String id,String mainClass)throws IOException {
        if(project(id).language()!=Language.JAVA)throw fail("Java entry point requires a Java project");if(!JavaSourceRunner.validMainClass(mainClass))throw fail("Invalid Java main class");
        Path path=projectPath(id).resolve(MANIFEST);String before=decode(readBytes(path,4096));
        var pattern=java.util.regex.Pattern.compile("(?m)^[ \t]*main_class[ \t]*[:=][^\r\n]*");var matcher=pattern.matcher(before);int count=0;while(matcher.find())count++;
        if(count>1)throw fail("Duplicate main_class configuration");
        String after=count==0?before+(before.endsWith("\n")?"":"\n")+"main_class="+mainClass+"\n":pattern.matcher(before).replaceFirst(java.util.regex.Matcher.quoteReplacement("main_class="+mainClass));
        if(bytes(after).length>4096)throw fail("Project metadata size limit");
        if(!decode(readBytes(path,4096)).equals(before))throw fail("Project metadata changed externally");atomic(path,bytes(after));
    }

    public synchronized void setGradleTask(String id,String task)throws IOException {

    public synchronized GradleBuildRunner.Options buildOptions(String id)throws IOException{
        project(id);var props=buildMetadata(decode(readBytes(projectPath(id).resolve(MANIFEST),4096)));try{
            long minutes=Long.parseLong(props.getProperty("build_timeout_minutes","10"));if(minutes<1||minutes>1440)throw new IllegalArgumentException();
            return new GradleBuildRunner.Options(minutes*60_000L,Integer.parseInt(props.getProperty("build_max_workers","2")));
        }catch(IllegalArgumentException invalid){throw fail("Invalid build_timeout_minutes (1–1440) or build_max_workers (0–64) in project metadata");}
    }
    public synchronized void setBuildOption(String id,String key,int value)throws IOException{
        if(project(id).language()!=Language.JAVA)throw fail("Build settings require a Java project");
        if(!key.equals("build_timeout_minutes")&&!key.equals("build_max_workers"))throw fail("Unknown build setting");
        if(key.equals("build_timeout_minutes")?(value<1||value>1440):(value<0||value>64))throw fail("Build setting out of range");
        setBuildMetadata(id,key,Integer.toString(value));
    }
    private static boolean continued(String line){
        int end=line.length();while(end>0&&(line.charAt(end-1)=='\n'||line.charAt(end-1)=='\r'))end--;
        int slashes=0;while(end>0&&line.charAt(--end)=='\\')slashes++;return (slashes&1)!=0;
    }
    /** Parse with Java Properties semantics, including escaped keys and continued declarations. */
    private static Properties buildMetadata(String text)throws IOException{
        var props=new Properties(){@Override public synchronized Object put(Object key,Object value){
            if(Set.of("gradle_task","build_timeout_minutes","build_max_workers").contains(key)&&containsKey(key))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate build setting: "+key);
            return super.put(key,value);
        }};
        try{props.load(new StringReader(text));return props;}catch(IllegalArgumentException bad){throw fail("Malformed build metadata: "+bad.getMessage());}
    }
    private void setBuildMetadata(String id,String key,String value)throws IOException{
        Path path=projectPath(id).resolve(MANIFEST);String before=decode(readBytes(path,4096));
        buildMetadata(before);String[] lines=before.split("(?<=\n)|(?<=\r)(?!\n)",-1);var updated=new StringBuilder();boolean replaced=false;
        for(int i=0;i<lines.length;i++){
            var logical=new StringBuilder(lines[i]);String first=lines[i].stripLeading();boolean comment=first.startsWith("#")||first.startsWith("!");
            while(!comment&&continued(lines[i])&&i+1<lines.length)logical.append(lines[++i]);
            var declaration=new Properties();try{declaration.load(new StringReader(logical.toString()));}catch(IllegalArgumentException bad){throw fail("Malformed project metadata");}
            if(declaration.containsKey(key)){updated.append(key).append('=').append(value).append('\n');replaced=true;}else updated.append(logical);
        }
        if(!replaced){if(!updated.isEmpty()&&continued(lines[lines.length-1])&&!lines[lines.length-1].stripLeading().startsWith("#")&&!lines[lines.length-1].stripLeading().startsWith("!"))updated.append("\n\n");if(!updated.isEmpty()&&updated.charAt(updated.length()-1)!='\n')updated.append('\n');updated.append(key).append('=').append(value).append('\n');}
        String after=updated.toString();buildMetadata(after);
        if(bytes(after).length>4096)throw fail("Project metadata size limit");
        if(!decode(readBytes(path,4096)).equals(before))throw fail("Project metadata changed externally");atomic(path,bytes(after));
    }
    public static boolean directJavaSource(String path){return com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.ProjectPath.valid(path)&&path.endsWith(".java")&&!path.startsWith("tests/")&&!path.startsWith("src/test/")&&!path.startsWith("libraries/")&&!path.startsWith("resources/");}
    /** Bounded, read-only Java source snapshot. Editor overrides retain external-change checks. */
    public synchronized Map<String,String> javaSources(String id,Map<String,Recovery> edits)throws IOException {
        if(project(id).language()!=Language.JAVA)throw fail("Java execution requires a Java project");
        if(importedGradle(id))throw fail("Use Gradle tasks for imported projects");
        Objects.requireNonNull(edits);var result=new TreeMap<String,String>();long total=0;
        for(String path:files(id))if(directJavaSource(path)){
            if(result.size()>=JavaSourceRunner.MAX_SOURCES)throw fail("Java source count exceeds 512");
            String disk=read(id,path);Recovery edit=edits.get(path);String value=disk;
            if(edit!=null){if(!disk.equals(edit.baseline()))throw fail("Source changed outside Scripts: "+path);value=edit.text();}
            total+=bytes(value).length;if(total>JavaSourceRunner.MAX_SOURCE_BYTES)throw fail("Java project exceeds 16 MiB");result.put(path,value);
        }
        for(String path:edits.keySet())if(!result.containsKey(path))throw fail("Missing Java source: "+path);
        if(result.isEmpty())throw fail("No Java sources in project");return Map.copyOf(result);

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\server\RuntimeBundle.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.server;
import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
/** Owns an immutable snapshot; failed cleanup remains retryable and observable. */
public final class RuntimeBundle implements AutoCloseable  {
    private static final java.util.Set<RuntimeBundle> PENDING=java.util.Collections.newSetFromMap(new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>());
    public static void retryCleanup() {
        for(RuntimeBundle b:List.copyOf(PENDING))b.close();
    }
    private final Path root;
    private final List<Path> paths;
    private final String entry;
    private final AtomicBoolean closed=new AtomicBoolean();
    private volatile String cleanupError="";
    public RuntimeBundle(Path root,List<Path> paths,String entry) {
        this.root=root.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        this.paths=paths.stream().map(p->p.toAbsolutePath().normalize()).toList();
        if(paths.isEmpty()||this.paths.stream().anyMatch(p->!p.startsWith(this.root)))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Classpath must belong to snapshot");
        if(!com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.JavaSourceRunner.validMainClass(entry)||protectedName(entry))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid runtime entry class");
        this.entry=entry;
    }
    public String entry() {
        return entry;
    }
    public Path root() {
        return root;
    }
    public String cleanupError() {
        return cleanupError;
    }
    public URLClassLoader loader(ClassLoader parent)throws IOException {
        if(closed.get())throw new IOException("Runtime snapshot closed");
        for(Path p:paths) {
            for(Path a=p;a!=null;a=a.getParent())if(Files.isSymbolicLink(a))throw new IOException("Linked runtime snapshot");
            if(!p.toRealPath().startsWith(root.toRealPath()))throw new IOException("Runtime classpath escapes snapshot");
        }
        URL[] urls=new URL[paths.size()];
        for(int i=0;i<urls.length;i++)urls[i]=paths.get(i).toUri().toURL();
        return new URLClassLoader(urls,parent) {
            protected synchronized Class<?> loadClass(String name,boolean resolve)throws ClassNotFoundException {
                if(protectedName(name))return getParent()==null?Class.forName(name,false,null):getParent().loadClass(name);
                Class<?> type=findLoadedClass(name);
                if(type==null)try {
                    type=findClass(name);
                }
                catch(ClassNotFoundException absent) {
                    type=super.loadClass(name,false);
                }
                if(resolve)resolveClass(type);
                return type;
            }
            public URL getResource(String name) {
                URL own=findResource(name);
                return own==null?super.getResource(name):own;
            }
            public Enumeration<URL> getResources(String name)throws IOException {
                var found=new LinkedHashSet<URL>();
                var own=findResources(name);
                while(own.hasMoreElements())found.add(own.nextElement());
                var parent=getParent()==null?super.getResources(name):getParent().getResources(name);
                while(parent.hasMoreElements())found.add(parent.nextElement());
                return Collections.enumeration(found);
            }
        };
    }
    public static boolean protectedName(String name) {
        for(String p:List.of("java.","javax.","jdk.","sun.","com.fixmer.genesis.","com.fixmer.mared.","net.minecraft.","net.neoforged.","com.mojang.","org.slf4j.","io.netty.","com.google.common.","it.unimi.dsi.fastutil."))if(name.startsWith(p))return true;
        return false;
    }
    @Override public synchronized void close() {
        closed.set(true);
        try {
            Files.walkFileTree(root,new SimpleFileVisitor<Path>() {
                public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path p,java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes a)throws IOException {
                    Files.deleteIfExists(p);return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
                }
                public FileVisitResult postVisitDirectory(Path p,IOException error)throws IOException {
                    if(error!=null)throw error;Files.deleteIfExists(p);return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
                }
            });
            cleanupError="";
            PENDING.remove(this);
        }
        catch(NoSuchFileException missing) {
            cleanupError="";
            PENDING.remove(this);
        }
        catch(IOException error) {
            cleanupError=error.toString();
            if(PENDING.size()<128)PENDING.add(this);
        }
    }
}

package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.server;

import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.function.LongConsumer;

/** Stable parent-loaded API. No Minecraft, Commands, MR or client classes. Not an OS sandbox. */
public interface ServerContext {
    String API_VERSION = "1";
    interface Subscription extends AutoCloseable { @Override void close(); }
    UUID owner();
    String worldSession();
    long generation();
    void log(String message);
    void broadcast(String message);
    void setDayTime(String dimension, long ticks);
    void setWeather(int durationTicks, boolean raining, boolean thundering);
    void setBlock(String dimension, int x, int y, int z, String blockId);
    String state(String key);
    void state(String key, String value);
    Subscription onTick(LongConsumer listener);
    Subscription afterTicks(int ticks, Runnable action);
    /** Advanced Gradle modules can cast this to MinecraftServer. Bypasses managed mutation staging. */
    Object nativeServer();
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\server\ServerModuleEngine.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.server;

import java.net.URLClassLoader;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.LongConsumer;

/** Single-server-thread lifecycle. Each project retains active plus ONE previous bundle. */
public final class ServerModuleEngine implements AutoCloseable {
    public record Result(boolean success,String message,long generation) {}
    public record Status(long generation,boolean running,boolean canRollback,int callbacks,String error) {}
    private final ServerModuleHost host;
    private final Map<String,Slot> slots=new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private long nextGeneration,tick;private int tickStart;
    private boolean closed;
    private static final class Slot {Loaded active;RuntimeBundle previous;String error="";}
    private static final class Loaded {
        boolean released;final RuntimeBundle bundle;final URLClassLoader loader;final Context context;final ServerModule module;
        Loaded(RuntimeBundle bundle,URLClassLoader loader,Context context,ServerModule module){this.bundle=bundle;this.loader=loader;this.context=context;this.module=module;}
    }
    private record Mutation(Runnable validate,Runnable apply,java.util.function.Supplier<Runnable> undo){}
    private final class Callback implements ServerContext.Subscription {
        final Context owner;final long due;final LongConsumer action;boolean removed;
        Callback(Context owner,long due,LongConsumer action){this.owner=owner;this.due=due;this.action=action;}
        @Override public void close(){requireThread();removed=true;owner.callbacks.remove(this);}
    }
    private final class Context implements ServerContext {
        final String project;final long generation;final Map<String,String> state;
        final List<Callback> callbacks=new ArrayList<>();final List<Mutation> staged=new ArrayList<>();
        boolean alive=true,active;
        Context(String project,long generation,Map<String,String> prior){this.project=project;this.generation=generation;state=new LinkedHashMap<>(prior);}
        void check(){requireThread();if(!alive||closed||!host.allowed())throw new IllegalStateException("Runtime context expired or permission denied");}
        void mutate(Runnable action){mutate(()->{},action,()->null);}
        void mutate(Runnable validation,Runnable action,java.util.function.Supplier<Runnable> undo){check();if(active){validation.run();action.run();}else {if(staged.size()>=1024)throw new IllegalStateException("Too many activation actions");staged.add(new Mutation(validation,action,undo));}}
        void revoke(){alive=false;active=false;callbacks.clear();staged.clear();}
        @Override public UUID owner(){check();return host.owner();}
        @Override public String worldSession(){check();return host.worldSession();}
        @Override public long generation(){check();return generation;}
        @Override public void log(String text){check();host.log("["+project+" #"+generation+"] "+limited(text,2048));}
        @Override public void broadcast(String text){String value=limited(text,512);mutate(()->host.validateBroadcast(value),()->host.broadcast(value),()->null);}
        @Override public void setDayTime(String dimension,long ticks){String id=dimension(dimension);if(ticks<0||ticks>Long.MAX_VALUE-24000)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid day time");mutate(()->host.validateDayTime(id,ticks),()->host.setDayTime(id,ticks),()->host.undoDayTime(id));}
        @Override public void setWeather(int duration,boolean rain,boolean thunder){if(duration<1||duration>1200000||thunder&&!rain)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid weather");mutate(()->host.validateWeather(duration,rain,thunder),()->host.setWeather(duration,rain,thunder),host::undoWeather);}
        @Override public void setBlock(String dimension,int x,int y,int z,String block){check();String id=dimension(dimension),name=dimension(block);host.validateBlock(id,x,y,z,name);mutate(()->host.validateBlock(id,x,y,z,name),()->host.setBlock(id,x,y,z,name),()->host.undoBlock(id,x,y,z));}
        @Override public String state(String key){check();return state.get(key(key));}
        @Override public void state(String key,String value){check();key=key(key);if(value==null){state.remove(key);return;}if(value.length()>4096||!state.containsKey(key)&&state.size()>=128)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Runtime state limit");state.put(key,value);}
        @Override public Subscription onTick(LongConsumer action){return add(-1,Objects.requireNonNull(action));}

        Subscription add(long due,LongConsumer action){check();if(callbacks.size()>=256)throw new IllegalStateException("Too many runtime callbacks");var callback=new Callback(this,due,action);callbacks.add(callback);return callback;}
        @Override public Object nativeServer(){check();return host.nativeServer();}
    }
    public ServerModuleEngine(ServerModuleHost host){this.host=Objects.requireNonNull(host);}
    private void requireThread(){if(!host.isServerThread())throw new IllegalStateException("Use the server owner thread");}
    private static String limited(String s,int limit){return Objects.requireNonNull(s).substring(0,Math.min(limit,s.length()));}
    private static String key(String s){if(s==null||s.isBlank()||s.length()>128)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid state key");return s;}
    private static String dimension(String s){if(s==null||s.length()>256||!s.matches("[a-z0-9_.-]+:[a-z0-9_./-]+"))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Use namespace:path");return s;}
    public Result apply(String project,RuntimeBundle bundle){return apply(project,bundle,()->false);}
    public Result apply(String project,RuntimeBundle bundle,java.util.function.BooleanSupplier cancelled){return apply(project,bundle,false,cancelled);}
    private Result apply(String project,RuntimeBundle bundle,boolean restoring,java.util.function.BooleanSupplier cancelled){
        requireThread();RuntimeBundle.retryCleanup();Objects.requireNonNull(bundle);
        if(!slots.containsKey(project)&&slots.size()>=16)for(var e:List.copyOf(slots.entrySet()))if(!e.getValue().active.context.alive){stop(e.getKey());break;}
        if(closed||cancelled.getAsBoolean()||!host.allowed()||project==null||project.isBlank()||project.length()>192||!slots.containsKey(project)&&slots.size()>=16){if(!restoring)bundle.close();return new Result(false,"World/permission unavailable or module limit",0);}
        ClassLoader threadLoader=Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();long activationStarted=System.nanoTime();int[] commits={0},irreversible={0};var compensations=new ArrayList<Runnable>();Slot slot=slots.get(project);Loaded candidate=null;URLClassLoader loader=null;Context context=null;ServerModule module=null;
        try {
            loader=bundle.loader(ServerModule.class.getClassLoader());Thread.currentThread().setContextClassLoader(loader);Class<?> type=Class.forName(bundle.entry(),true,loader);
            if(type.getClassLoader()!=loader||!ServerModule.class.isAssignableFrom(type))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Entry must implement Genesis ServerModule; ordinary @Mod/main is not a runtime module");
            module=(ServerModule)type.getConstructor().newInstance();if(cancelled.getAsBoolean()||!host.allowed())throw new IllegalStateException("Cancelled / world changed during class initialization");
            context=new Context(project,++nextGeneration,slot==null||slot.active==null?Map.of():slot.active.context.state);
            candidate=new Loaded(bundle,loader,context,module);if(System.nanoTime()-activationStarted>200_000_000L)throw new IllegalStateException("Class initialization / constructor exceeded 200 ms after returning");module.onEnable(context);
            if(System.nanoTime()-activationStarted>200_000_000L)throw new IllegalStateException("Activation exceeded 200 ms after returning; in-process code cannot be forcibly interrupted");
            if(cancelled.getAsBoolean()||!host.allowed())throw new IllegalStateException("Cancelled / world changed during activation");
            // Old callbacks cannot interleave: commit is on the same server thread. A world mutation is not transactional.
            for(Mutation action:List.copyOf(context.staged))action.validate().run();
            if(cancelled.getAsBoolean()||!host.allowed())throw new IllegalStateException("Cancelled before world commit");
            for(Mutation action:List.copyOf(context.staged)){Runnable undo=action.undo().get();if(undo!=null)compensations.add(undo);else irreversible[0]++;commits[0]++;action.apply().run();}context.staged.clear();
            if(slot==null){slot=new Slot();slots.put(project,slot);}
            Loaded old=slot.active;RuntimeBundle obsolete=restoring?null:slot.previous;
            if(old!=null)release(old);
            slot.previous=old==null?null:old.bundle;slot.active=candidate;slot.error="";context.active=true;
            if(obsolete!=null&&obsolete!=bundle)obsolete.close();
            host.log("["+project+"] applied #"+context.generation);return new Result(true,"APPLIED",context.generation);
        } catch(Throwable error) {
            Collections.reverse(compensations);int rollbackErrors=0;for(Runnable undo:compensations)try{undo.run();}catch(Throwable failure){rollbackErrors++;host.log("World compensation failed: "+failure);if(failure instanceof VirtualMachineError fatal)throw fatal;}
            if(candidate!=null)release(candidate);else {if(context!=null)context.revoke();if(loader!=null)try{loader.close();}catch(Exception ignored){}}
            if(!restoring)bundle.close();
            String message=(commits[0]>0&&(irreversible[0]>0||rollbackErrors>0)?"PARTIAL_APPLY: "+commits[0]+" world actions attempted; "+irreversible[0]+" non-compensatable, "+rollbackErrors+" rollback failures. ":"")+error.getClass().getSimpleName()+": "+Objects.toString(error.getMessage(),"");host.log("["+project+"] apply failed: "+limited(message,2048));
            if(error instanceof VirtualMachineError fatal)throw fatal;
            return new Result(false,message,slot==null||slot.active==null?0:slot.active.context.generation);
        }finally{Thread.currentThread().setContextClassLoader(threadLoader);}
    }
    private void release(Loaded loaded){
        // Revoke first: onDisable cannot create surviving callbacks or mutate the world through its expired context.
        if(loaded.released)return;loaded.released=true;loaded.context.revoke();ClassLoader before=Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();long disableStarted=System.nanoTime();try{Thread.currentThread().setContextClassLoader(loaded.loader);loaded.module.onDisable();if(System.nanoTime()-disableStarted>200_000_000L)host.log("onDisable exceeded 200 ms after returning; in-process code cannot be forcibly interrupted");}catch(Throwable bad){host.log("onDisable: "+limited(bad.toString(),2048));if(bad instanceof VirtualMachineError fatal)throw fatal;}
        finally{Thread.currentThread().setContextClassLoader(before);try{loaded.loader.close();}catch(Exception bad){host.log("Classloader close: "+bad.getMessage());}}
    }
    public Result rollback(String project){requireThread();Slot slot=slots.get(project);if(slot==null||slot.previous==null)return new Result(false,"No previous successful bundle",0);return apply(project,slot.previous,true,()->false);}
    public Result stop(String project){requireThread();Slot slot=slots.remove(project);if(slot==null)return new Result(false,"Module not running",0);long generation=slot.active.context.generation;release(slot.active);slot.active.bundle.close();if(slot.previous!=null)slot.previous.close();return new Result(true,"STOPPED",generation);}
    public void tick(){
        requireThread();RuntimeBundle.retryCleanup();if(closed)return;if(!host.allowed()){close();return;}tick++;
        var entries=List.copyOf(slots.entrySet());int count=entries.size();long totalStarted=System.nanoTime();int first=count==0?0:Math.floorMod(tickStart,count);
        for(int offset=0;offset<count;offset++){
            int index=(first+offset)%count;var entry=entries.get(index);tickStart=(index+1)%count;
            Loaded loaded=entry.getValue().active;Context ctx=loaded.context;if(!ctx.alive)continue;long started=System.nanoTime();
            ClassLoader before=Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();try {Thread.currentThread().setContextClassLoader(loaded.loader);for(Callback callback:List.copyOf(ctx.callbacks)){
                if(callback.removed||!ctx.alive)continue;if(callback.due>=0&&tick<callback.due)continue;
                if(callback.due>=0)callback.close();callback.action.accept(tick);
                if(System.nanoTime()-started>10_000_000L)throw new IllegalStateException("Runtime tick exceeded 10 ms after returning");
            }}catch(Throwable bad){entry.getValue().error=limited(bad.toString(),2048);host.log("["+entry.getKey()+"] disabled: "+entry.getValue().error);release(loaded);if(bad instanceof VirtualMachineError fatal)throw fatal;}finally{Thread.currentThread().setContextClassLoader(before);}
            if(System.nanoTime()-totalStarted>20_000_000L)break;
        }
    }
    public Map<String,Status> snapshot(){requireThread();var result=new LinkedHashMap<String,Status>();slots.forEach((id,s)->result.put(id,new Status(s.active.context.generation,s.active.context.alive,s.previous!=null,s.active.context.callbacks.size(),s.error)));return Map.copyOf(result);}
    @Override public void close(){requireThread();if(closed)return;for(String id:List.copyOf(slots.keySet()))stop(id);closed=true;}
}

===== technologies\core\src\main\java\com\fixmer\genesis\technology\storage\ProjectArchive.java =====
package com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;

/** Portable, data-only Commands ZIP format. No execution, extraction or Minecraft dependencies. */
public final class ProjectArchive {
    public static final int MAX_ENTRIES = 2000;
    public static final int MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
    private static final String MANIFEST = "genesis-project.properties";
    private static final String HEADER = "format=genesis-commands\nversion=1\n";
    private ProjectArchive() {}
    public record Plan(Map<String,String> documents, Set<String> directories, long bytes) {
        public Plan {
            documents = Collections.unmodifiableMap(new TreeMap<>(documents));
            directories = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new TreeSet<>(directories));
        }
        public Plan beneath(String prefix) throws IOException {
            if (prefix.isEmpty()) return this;
            if (!RepositoryPath.valid(prefix)) throw new IOException("Invalid destination folder");
            var files = new TreeMap<String,String>(); var folders = new TreeSet<String>();
            addParents(prefix, folders); folders.add(prefix);
            for (var entry : documents.entrySet()) files.put(prefix + "/" + entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
            for (String directory : directories) folders.add(prefix + "/" + directory);
            return validated(files, folders, bytes);
        }
    }
    private static void interrupted() throws IOException { if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) throw new InterruptedIOException("Archive operation cancelled"); }
    private static void addParents(String path, Set<String> folders) {
        for (String p = RepositoryPath.parent(path); !p.isEmpty(); p = RepositoryPath.parent(p)) folders.add(p);
    }
    private static Plan validated(Map<String,String> files, Set<String> folders, long bytes) throws IOException {
        if (files.size() + folders.size() > MAX_ENTRIES || bytes > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES) throw new IOException("Project exceeds archive limits");
        Set<String> physical = new HashSet<>();
        for (String folder : folders) {
            if (!RepositoryPath.valid(folder) || !physical.add(folder.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))) throw new IOException("Invalid or ambiguous folder: " + folder);
        }
        for (String file : files.keySet()) {
            if (!RepositoryPath.valid(file) || !physical.add((file + ".txt").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))) throw new IOException("Invalid or ambiguous file: " + file);
        }
        return new Plan(files, folders, bytes);
    }
    public static Plan snapshot(TextRepository repository) throws IOException {
        synchronized (repository) {
            var files = new TreeMap<String,String>(); var folders = new TreeSet<String>();
            var pending = new ArrayDeque<String>(); pending.add(""); long bytes = 0;
            while (!pending.isEmpty()) {
                interrupted();
                for (var entry : repository.entries(pending.remove())) {
                    if (entry.directory()) { folders.add(entry.path()); pending.add(entry.path()); }
                    else { String text = repository.read(entry.path()); bytes += text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).length; files.put(entry.path(),text); }
                    if (files.size() + folders.size() > MAX_ENTRIES || bytes > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES) throw new IOException("Project exceeds archive limits");
                }
            }
            return validated(files, folders, bytes);
        }
    }
    /** Write to a fresh name; publish only a complete archive. Parent folder must exist. */
    public static void write(Path destination, Plan plan) throws IOException {
        plan = validated(plan.documents(), plan.directories(), plan.bytes());
        if (Files.exists(destination, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) throw new IOException("Archive already exists");
        Path temporary = Files.createTempFile(destination.toAbsolutePath().getParent(), "genesis-export-", ".tmp");
        try {
            try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(temporary), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                put(zip, MANIFEST, HEADER.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                long bytes = 0;
                for (String folder : plan.directories()) { interrupted(); put(zip, "commands/" + folder + "/", new byte[0]); }
                for (var file : plan.documents().entrySet()) {
                    interrupted(); StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newEncoder().encode(java.nio.CharBuffer.wrap(file.getValue()));
                    byte[] data;
                    // Encoder buffers may have unused capacity; use exact UTF-8 bytes after strict validation.
                    data = file.getValue().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8); bytes += data.length;
                    if (data.length > TextRepository.MAX_BYTES || bytes > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES) throw new IOException("Project exceeds archive limits");
                    put(zip, "commands/" + file.getKey() + ".txt", data);
                }
            }
            Files.move(temporary, destination); // no replace; do not clobber a concurrently created export
        } finally { Files.deleteIfExists(temporary); }
    }
    private static void put(ZipOutputStream zip, String path, byte[] data) throws IOException {
        var entry = new ZipEntry(path); entry.setTime(0); zip.putNextEntry(entry); zip.write(data); zip.closeEntry();
    }
    /** Read bounded entry streams. Archive paths are identifiers, never extraction destinations. */
    public static Plan read(Path archive) throws IOException {
        if (Files.isSymbolicLink(archive) || !Files.isRegularFile(archive,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) throw new IOException("Invalid archive file");
        if (Files.size(archive) > 64L * 1024 * 1024) throw new IOException("Compressed archive exceeds 64 MiB limit");
        final int directoryEntries;
        try(var directory=new ZipFile(archive.toFile(),StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            directoryEntries=directory.size();
            if(directoryEntries>MAX_ENTRIES+1)throw new IOException("Too many archive entries");
        } catch(IllegalArgumentException error) { throw new IOException("Invalid ZIP directory",error); }
        var files = new TreeMap<String,String>(); var folders = new TreeSet<String>();
        Set<String> names = new HashSet<>(); boolean manifest = false; long total = 0; int count = 0;
        try (var input = Files.newInputStream(archive,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS); var zip = new ZipInputStream(input,StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            ZipEntry entry;
            while ((entry = zip.getNextEntry()) != null) {
                interrupted(); if (++count > MAX_ENTRIES + 1) throw new IOException("Too many archive entries");
                String name = entry.getName();
                if (!names.add(name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))) throw new IOException("Duplicate archive entry: " + name);
                int limit = name.equals(MANIFEST) ? 4096 : entry.isDirectory() ? 0 : TextRepository.MAX_BYTES;
                byte[] data = zip.readNBytes(limit + 1);
                if (data.length > limit) throw new IOException("Archive entry exceeds size limit: " + name);
                total += data.length; if (total > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES + 4096L) throw new IOException("Archive exceeds total size limit");
                if (name.equals(MANIFEST)) {
                    if (!new String(data,StandardCharsets.UTF_8).equals(HEADER)) throw new IOException("Unsupported project format/version");
                    manifest = true;
                } else {
                    if (!name.startsWith("commands/")) throw new IOException("Unknown archive entry: " + name);
                    String relative = name.substring(9);
                    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
                        if (relative.isEmpty()) continue;
                        relative = relative.substring(0,relative.length()-1);
                        if (!RepositoryPath.valid(relative)) throw new IOException("Invalid folder path: " + name);
                        folders.add(relative); addParents(relative,folders);
                    } else {
                        if (!relative.endsWith(".txt")) throw new IOException("Only text documents can be imported");
                        relative = relative.substring(0,relative.length()-4);
                        if (!RepositoryPath.valid(relative)) throw new IOException("Invalid file path: " + name);
                        files.put(relative,StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newDecoder().decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(data)).toString());
                        addParents(relative,folders);
                    }
                }
                zip.closeEntry();
            }
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException error) { throw new IOException("Invalid ZIP encoding",error); }
        if (count != directoryEntries) throw new IOException("ZIP directory does not match entry stream");
        if (!manifest) throw new IOException("Missing Genesis project manifest");
        return validated(files,folders,total - HEADER.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).length);
    }
}
