    @Test void versionOnePreferencesMigrateWithoutDiscardingPanelSizes() throws Exception {
        FMLPaths.loadAbsolutePaths(directory);
        Path path=directory.resolve("config/mared/editor_workbench.json");
        Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());
        Files.writeString(path,"{\"version\":1,\"selectedTab\":1,\"filesRatio\":0.25,\"helpRatio\":0.35,\"logsRatio\":0.30,\"helpOpen\":true}");
        var prefs=WorkbenchPreferences.load();
        assertEquals(2,prefs.version);assertEquals(1,prefs.selectedTab);
        assertEquals(.25,prefs.filesRatio);assertEquals(.35,prefs.helpRatio);assertEquals(.30,prefs.logsRatio);
        assertFalse(prefs.helpOpen);assertFalse(prefs.helpDocked);
        prefs.helpOpen=true;prefs.helpDocked=true;prefs.helpWindowX=.12;prefs.helpWindowW=.65;prefs.save();
        var restored=WorkbenchPreferences.load();
        assertTrue(restored.helpOpen);assertTrue(restored.helpDocked);
        assertEquals(.12,restored.helpWindowX);assertEquals(.65,restored.helpWindowW);
    }

    @Test void livePaletteCacheUsesThemeIdentityAndExplicitTextColorRemainsSupported() {
        FMLPaths.loadAbsolutePaths(directory);
        MaredTheme previous=MaredThemeRegistry.active();
        try {
            var first=MaredTheme.builder("same-id","First").bgPanel(0xFF101010).text(0xFFEFEFEF).build();
            var replacement=MaredTheme.builder("same-id","Replacement").light(true).bgPanel(0xFFFFFFFF).text(0xFF222222).build();
            MaredThemeRegistry.setActive(first);assertEquals(first.bgPanel,GenesisEditorVisuals.panel());
            MaredThemeRegistry.setActive(replacement);
            assertEquals(replacement.bgPanel,GenesisEditorVisuals.panel());assertEquals(replacement.text,GenesisEditorVisuals.text());
            assertEquals(replacement.text,SpanResolver.plain().baseColor());
            assertEquals(0xFF123456,SpanResolver.plain(0xFF123456).baseColor());
        } finally { MaredThemeRegistry.setActive(previous); }
    }
}

package com.fixmer.mared;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.editor.EditorLayout;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.editor.EditorLayout.Rect;
import com.fixmer.mared.gui2.navigation.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import java.util.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class EditorWorkbenchIntegrationTest {
    @org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir java.nio.file.Path directory;
    private List<Rect> rectangles(EditorLayout.Frame f){return List.of(f.rail(),f.toolbar(),f.files(),f.editor(),f.logs(),f.help(),f.status());}
    @Test void panelsTileScreenWithoutOverlapsAtEveryStateAndSize(){
        for(int w:new int[]{0,1,29,120,260,320,640,960,1280,1920})for(int h:new int[]{0,1,22,100,180,360,720,1080})
            for(int state=0;state<8;state++)for(double ratio:new double[]{Double.NaN,-1,.18,.6,Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY}){
                var frame=EditorLayout.calculate(w,h,ratio,ratio,ratio,(state&1)!=0,(state&2)!=0,(state&4)!=0);
                var rects=rectangles(frame);long area=0;
                for(Rect r:rects){assertTrue(r.x()>=0&&r.y()>=0&&r.right()<=w&&r.bottom()<=h,r.toString());area+=(long)r.width()*r.height();}
                assertEquals((long)w*h,area);
                for(int i=0;i<rects.size();i++)for(int j=i+1;j<rects.size();j++){
                    Rect a=rects.get(i),b=rects.get(j);assertFalse(Math.min(a.right(),b.right())>Math.max(a.x(),b.x())&&Math.min(a.bottom(),b.bottom())>Math.max(a.y(),b.y()));
                }
            }
    }
    @Test void collapsingReturnsEditorSpaceAndRestoresRequestedRatios(){
        var open=EditorLayout.calculate(640,360,.18,.29,.24,true,true,true);
        var closed=EditorLayout.calculate(640,360,.18,.29,.24,false,false,false);

package com.fixmer.mared;

 @Test public void unicodeAndSpacesRoundTripWithoutWritingAnySources()throws Exception{

  var state=new State("Мой проект",List.of(new Document("Мой проект","src/Мой класс.java",true),new Document("other",".gitignore",false)),List.of(new View("Мой проект",List.of("src","src/папка"),"src/папка","src/папка/read me.txt",19)));
  storage.save(state);assertEquals(state,storage.load());try(var entries=Files.list(root)){assertEquals(1L,entries.count());}assertTrue(Files.size(root.resolve(".genesis-workspace.properties"))<=EditorWorkspaceState.MAX_BYTES);

 @Test public void invalidStateDoesNotReplaceExistingContext()throws Exception{
  Path root=Files.createTempDirectory("workspace-refuse-");var storage=new EditorWorkspaceState(root);storage.save(EditorWorkspaceState.empty());byte[] original=Files.readAllBytes(root.resolve(".genesis-workspace.properties"));
  assertThrows(java.io.IOException.class,()->storage.save(new State("ok",List.of(new Document("ok","../escape.java",true)),List.of())));

===== src\test\java\com\fixmer\mared\ExecutionScopeIntegrationTest.java =====
package com.fixmer.mared;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.runtime.ExecutionScope;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.runtime.ExecutionScope.Kind;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class ExecutionScopeIntegrationTest {
    @Test void cancellationWaitsForExecutorAcknowledgementAndRunsCallbacksOnce() {
        var scope=new ExecutionScope();var calls=new AtomicInteger();
        scope.own(Kind.EVENT,calls::incrementAndGet);
        var executor=scope.own(Kind.EXECUTOR,calls::incrementAndGet);
        scope.close();scope.close();
        assertEquals(2,calls.get());assertEquals(1,scope.snapshot().resources());
        assertEquals(1,scope.snapshot().count(Kind.EXECUTOR));
        executor.close();assertEquals(0,scope.snapshot().resources());
        var late=scope.own(Kind.TIMER,calls::incrementAndGet);
        assertFalse(late.active());assertEquals(3,calls.get());assertEquals(0,scope.snapshot().resources());
    }
    @Test void normalCompletionReleasesCapacityAndSnapshotsAreImmutable() {
        var scope=new ExecutionScope(1);var lease=scope.own(Kind.BIND,()->{});
        var snapshot=scope.snapshot();
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException.class,()->scope.own(Kind.TIMER,()->{}));
        lease.close();lease.close();scope.own(Kind.EVENT,()->{});
        assertEquals(1,snapshot.count(Kind.BIND));assertEquals(1,scope.snapshot().count(Kind.EVENT));
        assertThrows(UnsupportedOperationException.class,()->snapshot.counts().clear());
        scope.close();assertEquals(0,scope.snapshot().resources());
    }
    @Test void failingCleanupDoesNotSkipOtherResources() {
        var scope=new ExecutionScope();var calls=new AtomicInteger();
        scope.own(Kind.EVENT,()->{throw new IllegalStateException("cleanup failed");});
        scope.own(Kind.BLOCK,calls::incrementAndGet);scope.close();
        assertEquals(1,calls.get());assertEquals(0,scope.snapshot().resources());
        assertNotNull(scope.snapshot().failure());assertEquals("cleanup failed",scope.snapshot().failure().getMessage());
    }
    @Test void registrationRacingCancellationCannotEscapeItsOwner() throws Exception {
        for(int i=0;i<100;i++){
            var scope=new ExecutionScope();var calls=new AtomicInteger();var failure=new AtomicReference<Throwable>();
            var gate=new CountDownLatch(1);
            var thread=new Thread(()->{try{gate.await();scope.own(Kind.EVENT,calls::incrementAndGet);}catch(Throwable error){failure.set(error);}});
            thread.start();gate.countDown();scope.close();thread.join(5000);
            assertFalse(thread.isAlive());assertNull(failure.get());assertEquals(1,calls.get());assertEquals(0,scope.snapshot().resources());
        }
    }
    @Test void cancellationCallbackDoesNotHoldTheScopeLock() {
        var scope=new ExecutionScope();var acknowledged=new CountDownLatch(1);
        scope.own(Kind.EVENT,()->{
            var worker=new Thread(()->{scope.snapshot();acknowledged.countDown();});worker.start();
            try { if(!acknowledged.await(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new IllegalStateException("scope lock held during callback"); }
            catch(InterruptedException error){Thread.currentThread().interrupt();throw new IllegalStateException(error);}
        });
        scope.close();assertNull(scope.snapshot().failure());assertEquals(0,acknowledged.getCount());
    }
}

package com.fixmer.mared;

import com.fixmer.mared.technology.runtime.CommandFilePlan;
import com.fixmer.mared.technology.runtime.RunJournal;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class FileRunToolsIntegrationTest {
    @Test void mixedFilesKeepRawNbtAndQuotedMrNbtSeparate() {
        var plan = CommandFilePlan.parse("#persistent\n/data merge entity @s {Name:'a } // b'}\n{\n// } ignored\nmc data merge entity @s {Name:'a } // b'};\n}\n/othermod:test");
        assertTrue(plan.persistent()); assertEquals(3, plan.parts().size());
        assertFalse(plan.parts().get(0).script());
        assertEquals("data merge entity @s {Name:'a } // b'}", plan.parts().get(0).text());
        assertTrue(plan.parts().get(1).script()); assertEquals(3, plan.parts().get(1).line());
        assertEquals("othermod:test", plan.parts().get(2).text());
        assertEquals("{ print ok }", CommandFilePlan.parse("{ print ok } // } comment").parts().get(0).text());
    }
    @Test void malformedAndOversizedPlansAreRejectedBeforeExecution() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> CommandFilePlan.parse("say before\n{ print incomplete"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> CommandFilePlan.parse("{ print ok } say unexpected"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> CommandFilePlan.parse("}"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> CommandFilePlan.parse("x".repeat(1_048_577)));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> CommandFilePlan.parse("say hi\n".repeat(4097)));
    }
    @Test void journalHasBoundedImmutableOutputAndClearRevision() {
        var journal = new RunJournal();
        for(int i=0;i<700;i++) journal.add("line " + i);
        var before=journal.snapshot();
        assertEquals(512,before.size()); assertEquals(188,journal.dropped());
        journal.add("x".repeat(5000));
        assertEquals("line 188",before.get(0).message());
        assertEquals(4097,journal.snapshot().get(511).message().length());
        assertThrows(UnsupportedOperationException.class, () -> before.clear());
        long revision=journal.revision(); journal.clear();
        assertTrue(journal.snapshot().isEmpty()); assertTrue(journal.revision()>revision);
    }
}

===== src\test\java\com\fixmer\mared\FolderStorageIntegrationTest.java =====
package com.fixmer.mared;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.RepositoryPath;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.TextRepository;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** Folder semantics use the production repository; no Minecraft window is required. */
public class FolderStorageIntegrationTest {
    @Test void legacyFilesAndEmptyFoldersArePreserved() throws Exception {
        Path root = Files.createTempDirectory("genesis-folders-");
        var repo = new TextRepository(root);
        repo.create("legacy", "old");
        repo.createDirectory("empty");
        repo.createDirectory("quests");
        repo.createDirectory("quests/chapter1");
        repo.create("quests/chapter1/start", "Привет 🌍");
        assertEquals(List.of("legacy", "quests/chapter1/start"), repo.list());
        assertEquals(List.of(new TextRepository.Entry("empty", true), new TextRepository.Entry("quests", true),
            new TextRepository.Entry("legacy", false)), repo.entries(""));
        assertEquals(List.of(), repo.entries("empty"));
        assertEquals("Привет 🌍", repo.read("quests/chapter1/start"));
        assertEquals("old", repo.read("legacy"));
    }
    @Test void movingDocumentInvalidatesBothSaveDestinations() throws Exception {
        var repo = new TextRepository(Files.createTempDirectory("genesis-move-"));
        repo.createDirectory("quests");
        repo.create("source", "base");
        var source = repo.capture("source");
        repo.create("quests/target", "previous");
        var previous = repo.capture("quests/target");
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> repo.rename("source", "quests/target"));
        assertEquals("previous", repo.read("quests/target"));
        repo.delete("quests/target");
        repo.rename("source", "quests/target");
        assertFalse(repo.write(source, "ghost source"));
        assertFalse(repo.write(previous, "ghost target"));
        assertFalse(repo.exists("source"));
        assertEquals("base", repo.read("quests/target"));
        assertTrue(repo.write(repo.capture("quests/target", "base"), "edited"));
    }
    @Test void pathsArePortableAndBounded() {
        for (String path : List.of("../escape", "a/../b", "/root", "a//b", "a/", "a\\b", ".hidden", "CON", "a/nul.py", "LPT1.txt", "a/" + "x".repeat(65), "a/".repeat(16) + "b", "x".repeat(300)))
            assertFalse(RepositoryPath.valid(path));
        assertTrue(RepositoryPath.valid("quests/chapter_1/start.v2"));
        assertEquals("quests/chapter_1", RepositoryPath.parent("quests/chapter_1/start"));
        assertEquals("start", RepositoryPath.leaf("quests/chapter_1/start"));
    }
    @Test void missingParentsAndCollisionsDoNotModifyFiles() throws Exception {
        Path root = Files.createTempDirectory("genesis-parents-");
        var repo = new TextRepository(root);
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> repo.create("missing/file", "bad"));
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> repo.createDirectory("missing/child"));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(root.resolve("missing")));
        repo.createDirectory("folder");
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> repo.createDirectory("folder"));
        repo.create("folder/file", "protected");
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> repo.create("folder/file", "overwrite"));
        assertEquals("protected", repo.read("folder/file"));
    }
    @Test void nestedSymlinksCannotEscapeRepository() throws Exception {
        Path root = Files.createTempDirectory("genesis-links-");
        Path outside = Files.createTempDirectory("genesis-outside-");
        Files.writeString(outside.resolve("file.txt"), "protected");
        var repo = new TextRepository(root);
        repo.createDirectory("safe");
        try { Files.createSymbolicLink(root.resolve("safe/link"), outside); }
        catch (UnsupportedOperationException | FileSystemException error) {
            org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.assumeTrue(false, "Symlink creation unavailable");
            return;
        }
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> repo.read("safe/link/file"));
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> repo.create("safe/link/new", "bad"));
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> repo.createDirectory("safe/link/new"));
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> repo.entries("safe/link"));
        assertEquals(List.of(), repo.list());
        assertEquals("protected", Files.readString(outside.resolve("file.txt")));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(outside.resolve("new.txt")));
    }
    @Test void externalEditStillConflictsInsideFolder() throws Exception {
        Path root = Files.createTempDirectory("genesis-conflict-");
        var repo = new TextRepository(root);
        repo.createDirectory("folder");
        repo.create("folder/file", "base");
        var ticket = repo.capture("folder/file", "base");
        Files.writeString(root.resolve("folder/file.txt"), "external");
        assertFalse(repo.write(ticket, "editor"));
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> repo.capture("folder/file", "base"));
        assertEquals("external", repo.read("folder/file"));
    }
}

package com.fixmer.mared;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class GradleTasksIntegrationTest {
    @Test void groupedTasksModulePathsDescriptionsAndRulesAreParsedWithoutInventedTasks(){
        var c=GradleTasks.parse("""
            Configuration log - not a task
            Tasks runnable from root project 'example'
            ------------------------------------------
            Build tasks
            -----------
            build - Assembles and tests this project.
            client:build - Builds the client модуль.
            :server:build - Builds the server.

            Other tasks
            -----------
            compileJava
            build - repeated description
            --bad - flag
            ../escape - unsafe
            custom task - unsupported

            Rules
            -----
            Pattern: clean<TaskName>: Cleans the output files of a task.
            phantom - not a task
            BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 2s
            """,false);
        assertEquals(4,c.tasks().size());assertFalse(c.limited());assertEquals(1,c.filter("CLIENT модуль").size());assertEquals("client:build",c.filter("client модуль").get(0).path());assertEquals(3,c.filter("build tasks").size());assertTrue(c.filter("missing").isEmpty());assertThrows(UnsupportedOperationException.class,()->c.tasks().clear());assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->new GradleTasks.Task("--all","",""));
    }
    @Test void ansiEmptyDescriptionsDuplicatesAndOutputLimitsAreBounded(){
        var c=GradleTasks.parse("\u001b[32mOther tasks\u001b[0m\r\n---\r\nbuild\r\nbuild - Full description\r\n",false);assertEquals(1,c.tasks().size());assertEquals("Full description",c.tasks().get(0).description());
        assertTrue(GradleTasks.parse("",true).limited());var many=new StringBuilder("Other tasks\n---\n");for(int i=0;i<600;i++)many.append("task").append(i).append(" - description\n");var capped=GradleTasks.parse(many.toString(),false);assertEquals(512,capped.tasks().size());assertTrue(capped.limited());assertTrue(GradleTasks.parse("x".repeat(GradleTasks.MAX_CHARS+1),false).limited());assertTrue(GradleTasks.parse("Other tasks\n---\n"+"x".repeat(2049),false).limited());assertTrue(GradleTasks.parse("Random heading\n---\nphantom - noise",false).tasks().isEmpty());
    }
    static Path wrapper()throws Exception{
        Path root=Files.createTempDirectory("tasks-wrapper-");Path src=root.resolve("org/gradle/wrapper/GradleWrapperMain.java");Files.createDirectories(src.getParent());Files.writeString(src,"""
            package org.gradle.wrapper;import java.nio.file.*;public class GradleWrapperMain{public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
                Path p=Path.of(args[1]);Files.writeString(p.resolve("argv.txt"),String.join("\\n",args));
                if(Files.exists(p.resolve("fail"))){System.out.println("configuration failed");System.exit(7);}
                if(Files.exists(p.resolve("wait")))Thread.sleep(5000);
                if(!args[args.length-1].equals("--all")||!args[args.length-2].equals("tasks"))throw new AssertionError("Wrong task listing arguments");

            }}

    }
    static GradleBuildRunner.Result finish(GradleBuildRunner runner)throws Exception{GradleBuildRunner.Result[] r={null};long end=System.nanoTime()+10_000_000_000L;while(runner.busy()&&System.nanoTime()<end){runner.poll(v->r[0]=v);Thread.sleep(5);}assertNotNull(r[0]);assertFalse(runner.busy());return r[0];}

package com.fixmer.mared;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.SourceProjects;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class GradleWorkspaceFilesIntegrationTest {
    @Test void setupPreservesSourcesAndKeepsTestsOutsideDirectRun() throws Exception {
        Path root=Files.createTempDirectory("gradle-files-");var store=new SourceProjects(root);
        store.create("demo",SourceProjects.Language.JAVA);String source=store.read("demo","src/Main.java");
        store.initializeGradle("demo");assertTrue(store.hasGradle("demo"));
        assertEquals(source,store.read("demo","src/Main.java"));
        assertTrue(store.read("demo","build.gradle").contains("JavaLanguageVersion.of(21)"));
        assertTrue(store.read("demo","build.gradle").contains("version = '0.4.0'"));
        store.createFile("demo","tests/demo/Test.java");
        store.save("demo","tests/demo/Test.java","","this is deliberately invalid Java");
        assertTrue(store.files("demo").contains("tests/demo/Test.java"));
        assertEquals(Set.of("src/Main.java"),store.javaSources("demo",Map.of()).keySet());
        Files.delete(root.resolve("demo/src/Main.java"));Files.delete(root.resolve("demo/src"));
        assertTrue(store.files("demo").containsAll(List.of("build.gradle","settings.gradle","tests/demo/Test.java")));
    }
    @Test void existingConfigurationsAndOtherLanguagesAreNeverOverwritten() throws Exception {
        Path root=Files.createTempDirectory("gradle-conflicts-");var store=new SourceProjects(root);
        for(String name:List.of("build.gradle","settings.gradle","build.gradle.kts","settings.gradle.kts")){
            String id="p"+name.replace('.','_');store.create(id,SourceProjects.Language.JAVA);
            store.createFile(id,name);store.save(id,name,"","// user configuration\n");
            assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.initializeGradle(id));
            assertEquals("// user configuration\n",store.read(id,name));
            assertEquals(2,store.files(id).size());
        }
        store.create("py",SourceProjects.Language.PYTHON);
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.initializeGradle("py"));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(root.resolve("py/build.gradle")));
        assertFalse(SourceProjects.validFile("../build.gradle"));
        assertFalse(SourceProjects.validFile("gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar"));
    }
    @Test void exportIncludesBuildDraftsTestsAndWrapperWithoutSavingOrLeakingEditorState() throws Exception {
        Path root=Files.createTempDirectory("gradle-export-");var store=new SourceProjects(root);
        store.create("demo",SourceProjects.Language.JAVA);store.initializeGradle("demo");
        store.createFile("demo","tests/demo/Test.java");String before=store.read("demo","build.gradle"),draft=before+"// draft\n";
        store.checkpoint("demo","build.gradle",before,draft);
        Path wrapper=root.resolve("demo/gradle/wrapper");Files.createDirectories(wrapper);
        byte[] binary={0,1,2,(byte)255};Files.write(wrapper.resolve("gradle-wrapper.jar"),binary);
        Files.writeString(wrapper.resolve("gradle-wrapper.properties"),"distributionUrl=example\n");
        Files.writeString(root.resolve("demo/gradlew.bat"),"@echo off\n");
        Files.writeString(root.resolve(".build-tools.properties"),"java_home=private-machine-path\n");
        var edits=Map.of("build.gradle",new SourceProjects.Recovery(before,draft));
        try(var zip=new ZipFile(store.exportJava("demo",edits).toFile())){
            assertEquals(draft,new String(zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("build.gradle")).readAllBytes(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            for(String name:List.of("settings.gradle","tests/demo/Test.java","gradlew.bat","gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties"))assertNotNull(zip.getEntry(name));
            assertTrue(Arrays.equals(binary,zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar")).readAllBytes()));
            assertNull(zip.getEntry(".build-tools.properties"));
            assertTrue(zip.stream().noneMatch(e->e.getName().contains(".genesis-recovery")));
        }
        assertEquals(before,store.read("demo","build.gradle"));
        store.save("demo","build.gradle",before,"external\n");
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.exportJava("demo",edits));
    }

        Path p=project(),wrapper=wrapper();try(var runner=new GradleBuildRunner(5000)){assertTrue(runner.start(p,settings(wrapper),"build"));assertFalse(runner.start(p,settings(wrapper),"build"));var result=finish(runner);assertEquals(GradleBuildRunner.Status.SUCCESS,result.status());assertTrue(result.output().contains("Привет"));assertEquals(1,result.artifacts().size());String arguments=Files.readString(p.resolve(".genesis-build/argv.txt"));assertTrue(arguments.contains(p.toString()));assertTrue(arguments.contains("--no-daemon"));assertTrue(arguments.contains("--console=plain"));}
        try(var runner=new GradleBuildRunner(5000)){runner.start(p,settings(wrapper),"live");String live="";long end=System.nanoTime()+java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(2);while(!live.contains("Привет")&&System.nanoTime()<end){live+=runner.drainOutput();Thread.sleep(5);}assertTrue(live.contains("Привет"));assertTrue(runner.busy());assertEquals(GradleBuildRunner.Status.SUCCESS,finish(runner).status());}
    }
    @Test void failedTasksTimeoutCancellationCloseAndRestartAreHandled()throws Exception{
        Path p=project(),wrapper=wrapper();try(var runner=new GradleBuildRunner(5000)){runner.start(p,settings(wrapper),"fail");var failed=finish(runner);assertEquals(GradleBuildRunner.Status.FAILED,failed.status());assertEquals(23,failed.exitCode());runner.start(p,settings(wrapper),"wait");Thread.sleep(150);runner.stop();assertEquals(GradleBuildRunner.Status.CANCELLED,finish(runner).status());runner.start(p,settings(wrapper),"stdin");assertTrue(finish(runner).output().contains("EOF=-1"));runner.start(p,settings(wrapper),"wait");runner.close();assertEquals(GradleBuildRunner.Status.CANCELLED,finish(runner).status());assertFalse(runner.start(p,settings(wrapper),"build"));}
        try(var runner=new GradleBuildRunner(100)){runner.start(p,settings(wrapper),"wait");assertEquals(GradleBuildRunner.Status.TIMEOUT,finish(runner).status());}
    }

    @Test void invalidTasksAndToolsDoNotStartProcesses()throws Exception{
        Path p=project();try(var runner=new GradleBuildRunner(5000)){
            for(String task:List.of("--init-script","build;anything","build test","../build")){runner.start(p,settings(wrapper()),task);assertEquals(GradleBuildRunner.Status.INPUT_ERROR,finish(runner).status());assertFalse(Files.exists(p.resolve(".genesis-build/argv.txt")));}
            runner.start(p,settings(p.resolve("missing.jar")),"build");assertEquals(GradleBuildRunner.Status.INPUT_ERROR,finish(runner).status());
        }
        assertTrue(GradleBuildRunner.validTask(":module:build"));assertFalse(GradleBuildRunner.validAbsolutePath("relative"));assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->new GradleBuildRunner(0));
    }
    @Test void delayedReaderOutputCannotContaminateAnotherBuild()throws Exception{
        Path p=project();try(var runner=new GradleBuildRunner(5000)){
            runner.start(p,settings(wrapper()),"wait");
            var tokenField=GradleBuildRunner.class.getDeclaredField("cancellation");tokenField.setAccessible(true);
            Object oldToken=tokenField.get(runner);runner.stop();assertEquals(GradleBuildRunner.Status.CANCELLED,finish(runner).status());
            runner.start(p,settings(wrapper()),"live");
            // Model delivery by the previous reader after cancellation and after the new capture was reset.
            var delivery=GradleBuildRunner.class.getDeclaredMethod("append",String.class,java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean.class);delivery.setAccessible(true);
            delivery.invoke(runner,"STALE_PREVIOUS_BUILD",oldToken);
            var result=finish(runner);assertEquals(GradleBuildRunner.Status.SUCCESS,result.status());
            assertFalse(result.output().contains("STALE_PREVIOUS_BUILD"));assertFalse(runner.drainOutput().contains("STALE_PREVIOUS_BUILD"));
        }
    }

===== src\test\java\com\fixmer\mared\JavaLibraryIntegrationTest.java =====
package com.fixmer.mared;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.jar.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class JavaLibraryIntegrationTest {
    private static final JavaSourceRunner.Limits LIMITS=JavaSourceRunner.Limits.defaults();
    private static Map<String,String> source(String body){return Map.of("src/Main.java","public class Main{public static void main(String[]a)throws Exception{"+body+"}}");}
    private static byte[] jar(Map<String,byte[]> entries,String classPath)throws Exception{
        var manifest=new Manifest();manifest.getMainAttributes().putValue("Manifest-Version","1.0");
        if(classPath!=null)manifest.getMainAttributes().putValue("Class-Path",classPath);
        var bytes=new ByteArrayOutputStream();try(var out=new JarOutputStream(bytes,manifest)){for(var e:entries.entrySet()){out.putNextEntry(new JarEntry(e.getKey()));out.write(e.getValue());out.closeEntry();}}return bytes.toByteArray();
    }
    private static byte[] library(String name,String text,byte[] dependency,Map<String,byte[]> resources)throws Exception{
        Path root=Files.createTempDirectory("java-library-");
        try{
            Path src=root.resolve(name+".java"),classes=Files.createDirectory(root.resolve("classes"));Files.writeString(src,text);
            var args=new ArrayList<String>(List.of("-proc:none","-encoding","UTF-8","-d",classes.toString()));
            if(dependency!=null){Path dep=root.resolve("dependency.jar");Files.write(dep,dependency);args.addAll(List.of("-cp",dep.toString()));}args.add(src.toString());
            assertEquals(0,ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,args.toArray(String[]::new)));
            var entries=new TreeMap<String,byte[]>(resources);try(var walk=Files.walk(classes)){for(Path p:walk.filter(Files::isRegularFile).toList())entries.put(classes.relativize(p).toString().replace('\\','/'),Files.readAllBytes(p));}
            return jar(entries,null);
        }finally{try(var walk=Files.walk(root)){for(Path p:walk.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toList())Files.deleteIfExists(p);}}
    }
    private static JavaSourceRunner.Result run(Map<String,byte[]> libraries,String body){return new JavaSourceRunner().run(source(body),libraries,"Main",LIMITS,new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation());}
    @Test void realLibrariesWorkAtCompileAndRuntimeWithTransitiveClassesAndResources()throws Exception{
        byte[] b=library("B","package example;public class B{public static String value(){return \"library-B\";}}",null,Map.of());
        byte[] a=library("A","package example;public class A{public static String value(){return B.value();}}",b,Map.of("message.txt","Привет из JAR".getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
        var result=run(Map.of("a.jar",a,"b.jar",b),"System.out.println(example.A.value());try(var in=Main.class.getClassLoader().getResourceAsStream(\"message.txt\")){System.out.println(new String(in.readAllBytes(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}");
        assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.SUCCESS,result.status());assertTrue(result.output().contains("library-B"));assertTrue(result.output().contains("Привет из JAR"));
        assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.COMPILE_ERROR,run(Map.of(),"System.out.println(example.A.value());").status());
        var missing=run(Map.of("a.jar",a),"System.out.println(example.A.value());");assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.RUNTIME_ERROR,missing.status());assertTrue(missing.output().contains("example/B"));
    }
    @Test void changedLibraryIsUsedOnNextRunAndPreviousSnapshotIsIndependent()throws Exception{
        var root=Files.createTempDirectory("java-library-store-");var store=new SourceProjects(root);store.create("demo",SourceProjects.Language.JAVA);
        byte[] old=library("Value","package example;public class Value{public static int number(){return 1;}}",null,Map.of());
        byte[] next=library("Value","package example;public class Value{public static int number(){return 2;}}",null,Map.of());
        Path path=root.resolve("demo/libraries/value.jar");Files.write(path,old);var snapshot=store.javaLibraries("demo");Files.write(path,next);
        assertTrue(run(snapshot,"System.out.println(example.Value.number());").output().contains("1"));
        assertTrue(run(store.javaLibraries("demo"),"System.out.println(example.Value.number());").output().contains("2"));
        assertTrue(Arrays.equals(next,Files.readAllBytes(path)));assertThrows(UnsupportedOperationException.class,()->snapshot.put("new.jar",old));
    }
    @Test void malformedArchivesManifestEscapesAndZipBombsAreRejectedBeforeCompile()throws Exception{
        for(var data:List.of(new byte[]{1,2,3},jar(Map.of("ok.txt",new byte[]{1}),"../outside.jar"),jar(Map.of("../outside.class",new byte[]{1}),null),jar(Map.of("META-INF/INDEX.LIST",new byte[]{1}),null),jar(Map.of("huge.bin",new byte[JavaSourceRunner.MAX_LIBRARY_BYTES+1]),null))){
            var result=run(Map.of("bad.jar",data),"System.out.println(\"must not execute\");");assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.INPUT_ERROR,result.status());assertEquals("prepare",result.phase());assertFalse(result.output().contains("must not execute"));
        }
        assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.INPUT_ERROR,run(Map.of("../escape.jar",new byte[]{1}),"").status());
        assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.INPUT_ERROR,run(Map.of("x.jar",new byte[]{1},"X.JAR",new byte[]{1}),"").status());
        var many=new HashMap<String,byte[]>();for(int i=0;i<33;i++)many.put("j"+i+".jar",new byte[]{1});assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.INPUT_ERROR,run(many,"").status());
    }
    @Test void libraryDirectoryRefusesLinksFoldersAndOversizeButIgnoresPlainNotes()throws Exception{
        var root=Files.createTempDirectory("java-library-path-");var store=new SourceProjects(root);store.create("demo",SourceProjects.Language.JAVA);Path folder=root.resolve("demo/libraries");
        Files.writeString(folder.resolve("README.md"),"ignored");assertTrue(store.javaLibraries("demo").isEmpty());
        Files.createDirectory(folder.resolve("nested"));assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.javaLibraries("demo"));Files.delete(folder.resolve("nested"));
        Files.write(folder.resolve("empty.jar"),new byte[0]);assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.javaLibraries("demo"));Files.delete(folder.resolve("empty.jar"));
        try(var channel=java.nio.channels.FileChannel.open(folder.resolve("large.jar"),StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW,StandardOpenOption.WRITE)){channel.position(JavaSourceRunner.MAX_LIBRARY_BYTES);channel.write(java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(new byte[]{0}));}
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.javaLibraries("demo"));Files.delete(folder.resolve("large.jar"));
        if(!System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("win")){Path outside=Files.createTempFile("external-library-",".jar");Files.createSymbolicLink(folder.resolve("linked.jar"),outside);assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.javaLibraries("demo"));}
        store.create("py",SourceProjects.Language.PYTHON);assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.javaLibraries("py"));
    }
    @Test void annotationProcessorServicesAreNotExecutedDuringCompilation()throws Exception{
        byte[] dependency=jar(Map.of("META-INF/services/javax.annotation.processing.Processor","missing.BadProcessor\n".getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)),null);
        var result=run(Map.of("processor.jar",dependency),"System.out.println(\"no processor\");");assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.SUCCESS,result.status());assertTrue(result.output().contains("no processor"));
    }
    @Test void editorRunAdapterActuallyIncludesProjectLibraries()throws Exception{
        var root=Files.createTempDirectory("java-library-adapter-");var store=new SourceProjects(root);store.create("demo",SourceProjects.Language.JAVA);
        Files.write(root.resolve("demo/libraries/value.jar"),library("Value","package example;public class Value{public static String value(){return \"adapter-library\";}}",null,Map.of()));
        String baseline=store.read("demo","src/Main.java");
        try(var runs=new com.fixmer.mared.technology.scripts.JavaProjectRuns(store)){
            assertTrue(runs.start("demo","Main",Map.of("src/Main.java",new SourceProjects.Recovery(baseline,source("System.out.println(example.Value.value());").get("src/Main.java")))));
            JavaSourceRunner.Result[] result={null};long deadline=System.nanoTime()+java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(20);
            while(runs.busy()&&System.nanoTime()<deadline){runs.poll(value->result[0]=value);Thread.sleep(5);}
            assertFalse(runs.busy());assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.SUCCESS,result[0].status());assertTrue(result[0].output().contains("adapter-library"));assertEquals(baseline,store.read("demo","src/Main.java"));
        }
    }

    @Test void automaticCompilerPluginsCannotRunFromUserLibraries()throws Exception{
        byte[] dependency=library("AutoPlugin","public class AutoPlugin implements com.sun.source.util.Plugin{public String getName(){return \"GenesisTest\";}public boolean autoStart(){return true;}public void init(com.sun.source.util.JavacTask task,String...args){throw new IllegalStateException(\"must not start during compilation\");}}",null,Map.of("META-INF/services/com.sun.source.util.Plugin","AutoPlugin\n".getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
        var result=run(Map.of("plugin.jar",dependency),"System.out.println(\"plain source\");");assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.SUCCESS,result.status());assertTrue(result.output().contains("plain source"));
    }

}

===== src\test\java\com\fixmer\mared\JavaSourceRunnerIntegrationTest.java =====
package com.fixmer.mared;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import java.util.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class JavaSourceRunnerIntegrationTest {
    private final JavaSourceRunner runner=new JavaSourceRunner();
    private static Map<String,String> source(String body){return Map.of("src/Main.java","public class Main {public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {"+body+"}}");}
    private JavaSourceRunner.Result run(String body){return runner.run(source(body),"Main",JavaSourceRunner.Limits.defaults(),new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation());}
    @Test void realCompilerRunsUnicodeAndMultiplePackagedSources() {
        var result=runner.run(Map.of("src/demo/App.java","package demo; public class App {public static void main(String[] a){System.out.println(Helper.text());}}","src/demo/Helper.java","package demo; final class Helper {static String text(){return \"Привет, Genesis\";}}"),"demo.App",JavaSourceRunner.Limits.defaults(),new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation());
        assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.SUCCESS,result.status());assertTrue(result.output().contains("Привет, Genesis"));assertEquals(0,result.exitCode());
    }
    @Test void syntaxErrorsAndRuntimeExitAreDifferentAndDoNotExitHost() {
        var compilation=run("not valid java;");assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.COMPILE_ERROR,compilation.status());assertEquals("compile",compilation.phase());assertTrue(compilation.output().contains("Main.java"));
        assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.COMPILE_ERROR,run("System.out.println(com.fixmer.mared.Mared.class);").status());
        var exited=run("System.exit(7);");assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.RUNTIME_ERROR,exited.status());assertEquals(7,exited.exitCode());
        var noMain=runner.run(Map.of("src/Main.java","public class Main {}"),"Main",JavaSourceRunner.Limits.defaults(),new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation());assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.RUNTIME_ERROR,noMain.status());
    }
    @Test void timeoutOutputFloodAndClosedStdinAreBounded() {
        var timeout=runner.run(source("while(true){Thread.sleep(10);}"),"Main",new JavaSourceRunner.Limits(20_000,200,1024,64),new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation());assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.TIMEOUT,timeout.status());
        var flood=runner.run(source("while(true){System.out.print(\"abcdefghij\");}"),"Main",new JavaSourceRunner.Limits(20_000,3000,1024,64),new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation());assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.OUTPUT_LIMIT,flood.status());assertTrue(flood.output().getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8).length<=1024);
        var stdin=run("System.out.println(System.in.read());");assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.SUCCESS,stdin.status());assertTrue(stdin.output().contains("-1"));
    }
    @Test void cancellationBeforeStartAndDuringRunStopsWork() throws Exception {
        var cancelled=new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation();cancelled.cancel();assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.CANCELLED,runner.run(source("System.out.println(1);"),"Main",JavaSourceRunner.Limits.defaults(),cancelled).status());
        var active=new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation();var pool=java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
        try {var future=pool.submit(()->runner.run(source("while(true){Thread.sleep(10);}"),"Main",JavaSourceRunner.Limits.defaults(),active));long end=System.nanoTime()+java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(20);
            while(!active.phase().equals("run")&&!future.isDone()&&System.nanoTime()<end)Thread.sleep(10);assertEquals("run",active.phase());active.cancel();assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.CANCELLED,future.get(5,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS).status());
        }finally{pool.shutdownNow();}
    }
    @Test void pathsEntryPointsLimitsAndUnavailableRuntimeNeverLaunch() {
        for(String path:List.of("../Main.java","src/../../Main.java","src/module-info.java","src/Main.txt"))assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.INPUT_ERROR,runner.run(Map.of(path,""),"Main",JavaSourceRunner.Limits.defaults(),new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation()).status());
        assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.INPUT_ERROR,runner.run(source(""),"-version",JavaSourceRunner.Limits.defaults(),new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation()).status());
        assertFalse(JavaSourceRunner.validMainClass("demo.Main;anything"));assertTrue(JavaSourceRunner.validMainClass("demo.Main$Nested"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->new JavaSourceRunner.Limits(0,1,1,64));
        assertEquals(JavaSourceRunner.Status.UNAVAILABLE,new JavaSourceRunner(Path.of("missing-jdk-home")).run(source(""),"Main",JavaSourceRunner.Limits.defaults(),new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation()).status());
    }
    @Test void entryPointChangesPreserveMetadataAndSupportExistingProjects() throws Exception {
        var root=Files.createTempDirectory("java-main-");var store=new SourceProjects(root);store.create("demo",SourceProjects.Language.JAVA);
        Path metadata=root.resolve("demo/genesis-project.properties");String before=Files.readString(metadata)+"# retain comment\ncustom=value\n";Files.writeString(metadata,before);
        assertEquals("Main",store.javaMainClass("demo"));store.setJavaMainClass("demo","demo.App$Nested");assertEquals("demo.App$Nested",store.javaMainClass("demo"));assertTrue(Files.readString(metadata).contains("custom=value"));assertTrue(Files.readString(metadata).contains("# retain comment"));
        store.setJavaMainClass("demo","Main");assertEquals(1,Files.readString(metadata).split("main_class=",-1).length-1);
        assertThrows(java.io.IOException.class,()->store.setJavaMainClass("demo","-version"));
        Files.writeString(metadata,before+"main_class=bad class\n");store.setJavaMainClass("demo","demo.Main");assertEquals("demo.Main",store.javaMainClass("demo"));
    }
    @Test void sourceSnapshotIncludesDraftsRefusesStaleBasesAndDoesNotSaveOriginals() throws Exception {
        var root=Files.createTempDirectory("java-input-");var store=new SourceProjects(root);store.create("demo",SourceProjects.Language.JAVA);String baseline=store.read("demo","src/Main.java");

===== src\test\java\com\fixmer\mared\LineToolsIntegrationTest.java =====
package com.fixmer.mared;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.editor.LineTools;
import com.fixmer.mared.technology.runtime.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
class LineToolsIntegrationTest {
    private LineTools.Result edit(String s,int a,int b,LineTools.Operation op){return LineTools.edit(s,a,b,b,0,op,100000);}
    @Test void duplicatesAndMovesCompleteLinesIncludingTrailingEmptyLine(){
        assertEquals("a\nb\nb",edit("a\nb",1,1,LineTools.Operation.DUPLICATE).text());
        assertEquals("\n",edit("",0,0,LineTools.Operation.DUPLICATE).text());
        assertEquals("a\n\n",edit("a\n",1,1,LineTools.Operation.DUPLICATE).text());
        assertEquals("b\nc\na\nd",edit("a\nb\nc\nd",1,2,LineTools.Operation.UP).text());
        assertEquals("a\nd\nb\nc",edit("a\nb\nc\nd",1,2,LineTools.Operation.DOWN).text());
        assertEquals("a\nb",edit("a\nb",0,0,LineTools.Operation.UP).text());
        assertEquals("a\nb",edit("a\nb",1,1,LineTools.Operation.DOWN).text());
    }
    @Test void commentTogglePreservesIndentationBlankLinesAndNestedExistingComments(){
        String text="  say 😀\n\t// existing\n   \n";
        var commented=edit(text,0,3,LineTools.Operation.COMMENT);
        assertEquals("  // say 😀\n\t// // existing\n   \n",commented.text());
        assertEquals(text,edit(commented.text(),0,3,LineTools.Operation.COMMENT).text());
        assertEquals("   \n\t",edit("   \n\t",0,1,LineTools.Operation.COMMENT).text());
        assertEquals("say hi",edit("//say hi",0,0,LineTools.Operation.COMMENT).text());
        assertEquals(3,LineTools.offset("😀\nx",1,0));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->LineTools.edit("aaa",0,0,0,0,LineTools.Operation.DUPLICATE,4));
    }
    @Test void randomMovesAreReversible(){
        var random=new java.util.Random(706);
        for(int n=0;n<2000;n++){
            int count=2+random.nextInt(40);var lines=new java.util.ArrayList<String>();for(int i=0;i<count;i++)lines.add(i%3==0?"":"row"+i);
            String source=String.join("\n",lines);int first=random.nextInt(count-1),last=first+random.nextInt(count-1-first);
            var moved=edit(source,first,last,LineTools.Operation.DOWN);
            assertEquals(source,edit(moved.text(),moved.first(),moved.last(),LineTools.Operation.UP).text());
        }
    }
    @Test void fragmentIncludesOnlyWholeCommandsAndNeverInheritsPersistent(){
        String source="#persistent\n/say first\n{\nprint \\\"ignored\\\"\n}\nsay last".replace("\\\"","\"");
        String first=CommandFragment.extract(source,1,0,1,10);var plan=CommandFilePlan.parse(first);
        assertFalse(plan.persistent());assertEquals(1,plan.parts().size());assertEquals("say first",plan.parts().get(0).text());
        String block=CommandFragment.extract(source,2,0,4,1);assertTrue(CommandFilePlan.parse(block).parts().get(0).script());
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->CommandFragment.extract(source,3,0,3,source.split("\n")[3].length()));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->CommandFragment.extract(source,1,1,1,10));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->CommandFragment.extract(source,0,0,0,11));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->CommandFragment.extract("// nothing",0,0,0,10));
    }
}

===== src\test\java\com\fixmer\mared\MinecraftCommandToolsIntegrationTest.java =====
package com.fixmer.mared;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.editor.CommandInput;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.editor.ScriptHeads;
import com.fixmer.mared.commands.engine.MaredScriptParser;
import com.fixmer.mared.commands.server_cmd.MaredMcCommand;
import com.fixmer.mared.technology.catalog.BrigadierCommandTools;
import com.mojang.brigadier.CommandDispatcher;
import com.mojang.brigadier.arguments.IntegerArgumentType;
import com.mojang.brigadier.arguments.StringArgumentType;
import com.mojang.brigadier.builder.LiteralArgumentBuilder;
import com.mojang.brigadier.builder.RequiredArgumentBuilder;
import com.mojang.brigadier.suggestion.Suggestions;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletionException;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class MinecraftCommandToolsIntegrationTest {
    @Test void realBrigadierValidatesModCommandsArgumentsRedirectsWithoutExecuting() {
        var dispatcher = new CommandDispatcher<Object>();
        int[] executions = {0};
        dispatcher.register(LiteralArgumentBuilder.<Object>literal("testmod:trade")
            .then(RequiredArgumentBuilder.<Object, Integer>argument("price", IntegerArgumentType.integer(0, 100))
                .executes(ctx -> { executions[0]++; return 1; })));
        dispatcher.register(LiteralArgumentBuilder.<Object>literal("alias").redirect(dispatcher.getRoot()));
        var tools = new BrigadierCommandTools<>(dispatcher, new Object());
        assertTrue(tools.check("testmod:trade 4").valid());
        assertTrue(tools.check("alias testmod:trade 4").valid());
        assertFalse(tools.check("testmod:trade").valid());
        assertFalse(tools.check("testmod:trade 101").valid());
        assertFalse(tools.check("testmod:trade 4 extra").valid());
        assertFalse(tools.check("missing:command").valid());
        assertEquals(0, executions[0]);
    }

    @Test void realSuggestionsUseNewRegistrationsAndArgumentProvider() {
        var dispatcher = new CommandDispatcher<Object>();
        dispatcher.register(LiteralArgumentBuilder.<Object>literal("testmod:trade")
            .then(RequiredArgumentBuilder.<Object, String>argument("item", StringArgumentType.word())
                .suggests((ctx, builder) -> builder.suggest("custommod:item").buildFuture())
                .executes(ctx -> 1)));
        var tools = new BrigadierCommandTools<>(dispatcher, new Object());
        var root = tools.complete("testmod:tr", 10).join();
        assertTrue(root.stream().anyMatch(c -> c.text().equals("testmod:trade")));
        var argument = tools.complete("testmod:trade ", 14).join();
        assertTrue(argument.stream().anyMatch(c -> c.text().equals("custommod:item") && c.start() == 14));
        dispatcher.register(LiteralArgumentBuilder.<Object>literal("newmod:added").executes(ctx -> 1));
        assertTrue(tools.complete("newmod:", 7).join().stream().anyMatch(c -> c.text().equals("newmod:added")));
    }

    @Test void providerThatNeverCompletesTimesOutWithoutCancellingItsOwnFuture() {
        var dispatcher = new CommandDispatcher<Object>();
        var provider = new CompletableFuture<Suggestions>();
        dispatcher.register(LiteralArgumentBuilder.<Object>literal("test")
            .then(RequiredArgumentBuilder.<Object, String>argument("value", StringArgumentType.word())
                .suggests((ctx, builder) -> provider).executes(ctx -> 1)));
        var tools = new BrigadierCommandTools<>(dispatcher, new Object());
        assertThrows(CompletionException.class, () -> tools.complete("test ", 5).join());
        assertFalse(provider.isCancelled());
        assertFalse(provider.isDone());
    }

    @Test void sharedScannerKeepsNbtQuotesAndControlBlockBoundaries() {
        String script = "if true { mc data merge entity @s {Name:'a } ; // b', Nested:{x:1}}; mc /testmod:trade 4 }";
        var snippets = ScriptHeads.minecraft(script, 10);
        assertEquals(2, snippets.size());
        assertEquals("data merge entity @s {Name:'a } ; // b', Nested:{x:1}}", snippets.getFirst().input().text());
        // Completion keeps the separator before the MR closing brace;
        // the runtime parser strips trailing whitespace before execution.
        assertEquals("testmod:trade 4", snippets.get(1).input().text().stripTrailing());
        assertEquals("testmod:trade 4 ", snippets.get(1).input().text());
        int cursor = script.lastIndexOf('}');
        var atCursor = ScriptHeads.at(script, cursor);
        assertNotNull(atCursor);
        assertEquals(snippets.get(1).input().text(), atCursor.input().text());
        assertEquals(atCursor.input().text().length(), atCursor.input().commandOffset(cursor));
        assertEquals(1, MaredScriptParser.parse(script).size());
        var parsed = MaredScriptParser.parse("mc data merge entity @s {Name:'a } ; // b', Nested:{x:1}}");
        assertEquals(snippets.getFirst().input().text(), ((MaredMcCommand) parsed.getFirst()).getCommand());
        assertNull(ScriptHeads.at("print \"mc ignored\"", 12));
        assertNull(ScriptHeads.at("// mc ignored", 8));
    }

    @Test void sourceMappingPreservesPrefixesAndMidTokenReplacement() {
        var input = new CommandInput("testmod:trade   cuitem later", 5);
        assertEquals("testmod:trade cuitem later", input.text());
        assertEquals(21, input.sourceOffset(14));
        assertEquals(20, input.replacementEnd(14, 16, "custommod:item", 16));
        assertEquals(16, input.replacementEnd(14, 16, "a b", 16));
        assertTrue(new CommandInput("say $name", 0).dynamic());
        assertTrue(new CommandInput("say \"a\\nb\"", 0).dynamic());
    }
}

package com.fixmer.mared;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft.MinecraftImportMode;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft.MinecraftLoader;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft.MinecraftProjectDetector;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft.MinecraftProjectImporter;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.minecraft.ProjectType;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.NeoForgeProjectTemplate;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.SourceProjects;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Map;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

final class MinecraftProjectImportIntegrationTest {
    @TempDir Path root;

    @Test void detectsNeoForgeStarter() throws Exception {
        Path original = root.resolve("mod");
        Files.createDirectories(original);
        for (Map.Entry<String, String> e : NeoForgeProjectTemplate.files("demomod").entrySet()) {
            if (e.getKey().equals("genesis-project.properties")) continue;
            Path out = original.resolve(e.getKey());
            Files.createDirectories(out.getParent());
            Files.writeString(out, e.getValue());
        }
        var info = MinecraftProjectDetector.analyze(original);
        assertEquals(ProjectType.MINECRAFT_MOD, info.projectType());
        assertEquals(MinecraftLoader.NEOFORGE, info.loader());
        assertEquals("demomod", info.modId());
        assertTrue(info.structure().hasGradle());
        assertTrue(info.suggestedRunTasks().contains("build"));
        assertTrue(info.suggestedRunTasks().contains("runClient"));
    }

    @Test void copyAndLinkImportWriteGenesisWorkspace() throws Exception {
        Path original = root.resolve("external");
        Files.createDirectories(original);
        for (Map.Entry<String, String> e : NeoForgeProjectTemplate.files("portal").entrySet()) {
            if (e.getKey().equals("genesis-project.properties")) continue; // external mods are not Genesis-managed yet
            Path out = original.resolve(e.getKey());
            Files.createDirectories(out.getParent());
            Files.writeString(out, e.getValue());
        }
        var store = new SourceProjects(root.resolve("managed"));
        var importer = new MinecraftProjectImporter(store);

        var copy = importer.importProject("portal_copy", original, MinecraftImportMode.COPY, () -> false);
        assertEquals(MinecraftImportMode.COPY, copy.mode());
        assertTrue(Files.isDirectory(copy.genesisDir()));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(copy.genesisDir().resolve("project.json")));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(copy.genesisDir().resolve("workspace.json")));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(copy.genesisDir().resolve("analysis.json")));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(copy.genesisDir().resolve("dependencies.json")));
        assertTrue(store.hasGradle("portal_copy"));
        assertTrue(store.importedGradle("portal_copy"));

        var link = importer.importProject("portal_link", original, MinecraftImportMode.LINK, () -> false);
        assertEquals(MinecraftImportMode.LINK, link.mode());
        assertTrue(store.linkedMinecraft("portal_link"));
        assertEquals(original.toRealPath(), store.workingDirectory("portal_link").toRealPath());
        assertTrue(Files.isDirectory(original.resolve(".genesis")));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(original.resolve(".genesis/project.json")));
        assertTrue(store.files("portal_link").stream().anyMatch(p -> p.endsWith("neoforge.mods.toml")));
    }

    @Test void fabricMetadataIsDetected() throws Exception {
        Path original = root.resolve("fabric");
        Files.createDirectories(original.resolve("src/main/resources"));
        Files.writeString(original.resolve("build.gradle"), "plugins { id 'fabric-loom' version '1.7-SNAPSHOT' }\n");
        Files.writeString(original.resolve("src/main/resources/fabric.mod.json"), """
                {
                  "schemaVersion": 1,
                  "id": "sample",
                  "version": "1.2.3",
                  "name": "Sample Fabric",
                  "entrypoints": { "main": ["com.example.SampleMod"] },
                  "depends": { "minecraft": "~1.21", "fabricloader": ">=0.15" }
                }
                """);
        var info = MinecraftProjectDetector.analyze(original);
        assertEquals(MinecraftLoader.FABRIC, info.loader());
        assertEquals("sample", info.modId());
        assertEquals("com.example.SampleMod", info.mainClass());
        assertEquals(ProjectType.MINECRAFT_MOD, info.projectType());
    }
}

===== src\test\java\com\fixmer\mared\PackagingIntegrationTest.java =====
package com.fixmer.mared;

import cpw.mods.jarhandling.JarContents;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;
import net.neoforged.fml.loading.moddiscovery.readers.JarModsDotTomlModFileReader;
import net.neoforged.neoforgespi.locating.IModFile;
import net.neoforged.neoforgespi.locating.ModFileDiscoveryAttributes;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** Uses the shipped nested JAR and FML's real reader; a flat test classpath would hide this error. */
public class PackagingIntegrationTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    private Path extractedCore() throws Exception {
        Path mod=Path.of(System.getProperty("genesis.packagedMod"));
        try(var archive=new ZipFile(mod.toFile())) {
            String json=new String(archive.getInputStream(archive.getEntry("META-INF/jarjar/metadata.json")).readAllBytes(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            var metadata=com.google.gson.JsonParser.parseString(json).getAsJsonObject().getAsJsonArray("jars").get(0).getAsJsonObject();
            assertEquals("0.1.38",metadata.getAsJsonObject("version").get("artifactVersion").getAsString());
            assertEquals("[0.1.38,0.2.0)",metadata.getAsJsonObject("version").get("range").getAsString());
            Path core=directory.resolve("genesis-core-0.1.38.jar");
            try(var in=archive.getInputStream(archive.getEntry(metadata.get("path").getAsString()))){Files.copy(in,core);}
            return core;
        }
    }
    @Test void fmlRecognizesNestedCoreAsGameLibrary() throws Exception {
        Path core=extractedCore();
        try(var contents=JarContents.of(core)) {
            assertEquals("GAMELIBRARY",contents.getManifest().getMainAttributes().getValue("FMLModType"));
            assertEquals("com.fixmer.genesis.core",contents.getManifest().getMainAttributes().getValue("Automatic-Module-Name"));
            var discovered=new JarModsDotTomlModFileReader().read(contents,ModFileDiscoveryAttributes.DEFAULT);
            assertNotNull(discovered);assertEquals(IModFile.Type.GAMELIBRARY,discovered.getType());
            assertEquals("com.fixmer.genesis.core",discovered.getSecureJar().name());
        }
    }
    @Test void textRepositoryLoadsFromPackagedModuleWithoutTestClasspath() throws Exception {
        Path core=extractedCore();
        // JVM module classloaders have no close(): on Windows they can lock this JAR
        // until JVM exit and make JUnit @TempDir cleanup fail after a successful check.
        Path javaExecutable=Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"),"bin","java");
        String classes=Path.of(PackagingModuleProbe.class.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation().toURI()).toString();
        Path output=directory.resolve("module-probe.log");
        Process child=new ProcessBuilder(javaExecutable.toString(),"-cp",classes,PackagingModuleProbe.class.getName(),
            core.toString(),directory.resolve("data").toString())
            .redirectErrorStream(true).redirectOutput(output.toFile()).start();
        try {
            boolean exited=child.waitFor(30,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            assertTrue(exited,"Module probe did not finish in 30 seconds");
            assertEquals(0,child.exitValue(),()->{
                try{return Files.readString(output);}catch(IOException error){return error.toString();}
            });
            // Verify release explicitly instead of depending only on JUnit's later cleanup.
            Files.delete(core);
            assertFalse(Files.exists(core));
        } finally {
            if(child.isAlive()){child.destroyForcibly();child.waitFor();}
        }
    }
    @Test void aiMixinAndDemoAreInTheShippedMod() throws Exception {
        try(var archive=new ZipFile(Path.of(System.getProperty("genesis.packagedMod")).toFile())) {
            var config=com.google.gson.JsonParser.parseString(new String(archive.getInputStream(archive.getEntry("mared.mixins.json")).readAllBytes(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).getAsJsonObject();
            assertTrue(java.util.stream.StreamSupport.stream(config.getAsJsonArray("mixins").spliterator(),false).anyMatch(v->v.getAsString().equals("GenesisMobGoals")));
            assertNotNull(archive.getEntry("com/fixmer/mared/mixin/GenesisMobGoals.class"));
            assertNotNull(archive.getEntry("com/fixmer/mared/technology/ai/GenesisAiEvents.class"));
            assertNotNull(archive.getEntry("genesis/examples/follow.mr"));
        }
    }

}

===== src\test\java\com\fixmer\mared\PackagingModuleProbe.java =====
package com.fixmer.mared;

import java.lang.module.ModuleFinder;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Set;

/** Standard-Java-only child process: no core, Minecraft or JUnit on its application classpath. */
public final class PackagingModuleProbe {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var finder=ModuleFinder.of(Path.of(args[0]));
        var configuration=ModuleLayer.boot().configuration().resolve(finder,ModuleFinder.of(),Set.of("com.fixmer.genesis.core"));
        var layer=ModuleLayer.boot().defineModulesWithOneLoader(configuration,ClassLoader.getPlatformClassLoader());
        Class<?> type=layer.findLoader("com.fixmer.genesis.core").loadClass("com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.TextRepository");
        if(!"com.fixmer.genesis.core".equals(type.getModule().getName()))throw new AssertionError("Wrong module");
        try {
            Class.forName(type.getName(),false,ClassLoader.getSystemClassLoader());
            throw new AssertionError("Core unexpectedly present on application classpath");
        }catch(ClassNotFoundException expected){ /* isolation confirmed */ }
        Object repository=type.getConstructor(Path.class).newInstance(Path.of(args[1]));
        if(!Boolean.TRUE.equals(type.getMethod("create",String.class,String.class).invoke(repository,"script","packaged core works")))
            throw new AssertionError("Create failed");
        if(!"packaged core works".equals(type.getMethod("read",String.class).invoke(repository,"script")))
            throw new AssertionError("Read failed");
        ClassLoader loader=layer.findLoader("com.fixmer.genesis.core");
        Class<?> projectsType=loader.loadClass("com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.SourceProjects");
        Class<?> languageType=loader.loadClass("com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.SourceProjects$Language");
        if(!"com.fixmer.genesis.core".equals(projectsType.getModule().getName()))throw new AssertionError("Projects in wrong module");
        Object projects=projectsType.getConstructor(Path.class).newInstance(Path.of(args[1]).resolve("projects"));
        projectsType.getMethod("create",String.class,languageType).invoke(projects,"java",languageType.getField("JAVA").get(null));
        String source=(String)projectsType.getMethod("read",String.class,String.class).invoke(projects,"java","src/Main.java");
        if(!source.contains("public final class Main"))throw new AssertionError("Independent source project failed");
        projectsType.getMethod("save",String.class,String.class,String.class,String.class).invoke(projects,"java","src/Main.java",source,"// module saved\n");
        if(!"// module saved\n".equals(projectsType.getMethod("read",String.class,String.class).invoke(projects,"java","src/Main.java")))throw new AssertionError("Independent source save failed");
        Class<?> runnerType=loader.loadClass("com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.JavaSourceRunner");
        if(!Boolean.TRUE.equals(runnerType.getMethod("validMainClass",String.class).invoke(null,"demo.Main")))throw new AssertionError("Java runner missing from packaged module");
        Class<?> toolsType=loader.loadClass("com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.BuildTools");
        if(!(Boolean)toolsType.getMethod("validAbsolutePath",String.class).invoke(null,Path.of(args[1]).toAbsolutePath().toString()))throw new AssertionError("BuildTools unavailable from isolated core");
        Class<?> gradleType=loader.loadClass("com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.GradleBuildRunner");
        if(!(Boolean)gradleType.getMethod("validTask",String.class).invoke(null,":module:build"))throw new AssertionError("Gradle runner unavailable from isolated core");
        Class<?> compilerType=loader.loadClass("com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.RuntimeModuleCompiler");
        byte[] api=(byte[])compilerType.getMethod("apiJar").invoke(null);
        var entries=new java.util.HashSet<String>();
        try(var jar=new java.util.jar.JarInputStream(new java.io.ByteArrayInputStream(api))){
            for(var entry=jar.getNextJarEntry();entry!=null;entry=jar.getNextJarEntry())entries.add(entry.getName());
        }
        if(!entries.equals(Set.of("com/fixmer/genesis/technology/server/ServerModule.class","com/fixmer/genesis/technology/server/ServerContext.class","com/fixmer/genesis/technology/server/ServerContext$Subscription.class")))throw new AssertionError("Packaged server API incomplete");
        projectsType.getMethod("createServerModule",String.class).invoke(projects,"world");
        String module=(String)projectsType.getMethod("read",String.class,String.class).invoke(projects,"world","src/WorldModule.java");
        if(!module.contains("implements ServerModule"))throw new AssertionError("Packaged server template missing");
        Class<?> treeType=loader.loadClass("com.fixmer.genesis.technology.editor.ProjectFileTree");
        Object tree=treeType.getMethod("of",java.util.Collection.class).invoke(null,java.util.List.of("src/Main.java"));
        if(!(Boolean)treeType.getMethod("containsFile",String.class).invoke(tree,"src/Main.java"))throw new AssertionError("File tree unavailable from isolated core");
        Class<?> importer=loader.loadClass("com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.GradleProjectImport");
        if(!(Boolean)importer.getMethod("editable",String.class).invoke(null,"module/src/main/java/Main.java"))throw new AssertionError("Importer unavailable from isolated core");
        System.out.println("Packaged module check passed: repository, source projects, Java runner and build tools");
    }
}

package com.fixmer.mared;

class PortableRuntimeIntegrationTest {
 private static final ExecutionLimits LIMITS=new ExecutionLimits(2,100,8,1_000_000_000L);
 @Test void budgetAndNormalCompletion(){int[] hits={0};FrameExecutor.Instruction hit=e->hits[0]++;var scope=new ExecutionScope();var e=new FrameExecutor(List.of(hit,hit,hit),LIMITS,scope);e.tick();assertEquals(2,hits[0]);assertFalse(e.isFinished());e.tick();assertEquals(3,hits[0]);assertTrue(e.isFinished());assertEquals(0,scope.snapshot().resources());}
 @Test void singleStepDoesNotRunWholeTick(){int[] hits={0};FrameExecutor.Instruction hit=e->hits[0]++;var e=new FrameExecutor(List.of(hit,hit),LIMITS,null);e.pauseFromDebugger();e.stepOverDebugger();assertEquals(1,hits[0]);assertTrue(e.snapshot().paused());e.tick();assertEquals(1,hits[0]);e.resumeFromDebugger();e.tick();assertTrue(e.isFinished());}

 @Test void cleanupRunsOnOwnerTick(){AtomicInteger cleaned=new AtomicInteger();var scope=new ExecutionScope();var e=new FrameExecutor(List.of(x->x.pauseCurrent(100)),LIMITS,scope);e.pushLoopInstructions(List.of(x->x.pauseCurrent(100)),new FrameExecutor.LoopOwner(){public boolean onBodyFinished(FrameExecutor ex,FrameExecutor.Frame f){return false;}public String describe(){return "test";}public void onDiscard(){cleaned.incrementAndGet();}});e.tick();e.pauseFromDebugger();scope.close();assertEquals(0,cleaned.get());assertEquals(1,scope.snapshot().resources());e.tick();assertEquals(1,cleaned.get());assertEquals(0,scope.snapshot().resources());assertTrue(e.isFinished());}
 @Test void failureCancelsSiblingResources(){var scope=new ExecutionScope();AtomicInteger closed=new AtomicInteger();scope.own(ExecutionScope.Kind.EVENT,closed::incrementAndGet);var e=new FrameExecutor(List.of(x->{throw new IllegalStateException("bad host");}),LIMITS,scope);e.tick();assertTrue(e.isFinished());assertNotNull(e.failure());assertTrue(scope.cancelled());assertEquals(1,closed.get());assertEquals(0,scope.snapshot().resources());}
 @Test void stackLimitIsEnforced(){var e=new FrameExecutor(List.of(x->x.pushInstructions(List.of(y->{}))),new ExecutionLimits(1,10,1,1_000_000_000L),null);e.tick();assertNotNull(e.failure());assertTrue(e.isFinished());}
 @Test void actionClaimsAreIndependent(){var a=new OwnedActions<String,String>(4);var one=new ExecutionScope();var two=new ExecutionScope();a.press(one,"forward");a.press(one,"forward");a.press(two,"forward");assertEquals(1,one.snapshot().resources());one.close();assertTrue(a.activeKeys().contains("forward"));assertTrue(a.pressed(two,"forward"));a.release(two,"forward");assertTrue(a.activeKeys().isEmpty());assertEquals(0,two.snapshot().resources());a.press(null,"left");a.stop(one);assertTrue(a.activeKeys().contains("left"));a.stopAll();assertTrue(a.activeKeys().isEmpty());}
 @Test void pendingActionsAreBoundedAndCancelled(){var a=new OwnedActions<String,Integer>(2);var one=new ExecutionScope();var two=new ExecutionScope();a.enqueue(one,1);a.enqueue(two,2);assertThrows(IllegalStateException.class,()->a.enqueue(two,3));one.close();var effects=new ArrayList<Integer>();a.drain(1,effects::add);assertEquals(List.of(2),effects);assertEquals(0,two.snapshot().resources());a.enqueue(two,4);a.drain(1,x->{throw new IllegalArgumentException("effect");});assertTrue(two.cancelled());assertNotNull(two.snapshot().failure());assertEquals(0,a.pendingCount());a.enqueue(two,5);assertEquals(0,a.pendingCount());}
 @Test void racingActionsCannotEscapeScope()throws Exception{for(int i=0;i<100;i++){var scope=new ExecutionScope();var a=new OwnedActions<String,Integer>(4);var start=new CountDownLatch(1);AtomicReference<Throwable> error=new AtomicReference<>();Thread thread=new Thread(()->{try{start.await();a.press(scope,"forward");a.enqueue(scope,1);}catch(Throwable e){error.set(e);}});thread.start();start.countDown();scope.close();thread.join();assertNull(error.get());assertTrue(a.activeKeys().isEmpty());assertEquals(0,a.pendingCount());assertEquals(0,scope.snapshot().resources());}}
