===== src\test\java\com\fixmer\mared\ProjectArchiveIntegrationTest.java =====
package com.fixmer.mared;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.storage.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import java.io.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class ProjectArchiveIntegrationTest {
    private Path temp() throws IOException {return Files.createTempDirectory("genesis-project-");}
    private static void zip(Path p,Map<String,byte[]> entries) throws IOException {
        try(var out=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(p))){for(var e:entries.entrySet()){out.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(e.getKey()));out.write(e.getValue());out.closeEntry();}}
    }
    private static Map<String,byte[]> contents(String name,byte[] text){var map=new LinkedHashMap<String,byte[]>();map.put("genesis-project.properties","format=genesis-commands\nversion=1\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));map.put(name,text);return map;}
    @Test void roundTripPreservesUnicodeCrLfEmptyFilesAndFolders() throws Exception {
        Path root=temp();var source=new TextRepository(root.resolve("source"));source.createDirectory("quests");source.createDirectory("empty");source.create("quests/start","mc say Привет 😀\r\n// data\n");source.create("blank","");
        var plan=ProjectArchive.snapshot(source);Path archive=root.resolve("project.zip");ProjectArchive.write(archive,plan);
        var parsed=ProjectArchive.read(archive);assertEquals(plan,parsed);
        var target=new TextRepository(root.resolve("target"));var nested=parsed.beneath("mods/story");assertTrue(target.previewBatch(nested.documents(),nested.directories()).isEmpty());target.createBatch(nested.documents(),nested.directories());
        assertEquals(source.read("quests/start"),target.read("mods/story/quests/start"));assertEquals("",target.read("mods/story/blank"));assertTrue(target.directoryExists("mods/story/empty"));
        byte[] before=Files.readAllBytes(archive);assertThrows(IOException.class,()->ProjectArchive.write(archive,plan));assertTrue(Arrays.equals(before,Files.readAllBytes(archive)));
    }
    @Test void conflictsNeverOverwriteAndChangedDestinationIsRechecked() throws Exception {
        Path root=temp();var repo=new TextRepository(root);repo.create("existing","keep");var files=Map.of("new","new text","existing","replacement");
        assertEquals(List.of("existing"),repo.previewBatch(files,Set.of()));assertThrows(IOException.class,()->repo.createBatch(files,Set.of()));assertFalse(repo.exists("new"));assertEquals("keep",repo.read("existing"));
        repo.create("Mixed","keep case");assertFalse(repo.previewBatch(Map.of("mixed","new"),Set.of()).isEmpty());
        var plan=new ProjectArchive.Plan(Map.of("later","data"),Set.of(),4);assertTrue(repo.previewBatch(plan.documents(),plan.directories()).isEmpty());repo.create("later","racing write");assertThrows(IOException.class,()->repo.createBatch(plan.documents(),plan.directories()));assertEquals("racing write",repo.read("later"));
    }
    @Test void invalidAndAmbiguousPathsAndManifestAreRejected() throws Exception {
        Path root=temp();Path archive=root.resolve("bad.zip");
        for(String name:List.of("commands/../escape.txt","commands/C:/escape.txt","commands/a\\escape.txt","commands/CON.txt","other/file.txt")){
            zip(archive,contents(name,"bad".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));assertThrows(IOException.class,()->ProjectArchive.read(archive));
        }
        var entries=contents("commands/A.txt",new byte[0]);entries.put("commands/a.txt",new byte[0]);zip(archive,entries);assertThrows(IOException.class,()->ProjectArchive.read(archive));
        entries=contents("commands/a.txt",new byte[0]);entries.put("commands/a.txt/",new byte[0]);zip(archive,entries);assertThrows(IOException.class,()->ProjectArchive.read(archive));
        zip(archive,Map.of("commands/a.txt",new byte[0]));assertThrows(IOException.class,()->ProjectArchive.read(archive));
        entries=contents("commands/a.txt",new byte[0]);entries.put("genesis-project.properties","format=genesis-commands\nversion=2\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));zip(archive,entries);assertThrows(IOException.class,()->ProjectArchive.read(archive));
    }
    @Test void malformedUtf8LargeEntriesAndCancelledExportLeaveNoFinalArchive() throws Exception {
        Path root=temp(),archive=root.resolve("bad.zip");zip(archive,contents("commands/a.txt",new byte[]{(byte)0xc3,0x28}));assertThrows(IOException.class,()->ProjectArchive.read(archive));
        zip(archive,contents("commands/a.txt",new byte[TextRepository.MAX_BYTES+1]));assertThrows(IOException.class,()->ProjectArchive.read(archive));
        var huge=contents("commands/f0.txt",new byte[TextRepository.MAX_BYTES]);
        for(int i=1;i<9;i++)huge.put("commands/f"+i+".txt",new byte[TextRepository.MAX_BYTES]);
        zip(archive,huge);assertThrows(IOException.class,()->ProjectArchive.read(archive));
        Path out=root.resolve("cancelled.zip");var plan=new ProjectArchive.Plan(Map.of("a","x"),Set.of(),1);
        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();try{assertThrows(IOException.class,()->ProjectArchive.write(out,plan));}finally{Thread.interrupted();}
        assertFalse(Files.exists(out));try(var files=Files.list(root)){assertFalse(files.anyMatch(p->p.getFileName().toString().endsWith(".tmp")));}
    }
    @Test void failedBatchRollsBackCreatedFilesAndOnlyNewFolders() throws Exception {
        Path root=temp();var repo=new TextRepository(root);repo.createDirectory("keep");repo.create("original","keep text");
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->repo.createBatch(Map.of("a","created","missing/b","failure"),Set.of()));assertFalse(repo.exists("a"));assertEquals("keep text",repo.read("original"));
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->repo.createBatch(Map.of(),Set.of("early","missing/late","keep")));assertFalse(repo.directoryExists("early"));assertTrue(repo.directoryExists("keep"));
    }
    @Test void truncatedZipAndCorruptCrcAreRejected() throws Exception {
        Path archive=temp().resolve("broken.zip");
        zip(archive,contents("commands/a.txt","x".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
        byte[] bytes=Files.readAllBytes(archive);Files.write(archive,Arrays.copyOf(bytes,bytes.length-1));
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->ProjectArchive.read(archive));
        var entries=contents("commands/a.txt","TEXT_CRC_TEST".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        try(var out=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(archive))){for(var item:entries.entrySet()){
            var crc=new CRC32();crc.update(item.getValue());var entry=new ZipEntry(item.getKey());entry.setMethod(ZipEntry.STORED);entry.setSize(item.getValue().length);entry.setCrc(crc.getValue());out.putNextEntry(entry);out.write(item.getValue());out.closeEntry();
        }}
        bytes=Files.readAllBytes(archive);byte[] marker="TEXT_CRC_TEST".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);boolean corrupted=false;
        for(int i=0;i<=bytes.length-marker.length;i++){boolean found=true;for(int j=0;j<marker.length;j++)if(bytes[i+j]!=marker[j])found=false;if(found){bytes[i]^=1;corrupted=true;break;}}
        assertTrue(corrupted);Files.write(archive,bytes);assertThrows(IOException.class,()->ProjectArchive.read(archive));
    }
    @Test void implicitParentsAndLimitsAreCheckedBeforeImport() throws Exception {
        Path root=temp(),archive=root.resolve("nested.zip");zip(archive,contents("commands/a/b/c.txt","x".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));var plan=ProjectArchive.read(archive);assertEquals(Set.of("a","a/b"),plan.directories());
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->plan.beneath("../escape"));assertThrows(IOException.class,()->plan.beneath("a/".repeat(15)+"end"));
        var docs=new TreeMap<String,String>();for(int i=0;i<ProjectArchive.MAX_ENTRIES+1;i++)docs.put("f"+i,"");assertThrows(IOException.class,()->ProjectArchive.write(root.resolve("oversize.zip"),new ProjectArchive.Plan(docs,Set.of(),0)));assertFalse(Files.exists(root.resolve("oversize.zip")));
    }
}

===== src\test\java\com\fixmer\mared\ProjectFileTreeIntegrationTest.java =====
package com.fixmer.mared;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.editor.ProjectFileTree;
import java.util.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class ProjectFileTreeIntegrationTest {
    @Test void foldersSortBeforeFilesAndCollapseOnlyTheirOwnDescendants() {
        var tree=ProjectFileTree.of(List.of("settings.gradle","src/z.java","src/pkg/A.java","tests/Test.java","build.gradle"));
        assertEquals(List.of("src","tests","build.gradle","settings.gradle"),tree.rows(Set.of()).stream().map(ProjectFileTree.Row::path).toList());
        var open=tree.rows(Set.of("src"));
        assertEquals(List.of("src","src/pkg","src/z.java","tests","build.gradle","settings.gradle"),open.stream().map(ProjectFileTree.Row::path).toList());
        assertEquals(1,open.get(1).depth());assertTrue(open.get(1).directory());
        assertEquals(List.of("src","src/pkg"),tree.ancestors("src/pkg/A.java"));
        assertTrue(tree.rows(Set.of("src","src/pkg")).stream().anyMatch(r->r.path().equals("src/pkg/A.java")&&r.depth()==2&&!r.directory()));
        assertEquals(List.of(),tree.ancestors("missing.java"));
        assertEquals(List.of(),tree.ancestors("build.gradle"));
    }
    @Test void snapshotIsImmutableDeduplicatedAndIndependentOfInputOrder() {
        var input=new ArrayList<>(List.of("src/z.java","src/a.java","src/z.java"));var tree=ProjectFileTree.of(input);input.clear();
        var rows=tree.rows(Set.of("src"));assertEquals(List.of("src","src/a.java","src/z.java"),rows.stream().map(ProjectFileTree.Row::path).toList());
        assertThrows(UnsupportedOperationException.class,()->rows.clear());assertThrows(UnsupportedOperationException.class,()->tree.directories().clear());
        assertEquals(rows,ProjectFileTree.of(List.of("src/a.java","src/z.java")).rows(Set.of("src")));
        var expanded=new HashSet<>(Set.of("src"));var first=tree.rows(expanded);expanded.clear();assertEquals(3,first.size());assertEquals(1,tree.rows(expanded).size());
    }
    @Test void invalidAliasesAndFileFolderCollisionsAreRefusedInEitherOrder() {
        for(String bad:List.of("../escape.java","src//File.java","C:/File.java","src/CON.java","/absolute.java"))assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ProjectFileTree.of(List.of(bad)));
        for(var paths:List.of(List.of("src/A.java","src/a.java"),List.of("src/A/File.java","src/a/Other.java"),List.of("src/file.java","src/file.java/Child.java"),List.of("src/file.java/Child.java","src/file.java")))assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ProjectFileTree.of(paths));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ProjectFileTree.of(Collections.nCopies(ProjectFileTree.MAX_FILES+1,"src/File.java")));
    }
    @Test void largeHierarchyHasPredictableVisibleProjectionAndDepthBound() {
        var paths=new ArrayList<String>();for(int i=0;i<2000;i++)paths.add("src/pkg"+(i/20)+"/File"+i+".java");var tree=ProjectFileTree.of(paths);
        assertEquals(1,tree.rows(Set.of()).size());assertEquals(101,tree.rows(Set.of("src")).size());assertEquals(2101,tree.rows(tree.directories()).size());
        String deep="a/".repeat(15)+"File.java";assertEquals(16,ProjectFileTree.of(List.of(deep)).rows(new HashSet<>(ProjectFileTree.of(List.of(deep)).directories())).size());
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ProjectFileTree.of(List.of("a/"+deep)));
    }
}

===== src\test\java\com\fixmer\mared\RuntimeIntegrationChecks.java =====
package com.fixmer.mared;
import java.util.*;
import com.fixmer.mared.commands.engine.*;
import com.fixmer.mared.commands.events_cmd.MaredWaitUntilCommand;
/** Runs compiled production classes on the real Minecraft/NeoForge classpath, without a game window. */
public class RuntimeIntegrationChecks {
 static int checks;
 static void check(boolean value,String reason){checks++;if(!value)throw new AssertionError(reason);}
 static MaredScriptCommand cmd(java.util.function.BiConsumer<MaredScriptContext,MaredScriptExecutor> fn){return new MaredScriptCommand(){public void execute(MaredScriptContext c,MaredScriptExecutor e){fn.accept(c,e);}public String describe(){return "context-test";}};}
 public static void main(String[]args){
  net.neoforged.fml.loading.FMLPaths.loadAbsolutePaths(java.nio.file.Path.of(".").toAbsolutePath());
  var c=new MaredScriptContext(null,null,s->{});int[] count={0};
  c.registerFunction("next",List.of(),List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->e.setReturnValue((long)++count[0]))));
  check(c.substitute("${next()}").equals("1"),"First function substitution");
  check(c.substitute("${next()}").equals("2"),"No result cache for repeated call");
  c.setVariable("value",1L);check(c.substitute("$value").equals("1"),"Initial value");
  c.setVariable("value",2L);check(c.substitute("$value").equals("2"),"Same tick sees changed variable");
  c.registerFunction("wait",List.of("temporary"),List.of(new MaredWaitUntilCommand("false")));
  try{c.callFunction("wait",List.of(3L));throw new AssertionError("Synchronous wait accepted");}catch(IllegalStateException expected){checks++;}
  check(!c.hasVariable("temporary"),"Absent parameter removed after failure");
  c.setVariable("temporary",null);
  try{c.callFunction("wait",List.of(3L));throw new AssertionError("Synchronous wait accepted");}catch(IllegalStateException expected){checks++;}
  check(c.hasVariable("temporary")&&c.getVariable("temporary")==null,"Existing null binding restored");
  for(var params:List.of(List.of("same","same"),List.of("self"),List.of("global.x"))){
   try{c.registerFunction("bad",params,List.of());throw new AssertionError("Bad parameters accepted");}catch(IllegalArgumentException expected){checks++;}
  }
  var fork=c.forkFor(null,null);
  check(fork.getServer()==null&&fork.hasFunction("next"),"Fork keeps functions");
  check(!fork.hasVariable("temporary"),"Fork has independent variables");
  c.setVariable("a",1L);c.setVariable("b",2L);
  c.registerFunction("swap",List.of("a","b"),List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->check(ctx.getVariable("a").equals(2L)&&ctx.getVariable("b").equals(1L),"Arguments resolve before binding"))));
  var swap=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(new com.fixmer.mared.commands.control.MaredCallCommand("swap",List.of("$b","$a"))));
  for(int i=0;i<100&&!swap.isFinished();i++)swap.tick();
  check(swap.isFinished()&&swap.failure()==null&&c.getVariable("a").equals(1L)&&c.getVariable("b").equals(2L),"Actual call restores bindings");
  int[] hits={0};var wait=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(new MaredWaitUntilCommand("$ready"),cmd((ctx,e)->hits[0]++)));
  for(int i=0;i<4;i++)wait.tick();check(hits[0]==0&&!wait.isFinished(),"Actual context waits");
  c.setVariable("ready",true);for(int i=0;i<100&&!wait.isFinished();i++)wait.tick();check(hits[0]==1&&wait.isFinished(),"Actual context resumes");
  var guard=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(new com.fixmer.mared.commands.control.MaredIfCommand("true && )",List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->hits[0]++)))));
  guard.tick();check(guard.isFinished()&&guard.failure()!=null&&hits[0]==1,"Actual malformed guard stops");
  MaredScriptRunner.stopAll();var live=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->e.pauseCurrent(50))));
  var done=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->{})));MaredScriptRunner.start(live);MaredScriptRunner.start(done);MaredScriptRunner.tick(null);
  check(MaredScriptRunner.getActiveCount()==1&&!live.isFinished(),"Actual runner preserves survivor");MaredScriptRunner.stopAll();
  var owned=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->e.pauseCurrent(50)),cmd((ctx,e)->hits[0]++)));
  var sibling=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->e.pauseCurrent(50))));
  MaredScriptRunner.start(owned);MaredScriptRunner.start(sibling);MaredScriptRunner.tick(null);
  var run=new com.fixmer.mared.technology.runtime.FileRun("owned");run.reserveBlock();run.attach(owned);run.blockSubmitted();run.submissionDone();
  check(run.snapshot().state()==com.fixmer.mared.technology.runtime.FileRun.State.WAITING,"Run observes actual wait");
  run.requestStop();check(!owned.isFinished(),"UI stop does not mutate executor stack");
  MaredScriptRunner.tick(null);
  check(run.snapshot().state()==com.fixmer.mared.technology.runtime.FileRun.State.CANCELLED&&!sibling.isFinished()&&hits[0]==1,"Owned cancellation preserves sibling and skips following instruction");
  MaredScriptRunner.stopAll();
  var paused=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->hits[0]++)));paused.pauseFromDebugger();paused.requestStop();paused.tick();
  check(paused.isFinished()&&hits[0]==1,"Cancellation bypasses debugger pause");
  var failed=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->{throw new IllegalStateException("expected run error");})));
  var failedRun=new com.fixmer.mared.technology.runtime.FileRun("failed");failedRun.reserveBlock();failedRun.attach(failed);failedRun.blockSubmitted();failedRun.submissionDone();failed.tick();
  check(failedRun.snapshot().state()==com.fixmer.mared.technology.runtime.FileRun.State.FAILED,"Executor failure is retained in run state");
  String wrapped="{\n// } ignored\nmc data merge entity @s {Name:'a } // ; b', Nested:{x:1}};\n}";
  var parsed=MaredScriptParser.parse(wrapped);
  check(parsed.size()==1&&parsed.get(0) instanceof com.fixmer.mared.commands.server_cmd.MaredMcCommand,"Outer MR wrapper ignores quoted NBT and comment braces");
  var ownerA=new com.fixmer.genesis.technology.runtime.ExecutionScope();var ownerB=new com.fixmer.genesis.technology.runtime.ExecutionScope();
  var scoped=new MaredScriptContext(null,null,msg->{});scoped.setExecutionScope(ownerA);
  check(scoped.fork().executionScope()==ownerA&&scoped.forkWith(null).executionScope()==ownerA&&scoped.forkFor(null,null).executionScope()==ownerA,"Actual context forks preserve owner");
  try{scoped.setExecutionScope(ownerB);throw new AssertionError("Context owner replaced");}catch(IllegalStateException expected){checks++;}
  var scopedB=new MaredScriptContext(null,null,msg->{});scopedB.setExecutionScope(ownerB);
  com.fixmer.mared.commands.events.MaredEventRegistry.removeAllEvents();
  com.fixmer.mared.commands.events.MaredEventRegistry.register("owned_test",List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->hits[0]++)),scoped,true);
  com.fixmer.mared.commands.events.MaredEventRegistry.register("owned_test",List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->hits[0]++)),scopedB,true);
  check(com.fixmer.mared.commands.events.MaredEventRegistry.count("owned_test")==2,"Actual event replacement preserves another owner");
  ownerA.close();check(com.fixmer.mared.commands.events.MaredEventRegistry.count("owned_test")==1,"Actual owner cleanup removes only its event");
  com.fixmer.mared.commands.events.MaredEventRegistry.fire("owned_test",null,Map.of());MaredScriptRunner.tick(null);
  check(ownerB.snapshot().count(com.fixmer.genesis.technology.runtime.ExecutionScope.Kind.EXECUTOR)==0&&hits[0]==2,"Actual event fork inherits owner and completes child");
  new com.fixmer.mared.commands.events_cmd.MaredOffCommand("all").execute(scopedB);
  check(com.fixmer.mared.commands.events.MaredEventRegistry.totalCount()==0&&ownerB.snapshot().resources()==0,"Actual off releases owned resource lease");
  com.fixmer.mared.commands.events.MaredEventRegistry.register("exit_test",List.of(new com.fixmer.mared.commands.control.MaredExitCommand()),scopedB,false);

  check(!com.fixmer.mared.commands.events.MaredEventRegistry.has("exit_test"),"Actual exit removes its queued event entry");
  var background=new com.fixmer.mared.technology.runtime.FileRun("background");var bgContext=new MaredScriptContext(null,null,msg->{});bgContext.setExecutionScope(background.scope());
  var bgRoot=new MaredScriptExecutor(bgContext,List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->com.fixmer.mared.commands.events.MaredEventRegistry.registerAfter(1,List.of(cmd((child,exec)->exec.pauseCurrent(20))),ctx))));
  background.reserveBlock();background.attach(bgRoot);background.blockSubmitted();background.submissionDone();bgRoot.tick();
  check(background.snapshot().state()==com.fixmer.mared.technology.runtime.FileRun.State.BACKGROUND,"Actual after keeps run alive beyond root completion");
  MaredScriptRunner.tick(null);background.requestStop();background.finishClientCancellation();
  check(background.snapshot().state()==com.fixmer.mared.technology.runtime.FileRun.State.CANCELLED&&MaredScriptRunner.getActiveCount()==0,"Actual background child acknowledges owned stop");
  ownerB.close();com.fixmer.mared.commands.events.MaredEventRegistry.removeAllEvents();MaredScriptRunner.stopAll();

  linkedBase.setCapabilityHost(new com.fixmer.genesis.technology.links.InvocationCapabilities<MaredScriptContext>(){

package com.fixmer.mared;
import com.fixmer.mared.technology.links.*;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.links.*;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.links.ScriptLinks.*;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.runtime.*;
import com.fixmer.mared.commands.engine.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.*;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
class ScriptLinkServiceIntegrationTest {
    static {
        net.neoforged.fml.loading.FMLPaths.loadAbsolutePaths(Path.of(".").toAbsolutePath());
    }
    static final ExecutionLimits TEST_LIMITS=new ExecutionLimits(1000,1_000_000,128,1_000_000_000);
    static ScriptLinkService.Snapshot refresh(ScriptLinkService s)throws Exception {
        s.refresh();
        long until=System.nanoTime()+TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(5);
        while(System.nanoTime()<until) {
            if(s.snapshot().loaded())return s.snapshot();
            Thread.yield();
        }
        throw new AssertionError("Catalog load timeout");
    }
    static ScriptLinkService.Snapshot revision(ScriptLinkService s,long previous)throws Exception {
        s.refresh();
        long until=System.nanoTime()+TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(5);
        while(System.nanoTime()<until) {
            if(s.snapshot().revision()>previous)return s.snapshot();
            Thread.yield();
        }
        throw new AssertionError("Catalog change timeout");
    }
    static void delete(Path root)throws Exception {
        try(var paths=Files.walk(root)) {
            for(var p:paths.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toList())Files.delete(p);
        }
    }
    @Test void demoInstallRoundTripAndOptimisticSave()throws Exception {
        Path root=Files.createTempDirectory("genesis-links-");
        var s=new ScriptLinkService(root);
        try {
            var first=s.installDemo().get(5,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            var p=GenesisAiDemo.profile();
            assertEquals(2,first.catalog().entries().size());
            assertFalse(first.project().profiles().get(0).enabled());
            assertNull(first.problem(p));
            assertEquals(first.project(),ScriptLinkCodec.read(ScriptLinkCodec.write(first.project())));
            assertEquals(1,first.index().usages(GenesisAiDemo.condition().reference()).size());
            var enabled=new AiProfile(p.id(),p.title(),p.tag(),true,p.interval(),p.range(),p.condition(),p.action());
            var changed=s.put(enabled,GenesisAiDemo.condition(),GenesisAiDemo.action(),first.projectText()).get(5,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            assertTrue(changed.project().profiles().get(0).enabled());
            assertThrows(Exception.class,()->s.put(p,GenesisAiDemo.condition(),GenesisAiDemo.action(),first.projectText()).get(5,TimeUnit.SECONDS));
            assertEquals(changed.projectText(),Files.readString(root.resolve("genesis/links.txt")));
            var removed=s.remove(p.id(),changed.projectText()).get(5,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            assertTrue(removed.project().bindings().isEmpty());
            assertEquals(2,removed.catalog().entries().size());
        }
        finally {
            s.close();
            delete(root);
        }
    }
    @Test void renameDeletionDuplicateAndBrokenProjectFailClosed()throws Exception {
        Path root=Files.createTempDirectory("genesis-links-");
        var s=new ScriptLinkService(root);
        try {
            var first=s.installDemo().get(5,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            Path file=root.resolve("commands/genesis.follow.txt");
            Files.move(file,root.resolve("commands/renamed.txt"));
            var renamed=revision(s,first.revision());
            assertNull(renamed.problem(GenesisAiDemo.profile()));
            assertEquals("renamed",renamed.catalog().resolve(GenesisAiDemo.action().reference()).symbol().source());
            Files.copy(root.resolve("commands/renamed.txt"),root.resolve("commands/duplicate.txt"));
            var duplicate=revision(s,renamed.revision());
            assertTrue(duplicate.catalog().entries().isEmpty());
            assertTrue(duplicate.errors().containsKey("renamed"));
            assertTrue(duplicate.errors().containsKey("duplicate"));
            Files.delete(root.resolve("commands/duplicate.txt"));
            var restored=revision(s,duplicate.revision());
            assertNull(restored.problem(GenesisAiDemo.profile()));
            Files.delete(root.resolve("commands/renamed.txt"));
            var deleted=revision(s,restored.revision());
            assertNotNull(deleted.problem(GenesisAiDemo.profile()));
            String broken="{ broken json";
            Files.writeString(root.resolve("genesis/links.txt"),broken);
            var invalid=revision(s,deleted.revision());
            assertTrue(invalid.project().profiles().isEmpty());
            assertTrue(invalid.errors().containsKey("links.txt"));
            assertEquals(broken,Files.readString(root.resolve("genesis/links.txt")));
        }
        finally {
            s.close();
            delete(root);
        }
    }

package com.fixmer.mared;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.links.*;

class ScriptLinksIntegrationTest {
    static final UUID MODULE=UUID.fromString("c817e3e5-9ad0-4e80-b655-21c771b88701"), EXPORT=UUID.fromString("58e67a0c-2a83-43ed-8759-0d1f48f57002");
    static final Reference REF=new Reference(MODULE,EXPORT,Kind.CONDITION);
    static String header() {
        return "// @genesis module "+MODULE+"\n// @genesis export "+EXPORT+" condition ready | Ready to run\n";
    }
    static CapabilityRegistry.Entry<String> entry(Reference ref,String source,List<String> params) {
        return new CapabilityRegistry.Entry<>(new CapabilityRegistry.Symbol(ref,source,"ready","Ready",params),"payload");
    }
    static Binding binding(Reference ref,Map<String,String> args) {
        return new Binding(UUID.randomUUID(),"quest:test","condition",ref,args);
    }
    @Test void metadataOnlyReadsTopLevelComments() {
        var m=ScriptExports.read(header()+"func ready($n) {\n// @genesis module nonsense\nreturn true\n}\nprint \"// @genesis export nonsense\"\n");
        assertEquals(MODULE,m.id());
        assertEquals(1,m.exports().size());
        assertEquals("ready",m.exports().get(0).function());
        assertEquals("Ready to run",m.exports().get(0).title());
        assertTrue(ScriptExports.read("print 'hello // @genesis module x'\n").exports().isEmpty());
    }
    @Test void malformedAndDuplicateIdsAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ScriptExports.read(header()+"// @genesis module "+MODULE));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ScriptExports.read(header()+"// @genesis export "+EXPORT+" action other"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ScriptExports.uuid("1-1-1-1-1"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ScriptExports.read("// @genesis export "+EXPORT+" condition ready"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ScriptExports.read("x".repeat(1_048_577)));
    }
    @Test void renamePreservesIdentityAndSnapshotIsImmutable() {
        var r=new CapabilityRegistry<String>();
        r.replace(List.of(entry(REF,"old",List.of("n"))));
        var before=r.snapshot();
        r.replace(List.of(entry(REF,"new",List.of("n"))));
        assertEquals("new",r.snapshot().resolve(REF).symbol().source());
        assertEquals("old",before.resolve(REF).symbol().source());
        assertThrows(UnsupportedOperationException.class,()->before.entries().clear());
        long rev=r.snapshot().revision();
        r.replace(List.of(entry(REF,"new",List.of("n"))));
        assertEquals(rev,r.snapshot().revision());
    }
    @Test void ambiguousRegistryPublicationIsAtomic() {
        var r=new CapabilityRegistry<String>();
        r.replace(List.of(entry(REF,"good",List.of())));
        long rev=r.snapshot().revision();
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->r.replace(List.of(entry(REF,"a",List.of()),entry(new Reference(MODULE,EXPORT,Kind.ACTION),"b",List.of()))));
        assertEquals(rev,r.snapshot().revision());
        assertEquals("good",r.snapshot().resolve(REF).symbol().source());
    }
    @Test void signatureAndDeletionFailClosed() {

        assertNotNull(r.snapshot().problem(binding(REF,Map.of())));

    }
    @Test void dependenciesAndUsagesAreImmutable() {

    @Test void profileRejectsForeignBindingsAndInvalidValues() {

    static class Action implements LinkedBehavior.Action {
        boolean done;
        Throwable failure;
        int closed;
        public boolean done() {
            return done;
        }
        public Throwable failure() {
            return failure;
        }
        public void close() {
            closed++;
        }
    }
    @Test void behaviorDoesNotOverlapAndFalseCancelsAction() {
        var action=new Action();
        int[] starts= {
            0
        }
        ,conditions= {
            0
        }
        ;
        boolean[] allow= {
            true
        }
        ;
        var b=new LinkedBehavior<Integer>(new LinkedBehavior.Host<>() {
            public boolean condition(Integer ctx) {
                conditions[0]++;
                return allow[0];
            }
            public LinkedBehavior.Action action(Integer ctx) {
                starts[0]++;
                return action;
            }
        }
        ,10);
        b.tick(0,0);
        b.tick(0,1);
        b.tick(0,10);
        assertEquals(1,starts[0]);
        assertEquals(2,conditions[0]);
        assertEquals(LinkedBehavior.State.RUNNING,b.state());
        allow[0]=false;
        b.tick(0,20);
        assertEquals(1,action.closed);
        assertEquals(LinkedBehavior.State.IDLE,b.state());
        b.close();
        b.tick(0,30);
        assertEquals(2+1,conditions[0]);
    }
    @Test void behaviorFailureIsStickyAndCleanupRuns() {
        var action=new Action();
        int[] starts= {
            0
        }
        ;
        var b=new LinkedBehavior<Integer>(new LinkedBehavior.Host<>() {
            public boolean condition(Integer c) {
                return true;
            }
            public LinkedBehavior.Action action(Integer c) {
                starts[0]++;
                return action;
            }
        }
        ,10);
        b.tick(0,0);
        action.failure=new IllegalStateException("broken");

        assertEquals(LinkedBehavior.State.ERROR,b.state());
        assertEquals(1,action.closed);
        b.tick(0,100);
        assertEquals(1,starts[0]);
        assertNotNull(b.failure());
    }
    @Test void completedActionCanStartOnNextEvaluationAndCloseIsIdempotent() {
        int[] starts= {
            0
        }
        ;
        var actions=new ArrayList<Action>();
        var b=new LinkedBehavior<Integer>(new LinkedBehavior.Host<>() {
            public boolean condition(Integer c) {
                return true;
            }
            public LinkedBehavior.Action action(Integer c) {
                starts[0]++;

                return a;
            }

        ,10);

        actions.get(0).done=true;

        b.tick(0,10);
        assertEquals(2,starts[0]);
        b.close();
        b.close();
        assertEquals(1,actions.get(1).closed);
    }
    @Test void consumerSlotPairsDoNotCollideOnSlashes(){

    @Test void literalSnapshotSearchPreservesPositionsHandlesDraftsAndHasBounds() {

    @Test void snippetsInferConventionalPackagesAndNeverAlterExistingFiles()throws Exception {

===== src\test\java\com\fixmer\mared\ServerModuleRuntimeIntegrationTest.java =====
package com.fixmer.mared;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.server.*;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.jar.*;
import java.io.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** Real compiler and class loaders; world host is a recording implementation, not Minecraft. */
class ServerModuleRuntimeIntegrationTest {
    static final class Host implements ServerModuleHost {
        final Thread thread=Thread.currentThread();final UUID id=UUID.randomUUID();
        final List<String> broadcasts=new ArrayList<>();boolean allowed=true;long time;
        public UUID owner(){return id;}public String worldSession(){return "test";}
        public boolean isServerThread(){return Thread.currentThread()==thread;}public boolean allowed(){return allowed;}
        public void log(String text){}public void broadcast(String text){broadcasts.add(text);}
        public void setDayTime(String dimension,long time){this.time=time;}
        public void setWeather(int duration,boolean rain,boolean thunder){}
        public void validateBlock(String dimension,int x,int y,int z,String block){}
        public void setBlock(String dimension,int x,int y,int z,String block){}
        public Object nativeServer(){return this;}
    }
    static RuntimeBundle compile(String body)throws Exception {
        String source="import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.server.*;public class WorldModule implements ServerModule{public void onEnable(ServerContext c)throws Exception{"+body+"}}";
        return RuntimeModuleCompiler.compile(Map.of("src/WorldModule.java",source),Map.of(),Map.of(),"WorldModule",new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation()).bundle();
    }
    @Test void failedAndCancelledReplacementsPreserveActiveGenerationAndStagedWorldActions()throws Exception {
        var host=new Host();try(var engine=new ServerModuleEngine(host)) {
            assertTrue(engine.apply("world",compile("c.setDayTime(\"minecraft:overworld\",6000);")).success());long generation=engine.snapshot().get("world").generation();
            var bad=compile("c.broadcast(\"must not publish\");throw new IllegalStateException(\"failed\");");Path badRoot=bad.root();
            assertFalse(engine.apply("world",bad).success());assertFalse(Files.exists(badRoot));assertTrue(host.broadcasts.isEmpty());
            System.clearProperty("genesis.runtime.cancel.test");var cancelled=compile("c.setDayTime(\"minecraft:overworld\",18000);System.setProperty(\"genesis.runtime.cancel.test\",\"yes\");");Path cancelledRoot=cancelled.root();
            try {assertFalse(engine.apply("world",cancelled,()->System.getProperty("genesis.runtime.cancel.test")!=null).success());}
            finally {System.clearProperty("genesis.runtime.cancel.test");}
            assertEquals(6000,host.time);assertEquals(generation,engine.snapshot().get("world").generation());assertFalse(Files.exists(cancelledRoot));
        }
    }
    @Test void rollbackRecreatesPreviousCodeWithCurrentStateAndStopDeletesBothBundles()throws Exception {
        var host=new Host();try(var engine=new ServerModuleEngine(host)) {
            var first=compile("String n=c.state(\"count\");c.broadcast(\"v1:\"+n);c.state(\"count\",\"one\");");var second=compile("c.broadcast(\"v2:\"+c.state(\"count\"));c.state(\"count\",\"two\");");
            assertTrue(engine.apply("world",first).success());assertTrue(engine.apply("world",second).success());assertTrue(engine.rollback("world").success());
            assertEquals(List.of("v1:null","v2:one","v1:two"),host.broadcasts);assertTrue(engine.snapshot().get("world").canRollback());
            assertTrue(engine.stop("world").success());assertTrue(engine.snapshot().isEmpty());assertFalse(Files.exists(first.root()));assertFalse(Files.exists(second.root()));
        }
    }
    @Test void callbackFailureCannotLeaveTickSubscriptionsAlive()throws Exception {
        var host=new Host();try(var engine=new ServerModuleEngine(host)) {
            assertTrue(engine.apply("world",compile("c.onTick(t->{throw new IllegalStateException(\"tick fault\");});c.onTick(t->c.broadcast(\"late\"));")).success());
            engine.tick();engine.tick();var status=engine.snapshot().get("world");assertFalse(status.running());assertEquals(0,status.callbacks());assertTrue(status.error().contains("tick fault"));assertTrue(host.broadcasts.isEmpty());
        }
    }
    @Test void ordinaryMainAndMalformedJavaCannotBecomeServerModules()throws Exception {
        var host=new Host();try(var engine=new ServerModuleEngine(host)) {
            var plain=RuntimeModuleCompiler.compile(Map.of("Main.java","public class Main{public static void main(String[]a){}}"),Map.of(),Map.of(),"Main",new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation()).bundle();
            assertFalse(engine.apply("main",plain).success());assertFalse(Files.exists(plain.root()));
            assertThrows(IOException.class,()->RuntimeModuleCompiler.compile(Map.of("WorldModule.java","not valid Java"),Map.of(),Map.of(),"WorldModule",new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation()));
        }
    }
    @Test void immutableJarDeploymentIncludesResourcesAndCannotReplaceHostApi()throws Exception {
        byte[] bytes;try(var compiled=compile("try(var in=getClass().getResourceAsStream(\"/message.txt\")){c.broadcast(new String(in.readAllBytes(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}")) {
            var output=new ByteArrayOutputStream();try(var jar=new JarOutputStream(output)) {
                try(var walk=Files.walk(compiled.root().resolve("classes"))) {for(Path file:walk.filter(Files::isRegularFile).toList()) {jar.putNextEntry(new JarEntry(compiled.root().resolve("classes").relativize(file).toString().replace('\\','/')));jar.write(Files.readAllBytes(file));jar.closeEntry();}}
                jar.putNextEntry(new JarEntry("message.txt"));jar.write("jar resource".getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));jar.closeEntry();
            }bytes=output.toByteArray();
        }
        var bundle=RuntimeModuleCompiler.fromJar(bytes,Map.of(),"WorldModule",new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation()).bundle();Arrays.fill(bytes,(byte)0);
        var host=new Host();try(var engine=new ServerModuleEngine(host)) {assertTrue(engine.apply("jar",bundle).success());assertEquals(List.of("jar resource"),host.broadcasts);}
        assertFalse(Files.exists(bundle.root()));assertThrows(IOException.class,()->RuntimeModuleCompiler.fromJar(new byte[]{0},Map.of(),"WorldModule",new JavaSourceRunner.Cancellation()));
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->compile("com.fixmer.mared.Mared.class.getName();"));
    }
    @Test void apiExportPreservesUserEditsAndPermissionClosureReleasesRuntime()throws Exception {
        var store=new SourceProjects(Files.createTempDirectory("server-project-test-"));var project=store.createServerModule("demo");assertEquals(ServerModuleTemplate.source(),store.read(project.id(),"src/WorldModule.java"));
        Path api=store.exportServerApi("demo");assertTrue(Arrays.equals(RuntimeModuleCompiler.apiJar(),Files.readAllBytes(api)));Files.writeString(api,"local edit");assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.exportServerApi("demo"));assertEquals("local edit",Files.readString(api));
        var host=new Host();var bundle=compile("c.onTick(t->{});");try(var engine=new ServerModuleEngine(host)) {assertTrue(engine.apply("world",bundle).success());host.allowed=false;engine.tick();assertTrue(engine.snapshot().isEmpty());assertFalse(Files.exists(bundle.root()));}
    }
}

package com.fixmer.mared;
import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.scripts.SourceProjects;

class SourceProjectsIntegrationTest {
    @Test void createsAllRealLanguageSourcesAndIndependentDirectories() throws Exception {
        var root=Files.createTempDirectory("source-projects-");var store=new SourceProjects(root);
        for(Language l:Language.values()){var p=store.create(l.name(),l);assertEquals(l,store.project(p.id()).language());
            assertEquals(l.starter,store.read(p.id(),"src/"+l.entry));assertTrue(Files.isDirectory(root.resolve(p.id()+"/libraries")));assertTrue(Files.isDirectory(root.resolve(p.id()+"/resources")));}
        assertEquals(4,store.list().projects().size());assertFalse(Files.exists(root.resolve("commands")));
    }
    @Test void nestedFilesSaveAtomicallyAndRefuseExternalChangesOrMissingFiles() throws Exception {
        var root=Files.createTempDirectory("source-projects-");var store=new SourceProjects(root);store.create("demo",Language.PYTHON);
        store.createFile("demo","src/utils/tool.py");store.save("demo","src/utils/tool.py","","привет\n");assertEquals("привет\n",store.read("demo","src/utils/tool.py"));
        Files.writeString(root.resolve("demo/src/utils/tool.py"),"external");assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.save("demo","src/utils/tool.py","привет\n","overwrite"));
        assertEquals("external",store.read("demo","src/utils/tool.py"));Files.delete(root.resolve("demo/src/utils/tool.py"));
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.save("demo","src/utils/tool.py","external","resurrect"));assertFalse(Files.exists(root.resolve("demo/src/utils/tool.py")));
    }
    @Test void invalidPathsAliasesAndSymlinksNeverEscapeTheProject() throws Exception {
        var root=Files.createTempDirectory("source-projects-");var store=new SourceProjects(root);store.create("demo",Language.JAVA);
        for(String id:new String[]{"../outside","A/B","CON","NUL.txt","demo"})assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.create(id,Language.JAVA));
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.create("DEMO",Language.JAVA));
        for(String p:new String[]{"../x.java","src/../../x.java","libraries/x.jar","src/CON.java","src/x.exe","src/a\\x.py"})assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.createFile("demo",p));
        store.createFile("demo","src/Util.java");assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.createFile("demo","src/util.java"));
        Path outside=Files.createTempDirectory("source-outside-");
        try {Files.createSymbolicLink(root.resolve("demo/src/link"),outside);}catch(IOException|UnsupportedOperationException|SecurityException unavailable){return;}
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.createFile("demo","src/link/evil.java"));assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.files("demo"));assertFalse(Files.exists(outside.resolve("evil.java")));
    }
    @Test void recoveryPreservesBaselineAndDoesNotWriteSource() throws Exception {
        var root=Files.createTempDirectory("source-projects-");var store=new SourceProjects(root);store.create("demo",Language.RUST);String original=store.read("demo","src/main.rs");
        store.checkpoint("demo","src/main.rs",original,"draft\n");var reopened=new SourceProjects(root);var recovery=reopened.recovery("demo","src/main.rs");
        assertEquals(original,recovery.baseline());assertEquals("draft\n",recovery.text());assertEquals(original,reopened.read("demo","src/main.rs"));
        reopened.checkpoint("demo","src/main.rs",original,original);assertNull(reopened.recovery("demo","src/main.rs"));
    }
    @Test void malformedMetadataAndInvalidUtf8AreReportedWithoutDroppingOtherProjects() throws Exception {

        Files.write(root.resolve("good/src/main.cpp"),new byte[]{(byte)0xC3,(byte)0x28});assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.read("good","src/main.cpp"));
    }
    @Test void boundedWritesAndRecoveryRejectOversizeAndCorruptRecords() throws Exception {
        var root=Files.createTempDirectory("source-projects-");var store=new SourceProjects(root);store.create("demo",Language.PYTHON);String original=store.read("demo","src/main.py");

        store.checkpoint("demo","src/main.py",original,"draft");try(var entries=Files.list(root.resolve(".genesis-recovery"))){Files.write(entries.findFirst().orElseThrow(),new byte[]{0,0,0,1,127,127,127,127});}
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->store.recovery("demo","src/main.py"));assertEquals(original,store.read("demo","src/main.py"));

/** Real production storage/adapter/journal classes on the Minecraft classpath; no window. */
public class StorageIntegrationTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;

    @Test void newerIntentInvalidatesOlderSave() throws Exception {
        repository.create("file","base");
        var first=repository.capture("file","base");
        var second=repository.capture("file","base");
        assertFalse(repository.write(first,"old"));assertTrue(repository.write(second,"new"));
        assertFalse(repository.write(first,"old"));assertEquals("new",repository.read("file"));
    }
    @Test void deleteAndRecreationCannotResurrectOldSnapshot() throws Exception {
        repository.create("file","base");var ticket=repository.capture("file");
        repository.delete("file");assertFalse(repository.write(ticket,"ghost"));
        repository.create("file","replacement");assertFalse(repository.write(ticket,"ghost"));
        assertEquals("replacement",repository.read("file"));
    }
    @Test void renameInvalidatesQueuedSaveAndKeepsDestination() throws Exception {
        repository.create("file","base");var ticket=repository.capture("file");
        repository.rename("file","new");assertFalse(repository.write(ticket,"ghost"));
        assertFalse(repository.exists("file"));assertEquals("base",repository.read("new"));
        repository.create("occupied","protected");
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->repository.rename("new","occupied"));
        assertEquals("protected",repository.read("occupied"));assertEquals("base",repository.read("new"));
    }
    @Test void externalEditsCauseConflict() throws Exception {

        assertEquals("external",repository.read("file"));
    }
    @Test void ownCommittedSaveCanBeFollowedBeforeCallback() throws Exception {

        assertEquals("second",repository.read("file"));
    }
    @Test void invalidateCancelsQueuedSave() throws Exception {

    }
    @Test void invalidUtf8AndOversizeAreRejected() throws Exception {

    @Test void selectiveCleanupAlsoPreservesDelayedAndRepeatingListeners() {
        MaredEventRegistry.removeAllEvents();
        try {
            var ordinary=new MaredScriptContext(null,null,s->{});
            var persistent=new MaredScriptContext(null,null,s->{});persistent.setPersistent(true);
            MaredEventRegistry.registerEvery(10,List.of(),ordinary,false);
            MaredEventRegistry.registerEvery(10,List.of(),persistent,true);
            MaredEventRegistry.registerAfter(10,List.of(),ordinary);

        }finally{MaredEventRegistry.removeAllEvents();}
    }

    }
    @Test void persistentCleanupKeepsOrdinaryListeners() {
        MaredEventRegistry.removeAllEvents();

===== src\test\java\com\fixmer\mared\TextReplacementIntegrationTest.java =====
package com.fixmer.mared;

import com.fixmer.genesis.technology.editor.TextSearch;
import com.fixmer.mared.technology.editor.DocumentReplacement;
import com.fixmer.mared.gui2.framework.components.editor.*;
import com.fixmer.mared.gui2.studio.panels.workspace.DocumentSession;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class TextReplacementIntegrationTest {
    @Test void replacementsAreLiteralNonOverlappingAndCaseAware() {
        assertEquals(new TextSearch.Replacement("$1\\x$1\\x",2),new TextSearch("aa",true).replaceAll("aaaa","$1\\x",100));
        assertEquals("xba",new TextSearch("aba",true).replaceAll("ababa","x",100).text());
        assertEquals("X X 😀",new TextSearch("привет",false).replaceAll("ПРИВЕТ привет 😀","X",100).text());
        assertEquals("A x",new TextSearch("a",true).replaceAll("A a","x",100).text());
        assertEquals("b",new TextSearch("a",true).replaceAll("aba","",100).text());
        assertEquals("a",new TextSearch("",true).replaceAll("a","x",100).text());
        assertTrue(new TextSearch("a",false).matches("😀A",2,3));
        assertFalse(new TextSearch("a",true).matches("😀A",2,3));
        assertFalse(new TextSearch("a",false).matches("A",0,2));
    }
    @Test void linearReplacementMatchesReferenceOnRandomInputs() {
        var rng=new java.util.Random(704);
        for(int n=0;n<2000;n++) {
            var s=new StringBuilder();for(int i=rng.nextInt(200);i>0;i--)s.append("ab\n".charAt(rng.nextInt(3)));
            String source=s.toString(),query=n%2==0?"aba":"aa",replacement=n%3==0?"":"$1\\value";
            assertEquals(source.replace(query,replacement),new TextSearch(query,true).replaceAll(source,replacement,10000).text());
        }
    }
    @Test void replaceAllIsOneUndoStepAndPreservesDirtyState() {
        var session=new DocumentSession();session.storageId="saved";session.setInitialText("😀 one\none");session.document.setCursor(1,3);
        var result=new TextSearch("one",true).replaceAll(session.currentText(),"two",100);
        assertTrue(DocumentReplacement.apply(session,session.currentText(),result.text(),5));
        assertTrue(session.dirty);assertEquals(1,session.history.undoSize());assertEquals("😀 two\ntwo",session.currentText());
        assertTrue(session.history.undo(session.document));session.recomputeDirty();
        assertEquals("😀 one\none",session.currentText());assertFalse(session.dirty);assertEquals(1,session.document.cursorLine());assertEquals(3,session.document.cursorCol());
        assertTrue(session.history.redo(session.document));session.recomputeDirty();assertTrue(session.dirty);
        int version=session.document.contentVersion();
        assertFalse(DocumentReplacement.apply(session,session.currentText(),session.currentText(),0));assertEquals(version,session.document.contentVersion());assertEquals(1,session.history.undoSize());
    }
    @Test void limitsAndStaleSnapshotsLeaveDocumentAndHistoryUntouched() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->new TextSearch("a",true).replaceAll("aaa","xxxx",10));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->new TextSearch("a",true).replaceAll("aaa","b",2));
        var session=new DocumentSession();session.setInitialText("safe");
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException.class,()->DocumentReplacement.apply(session,"old","new",0));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->DocumentReplacement.apply(session,"safe","я".repeat(3*1024*1024),0));
        assertEquals("safe",session.currentText());assertEquals(0,session.history.undoSize());assertFalse(session.dirty);
    }
    @Test void atomicReplacementNeverCoalescesWithTypingOrBackspace() {
        var doc=new EditorDocument();var history=new EditorHistory();doc.setValue("abc");
        var replacement=new Edit(0,0,"a","",0,0,0,0);doc.applyEdit(replacement);history.record(replacement);
        var deletion=new Edit(0,0,"b","",0,0,0,0);doc.applyEdit(deletion);history.recordCoalescible(deletion);
        assertEquals(2,history.undoSize());assertTrue(history.undo(doc));assertEquals("bc",doc.getValue());assertTrue(history.undo(doc));assertEquals("abc",doc.getValue());
        history.clear();doc.setValue("");
        for(int i=0;i<3;i++){var e=new Edit(0,i,"","x",0,i,0,i+1);doc.applyEdit(e);history.recordCoalescible(e);}
        assertEquals(1,history.undoSize());assertEquals(3L,history.retainedCharacters());assertTrue(history.undo(doc));assertEquals("",doc.getValue());
    }
    @Test void historyBoundsLargeReplacementsAndReleasesDiscardedRedo() {
        var history=new EditorHistory();var text="x".repeat(3*1024*1024);
        for(int i=0;i<4;i++)history.record(new Edit(0,0,text,text,0,0,0,0));
        assertEquals(1,history.undoSize());assertEquals(6L*1024*1024,history.retainedCharacters());
        var doc=new EditorDocument();doc.setValue(text);assertTrue(history.undo(doc));
        history.record(new Edit(0,0,"","a",0,0,0,1));assertEquals(1L,history.retainedCharacters());assertEquals(0,history.redoSize());
        history.clear();assertEquals(0L,history.retainedCharacters());
    }
}

===== src\test\java\com\fixmer\mared\TranslationFormattingIntegrationTest.java =====
package com.fixmer.mared;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class TranslationFormattingIntegrationTest {
    @Test void versionAndQuotedFileNamesAreSubstituted() {
        assertEquals("Версия: 0.4.0", MaredLang.formatTemplate("Версия: {0}", Mared.VERSION));
        assertEquals("Rename 'quests/start'", MaredLang.formatTemplate("Rename '{0}'", "quests/start"));
    }
    @Test void insertedTextIsLiteralAndNeverExpandedAgain() {
        assertEquals("'$1\\path {1} 50%' / ok", MaredLang.formatTemplate("'{0}' / {1}", "$1\\path {1} 50%", "ok"));
        assertEquals("value-value", MaredLang.formatTemplate("{0}-{0}", "value"));
    }
    @Test void missingAndOversizedIndicesStayVisible() {
        assertEquals("first {2} {999999999999999999999}", MaredLang.formatTemplate("{0} {2} {999999999999999999999}", "first"));
        assertEquals("{0}", MaredLang.formatTemplate("{0}", (Object[]) null));
    }
    @Test void percentCompatibilityAndPlainTextArePreserved() {
        assertEquals("Could not create quests/start", MaredLang.formatTemplate("Could not create %s", "quests/start"));
        assertEquals("50% complete", MaredLang.formatTemplate("50% complete"));
        assertEquals("%q", MaredLang.formatTemplate("%q", "arg"));
        assertEquals("50% done", MaredLang.formatTemplate("50% {0}", "done"));
        assertEquals("null", MaredLang.formatTemplate("{0}", (Object) null));
    }
}

===== verification\ContextRegressionTest.java =====
import java.util.*;
import com.fixmer.mared.commands.engine.*;
import com.fixmer.mared.commands.events_cmd.MaredWaitUntilCommand;
/** Tests production context methods; the runner removes only Minecraft data-refresh methods. */
public class ContextRegressionTest {
 static int checks;
 static void check(boolean value,String reason){checks++;if(!value)throw new AssertionError(reason);}
 static MaredScriptCommand cmd(java.util.function.BiConsumer<MaredScriptContext,MaredScriptExecutor> fn){return new MaredScriptCommand(){public void execute(MaredScriptContext c,MaredScriptExecutor e){fn.accept(c,e);}public String describe(){return "context-test";}};}
 public static void main(String[]args){
  var c=new MaredScriptContext(null,null,s->{});int[] count={0};
  c.registerFunction("next",List.of(),List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->e.setReturnValue((long)++count[0]))));
  check(c.substitute("${next()}").equals("1"),"First function substitution");
  check(c.substitute("${next()}").equals("2"),"No result cache for repeated call");
  c.setVariable("value",1L);check(c.substitute("$value").equals("1"),"Initial value");
  c.setVariable("value",2L);check(c.substitute("$value").equals("2"),"Same tick sees changed variable");
  c.registerFunction("wait",List.of("temporary"),List.of(new MaredWaitUntilCommand("false")));
  try{c.callFunction("wait",List.of(3L));throw new AssertionError("Synchronous wait accepted");}catch(IllegalStateException expected){checks++;}
  check(!c.hasVariable("temporary"),"Absent parameter removed after failure");
  c.setVariable("temporary",null);
  try{c.callFunction("wait",List.of(3L));throw new AssertionError("Synchronous wait accepted");}catch(IllegalStateException expected){checks++;}
  check(c.hasVariable("temporary")&&c.getVariable("temporary")==null,"Existing null binding restored");
  for(var params:List.of(List.of("same","same"),List.of("self"),List.of("global.x"))){
   try{c.registerFunction("bad",params,List.of());throw new AssertionError("Bad parameters accepted");}catch(IllegalArgumentException expected){checks++;}
  }
  var server=new net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer();var fork=c.forkFor(null,server);
  check(fork.getServer()==server&&fork.hasFunction("next"),"Event fork binds server and keeps functions");
  check(!fork.hasVariable("temporary"),"Fork has independent variables");
  System.out.println("Production context method checks passed: "+checks);
 }
}

"""Test unchanged production context methods; strip Minecraft player-data refresh only.
This is a source-extraction harness, not compilation of the complete Minecraft mod.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile, subprocess
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
jdk=os.environ.get('JAVA_HOME')
java=str(Path(jdk)/'bin/java') if jdk else 'java'
javac=str(Path(jdk)/'bin/javac') if jdk else 'javac'
source=root/'src/main/java/com/fixmer/mared/commands'
paths=list((root/'technologies/core/src/main/java').rglob('*.java'))
paths += [p for p in (root/'verification/stubs').rglob('*.java') if p.name not in ['MaredScriptContext.java','ServerPlayer.java']]
paths += [source/p for p in ['engine/MaredScriptCommand.java','engine/MaredScriptExecutor.java','control/MaredIfCommand.java','expr/MaredExpr.java','expr/MaredMethods.java','events_cmd/MaredWaitUntilCommand.java']]
# EventRegistry is not part of this context harness; the other harness compiles it directly.
paths += [root/'verification/ContextRegressionTest.java']
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
    work=Path(temp)
    context=(source/'engine/MaredScriptContext.java').read_text()
    start=context.index('    public void refreshPlayerData()')
    end=context.index('    public void refreshEventData(')
    context=context[:start]+context[end:]
    context=context.replace('import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;','')
    extras={
      'MaredScriptContext.java':context,
      'ServerPlayer.java':'package net.minecraft.server.level; public class ServerPlayer { public Chain getName(){return new Chain();} public Chain level(){return new Chain();} public static class Chain { public String getString(){return "stub";} public Chain dimension(){return this;} public Chain location(){return this;} } }',
      'MaredTicks.java':'package com.fixmer.mared; public class MaredTicks { public static long get(){return 0;} }',
      'MaredGlobalStorage.java':'package com.fixmer.mared.commands.storage; public class MaredGlobalStorage { private static final java.util.Map<String,Object> values=new java.util.HashMap<>(); public static void set(String n,Object v){values.put(n,v);} public static Object get(String n){return values.get(n);} public static boolean has(String n){return values.containsKey(n);} public static void remove(String n){values.remove(n);} }',
      'MaredBuiltins.java':'package com.fixmer.mared.commands.expr; public class MaredBuiltins { public static Object call(String n,java.util.List<Object> args,com.fixmer.mared.commands.engine.MaredScriptContext c){throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown builtin: "+n);} }'
    }
    for name,text in extras.items():
        p=work/name;p.write_text(text);paths.append(p)
    classes=work/'classes';classes.mkdir()
    subprocess.run([javac,'-encoding','UTF-8','-d',str(classes),*map(str,paths)],check=True)
    subprocess.run([java,'-cp',str(classes),'ContextRegressionTest'],check=True)

===== verification\RuntimeRegressionTest.java =====
import java.util.*;
import com.fixmer.mared.commands.engine.*;
import com.fixmer.mared.commands.control.*;
import com.fixmer.mared.commands.events_cmd.*;
import com.fixmer.mared.commands.expr.MaredExpr;
public class RuntimeRegressionTest {
 static int checks;
 static void check(boolean value,String why){checks++;if(!value)throw new AssertionError(why);}
 static MaredScriptCommand cmd(java.util.function.BiConsumer<MaredScriptContext,MaredScriptExecutor> fn){return new MaredScriptCommand(){public void execute(MaredScriptContext c,MaredScriptExecutor e){fn.accept(c,e);}public String describe(){return "test";}};}
 static void finish(MaredScriptExecutor e){for(int i=0;i<100&&!e.isFinished();i++)e.tick();check(e.isFinished(),"Finished");}
 public static void main(String[]args){
  var c=new MaredScriptContext();
  for(var entry:Map.of("-1 + 2",1L,"8 * 2 / 4",4L,"8 * 3 % 5",4L,"1 - 2 + 3",2L).entrySet())check(MaredExpr.eval(entry.getKey(),c).equals(entry.getValue()),"Precedence: "+entry.getKey());
  check(!MaredExpr.evalBool("false && probe()",c)&&c.calls==0,"AND short circuit");
  check(MaredExpr.evalBool("true || probe()",c)&&c.calls==0,"OR short circuit");
  check(!MaredExpr.evalBool("false && (null)()",c),"Skipped branch does not check runtime call type");
  check(MaredExpr.evalBool("false || probe()",c)&&c.calls==1,"Required call executes");
  for(String bad:List.of("true && )","true & false","1 @ 2","\"unterminated","(".repeat(140)+"1"+")".repeat(140),"!".repeat(140)+"true")) {
   try{MaredExpr.eval(bad,c);throw new AssertionError("Invalid expression accepted: "+bad);}catch(RuntimeException expected){checks++;}
  }
  c.setVariable("a",1L);c.setVariable("b",2L);
  c.funcs.put("swap",new MaredScriptContext.Func(List.of("a","b","absent"),List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->check(ctx.getVariable("a").equals(2L)&&ctx.getVariable("b").equals(1L),"Caller arguments")))));
  finish(new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(new MaredCallCommand("swap",List.of("$b","$a")))));
  check(c.getVariable("a").equals(1L)&&c.getVariable("b").equals(2L)&&!c.hasVariable("absent"),"Restore presence and values");
  c.funcs.put("pause",new MaredScriptContext.Func(List.of("fresh"),List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->e.pauseCurrent(10)))));
  var paused=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(new MaredCallCommand("pause",List.of("7"))));paused.tick();check(c.hasVariable("fresh"),"Bound during function");paused.stopAll();check(!c.hasVariable("fresh"),"Unbound after cancellation");
  int[] hits={0};var instruction=new MaredWaitUntilCommand("$ready");
  var waiting=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(instruction,cmd((ctx,e)->hits[0]++)));
  for(int i=0;i<4;i++)waiting.tick();check(hits[0]==0&&!waiting.isFinished(),"Waiting retries");
  var other=new MaredScriptContext();other.setVariable("ready",true);var parallel=new MaredScriptExecutor(other,List.of(instruction));finish(parallel);
  check(!waiting.isFinished(),"Shared instruction has independent wait state");
  c.setVariable("ready",true);finish(waiting);check(hits[0]==1,"Resumed once");
  var bad=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(new MaredIfCommand("true && )",List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->hits[0]++)))));finish(bad);check(bad.failure()!=null&&hits[0]==1,"Malformed guard stops");
  c.funcs.put("breakfn",new MaredScriptContext.Func(List.of(),List.of(new MaredBreakCommand(),cmd((ctx,e)->hits[0]++))));finish(new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(new MaredCallCommand("breakfn",List.of()))));check(hits[0]==2,"Break cannot escape function scope");
  c.funcs.put("recursive",new MaredScriptContext.Func(List.of(),List.of(new MaredCallCommand("recursive",List.of()))));var deep=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(new MaredCallCommand("recursive",List.of())));finish(deep);check(deep.failure()!=null&&deep.getStackDepth()==0,"Stack bounded and cleaned");
  check(MaredCallCommand.resolveArg("\"a\\n\"",c).equals("a\n"),"Escaped argument");
  var limits=new com.fixmer.genesis.technology.runtime.ExecutionLimits(2,4,8,1_000_000_000L);
  int[] count={0};var budget=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,Collections.nCopies(10,cmd((ctx,e)->count[0]++)),limits);
  budget.tick();check(count[0]==2&&!budget.isFinished(),"Per-tick step budget");finish(budget);check(count[0]==4&&budget.failure()!=null,"Lifetime instruction limit");
  MaredScriptRunner.stopAll();
  var live=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->e.pauseCurrent(50))));
  var done=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->{})));
  MaredScriptRunner.start(live);MaredScriptRunner.start(done);MaredScriptRunner.tick(null);
  check(MaredScriptRunner.getActiveCount()==1&&!live.isFinished(),"Earlier survivor stays active");
  MaredScriptRunner.start(live);check(MaredScriptRunner.getActiveCount()==1,"Duplicate not admitted");MaredScriptRunner.stopAll();
  var replacement=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->e.pauseCurrent(50))));
  var stopping=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->{MaredScriptRunner.stopAll();MaredScriptRunner.start(replacement);})));MaredScriptRunner.start(stopping);MaredScriptRunner.tick(null);
  check(MaredScriptRunner.getActiveCount()==1&&!replacement.isFinished(),"Reentrant stop and start preserved");MaredScriptRunner.stopAll();
  var server=new net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer();var ownedContext=new MaredScriptContext();ownedContext.server=server;int[] ownedHits={0};
  var owned=new MaredScriptExecutor(ownedContext,List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->ownedHits[0]++)));MaredScriptRunner.start(owned);MaredScriptRunner.tick(null);check(ownedHits[0]==0,"Other server does not execute context");MaredScriptRunner.tick(server);check(ownedHits[0]==1,"Owning server executes context");MaredScriptRunner.stopAll();
  for(int i=0;i<100;i++)MaredScriptRunner.start(new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->e.pauseCurrent(50)))));
  var rejected=new MaredScriptExecutor(c,List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->{})));MaredScriptRunner.start(rejected);check(rejected.isFinished()&&MaredScriptRunner.getActiveCount()==100,"Capacity rejection cleans executor");MaredScriptRunner.stopAll();
  check(MaredScriptRunner.getActiveCount()==0,"Stop clears snapshot");
  var template=new MaredScriptContext();int[] eventHits={0};
  com.fixmer.mared.commands.events.MaredEventRegistry.register("regression",List.of(cmd((ctx,e)->{check(ctx.getServer()==server,"Event fork server");eventHits[0]++;})),template,false,false);
  com.fixmer.mared.commands.events.MaredEventRegistry.fire("regression",server,Map.of());MaredScriptRunner.tick(server);check(eventHits[0]==1,"Event with null template server executes");
  com.fixmer.mared.commands.events.MaredEventRegistry.removeAllEvents();MaredScriptRunner.stopAll();
  System.out.println("Runtime/expression checks passed: "+checks);
 }
}

package com.fixmer.mared.commands.engine;
import java.util.*;
public class MaredScriptContext implements com.fixmer.genesis.technology.expression.ExpressionEnvironment {
 private boolean persistent; public boolean isPersistent(){return persistent;} public void setPersistent(boolean value){persistent=value;}

 public static class Func { public List<String> params; public List<MaredScriptCommand> body; public Func(List<String> p,List<MaredScriptCommand> b){params=p;body=b;} }
 public MaredScriptContext() {} public MaredScriptContext(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer p,net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer s,java.util.function.Consumer<String> logger){server=s;}
 public net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer getInitiator(){return null;}
 public MaredScriptContext forkFor(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer p,net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer s){var c=new MaredScriptContext();c.server=s;return c;}
 public void refreshPlayerData(){} public void refreshEventData(Map<String,Object> values){vars.putAll(values);}
 public net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer server; public net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer getServer(){return server;}
 public final Map<String,Object> vars=new HashMap<>(); public final Map<String,Func> funcs=new HashMap<>();
 public Func getFunction(String n){return funcs.get(n);} public Object getVariable(String n){return vars.get(n);}
 public boolean hasVariable(String n){return vars.containsKey(n);} public void setVariable(String n,Object v){vars.put(n,v);}
 public void removeVariable(String n){vars.remove(n);} public void log(String line){}
 public boolean hasFunction(String n){return funcs.containsKey(n);} public Object callFunction(String n,List<Object> args){return callBuiltin(n,args);}
 public int calls; public Object callBuiltin(String n,List<Object> args){calls++;return 10L;}
 public Object callMethod(Object v,String n,List<Object> args){calls++;return v;}
 public String substitute(String s){return s;}
}
